chapters.title: Chapter 1790
paragraphs: Ezekiel was actually looked down upon as Helen seemed lost in her memories when she spoke of him!
"Mmm..." Juliette nodded after a while as her eyes moved onto the brown-skinned beauty that was Nefertiti.
"This one is actually interesting as she's the sister of that woman who actually turned down the invitation of a Potentate of her Bloodline from the Main Reality-...oh?"
Her words stopped as she turned towards the direction of the Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Human base at this moment.
From the gaps of the protection of LEGENDS, a purple gold ship gradually neared as it held swirling golden waves of destiny that most beings proficient in Destiny and Fate could see!
A cluster of such dense destiny was paid attention to by the monstrous beings here as another region that was like this was near the entourage of the Young Emperor.
A smile rose in Juliette's eyes as she saw this.
"Speak of the devil..."
All entering vessels that neared the Domain Rift had to pass the tight defenses of the LEGENDS overseeing everything, and at this moment- the vessel they was the Purple Endeavor appeared.
OOOM!
It was subtle.
But the atmosphere changed!

The fee Chosen Emperors and monstrous geniuses building their foundation couldn't help but gaze towards the Purple Endeavor and see just who was on it as their destinies vibrated and reacted in that direction!

Juliette's eyes sparkled with a stellar light as she watched this TABOO Vessel anchor, figures beginning to rise from it that were led by the small visage of a smiling Brightborn towards the cluster of Royal Humans.

4 Candidate Emperors whose bodies screamed of wildness that Brightborn had picked up, the regal visage of Genevieve whose aura stood above even her sibling Namur, and then behind them and floating soundlessly alone...the visage of a silver white haired beauty whose crown glimmered with the word <SACRALIZED>.
A word more robust than many more beings here as even the four Alpha Strata LEGENDs only had <EMPEROR> swirling around their crowns as they didn't have anything attached to this!
"Sacralized? Are you kidding me?"
Even Juliette was stumped at this as her figure bubbled with power, seemingly wanting to fly over in that direction even now!
"I mean a guy is good but..." She tapped her chin as a devilish smile appeared on her exceedingly beautiful face.
"...maybe I can also see if I can subjugate her to be a hubby under my heel."
WAA!

Dreadful words echoed from her as Helen shook her head again on the Lotus Flower TABOO Vessel, floating a few more emitters away from Juliette whose body was releasing a terrifying air at this moment!
"Eh?" Yet the eyes of this being briefly stopped as they locked on to another being coincidentally.
He wasn't moving with pride and mixing with etiquette among the others, with his gaze being sharp as his eyes seemed to be brightening up as he gazed at everything around him!

Over the vast Domains of the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines. Over geniuses and LEGENDS as the look in his eyes...didn't show any apprehension or wonder within them as Juliette could swear she could see something akin to hunger!
But she shook her head and got back to staring at Katelyn as which being would gaze upon the Scions of the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines like this when they themselves didn't even have a solidified crown?
Noah stepped off the Purple Endeavor as his eyes took in the vast wonders around him.
Dense auras of powerful LEGENDS and existences with astounding Destiny permeated throughout- Noah getting a chance to meet a section of the few exceptional individuals across these vast Realities!

His main body back in the Cosmic Holy Land had pulled out a glimmering golden book as he utilized the Dictum Emperor to try and peer into what could possibly happen with the tightly coiling destinies of all beings here- but it was very hard to get back any information as he prepared to let this go and begin focusing on the Third Infinite Dream that would grant him yet another edge in this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

His Clones had entered the Dream Dimension as they sought to find Dream LEGENDS and Nightmares, while another one of his clones with RUINATION in the Mirror Dimension was finally making headway as the eyes of the Gazer had grasped onto what he might need across the hard to navigate spaces filled with endless Mirrors.

And now, this clone of Alexander had arrived at the pulsing Domain Rift of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum as Noah couldn't help but greedily gaze at all the existences here, trying to contain himself as best as he could as the authority of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor was crying out with fervor!
OOOM!

His three Aspects of Existence that were filled to the brim vibrated intensely as his destiny could actually feel a level of danger from a few spots around this reality sized Domain Rift, such a Reality not making him sullen as it actually made him more excited.

The Realities were vast, and he had still only been moving for just over a year. The true geniuses and anomalies that rose and lived for millions or billions of years...it would be disappointing and unrealistic if there weren't a few that were utterly exceptional in their Realm!
He could feel the auras of such beings here as even with the current level of power as a Triple Limit Breaker he had achieved...
'I might still have to break some sweat.'
WAA!

Work. It seemed Noah truly had to put on work this time around as his eyes were dazzled by the many TABOO Vessels stretching out across the 5 mini domains made by the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines, and he was dazzled more than anything by the massive figures of 5 LEGENDS that represented the Bloodlines here today releasing undeniable waves of power.

When Noah merely compared his current self to them...he felt like a mere palm from these beings would eradicate all Aspects of Existence of his Clone with the damage even extending towards his main body if he were to ever face them! Their power was currently too high as this may be the case now...
'But it won't be so in just a few months...or maybe even weeks!'

His will swept out silently and madly as he made this resolution, walking towards the forefront of the Legions of Royal Humans as Genevieve and Emperor Namur went to mix and mingle with the Royal Humans from the Main Reality. Adjudicator Katelyn remained behind with one of the Adjudicator Legions that normally followed her as those invited by Brightborn and many others in the surroundings began to spare glances at her- especially the crown spinning above her head that read SACRILIZED.
She seemed to stand above many beings even here as for now, Noah didn't make any moves to stand out or cause any eyes to land on him.
He waited for the entrance into the Grotto Sanctum to fully unfurl his wings and let loose.
He waited until he was locked in a room with a few of the geniuses of these vast Realities as there...the battle for supremacy would show who excelled among the rest!

Why could he feel a level of danger from a few beings that he could only gaze at and not spread his will over at this moment? How many Limit Breakers were there and what oddities of these vast Realities had they attained?!

Noah wanted the answers to all these questions as his gaze spread over the majestic Royal Humans, Reality Ursidae, Infinite Willow Trees, Dragon Phoenixes, and the shimmering Astral Bloodline that uniquely looked very close to his Samsara Dao Origin forms.

His gaze was just about to travel towards one of the areas where he felt a level of danger- an area where a certain entourage was calmly talking amongst each other while floating behind a Young Emperor when...
HOOONG!

A blaring horn sounded as a flash of golden light actually bloomed at the very center of the temporary domains set up by the 5 Pure-Blooded Bloodlines- a light so fast that many beings only saw it when the existence behind it formed instantly before their eyes!

Before the eyes of many LEGENDS and powerhouses, an existence actually appeared with a flash of golden light as one could shockingly see a pair of purple gold wings extending from her feet, an even more pair of radiant gold wings stretching from her back as she was adorned in a sleek battle armor.
From this existence...a maddeningly sonorous commanding voice echoed out for all to hear- without even an ounce of fear!
"Why are we still tarrying around here? Let us enter!"
WAA!

With an unblemished visage and valor, an existence with no sign of a crown on her head appeared as destiny began to weave madly in the surroundings, Noah's ears picking up a few voices of beings from the Main Reality who spoke with shock when gazing at the new entrant.
"Akaris!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1791
paragraphs: Akaris.
This was the name Noah heard as an existence with an exceedingly powerful aura in the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy appeared at the center of all base domains of the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines.
No crown could be seen above her head as this was an unbelievable thing when looking at the visage of this being who seemed unhindered by all existences here!

Golden purple wings adorned the sides of her feet as she seemed elevated apart from many others, the radiant golden wings behind her pulsing with stellar light as she didn't even wait for a reply before gazing towards the 5 camps where the auras of powerful LEGENDS reigned.
"Those destined to be here are already here. Let the rules of engagement of this Unexplored space be known."
WAA!

She spoke in such a manner while gazing towards the Alpha Strata LEGENDS of each of the Bloodlines, and she wasn't admonished or suffocated by their pressure in any way as she seemed to hold an astounding identity!
Noah's eyes took in her visage as his destiny didn't approach this being- already feeling a sense of danger as it seemed the anomalies of the vast Realities were boundless.
As for there being no crown above her head?
She seemed to obviously be among the rare few who could hide their authority as she did it so blatantly!
<Huh...that's an interesting existence. It seems this Nexus Event won't be all that easy for you.>

Cryptic words rang out within Noah's mind from Lavalliere as majestic golden waves of destiny began to permeate throughout as the stellar crimson eyes of the Dragon Phoenix Alpha Strata LEGEND shone, a deep and ancient voice emanating from it.

"This Domain holds within it a profound sense of destiny that has only appeared a few times before in the past eons. Across the Ages, any beings lucky enough to encounter such a domain and hold the vast resources within it excelled in their Era."
OOOM!

The voice was deep as it permeated in the minds of all Adjudicator Legions, Obsidian Adjudicator Legions, Will Bearers, and even the existences that didn't have close ties with the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines as the members of Cardinal Royal Bloodlines like the Royal Cosmic Wolves and the Spirit Race could be seen mixed among the Legions or among the Royalty!

"Destiny will go to those who fight for it...so those entering this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum have to understand that battles within will be common, and deaths might occur between the Bloodlines if different parties seek to obtain an astounding destiny and fortune!"
The eyes of the Dragon Phoenix LEGENDS blazed like burning Galaxies as its voice continued to echo out, Noah's own eyes flashing as he listened closely.

"Any deaths and conflicts that occur within this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum will begin and end there as all those entering will hold their own destinies and lives in their hands. You will not be persecuted when you leave this Sanctum for what happened within as those with the strongest destinies will prevail!"
HUUM!
The eyes of many geniuses and Candidate Emperors shone as others even had their eyes raised in alarm!
They didn't know these would be the rules of engagement for the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.
Some of them thought with their identities, they would be protected if they ever ran into any dangers or fought against others- but the words of this LEGEND now caused a few to hesitate!
The other Alpha Strata LEGENDS of the four other Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines remained silent as if this was something the upper echelons had agreed upon.
The air around the surroundings changed.
Yet the expressions of the truly powerful beings who were confident in themselves remained the same as Noah...
HUUUM!
His Origin was buzzing with excitement as a glorious possible Fates began to arise before his eyes!
From the Dragon Phoenix Alpha Strata LEGEND, the booming voice continued even after the bombshell it just dropped.
"Enter."
That fast and abrupt.

So abrupt that others couldn't even react as the visage of the woman known as Akaris flashed, turning into a streak of golden light as she instantly went towards the glimmering purple blue stellar Domain Rift that was the entrance of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum!

After Akaris, the Chosen Emperors standing at the forefront of the Adjudicator Legions also moved in sequence as they related quickly, turning into lights that surged towards the entrance of the Grotto Sanctum as the Legions behind them soon began to follow.
There were boundless destinies and wonders waiting for them in this place- they couldn't be left behind and let others obtain it before them!

From the side of the Royal Humans, esteemed Obsidian Adjudicators and Royalty from the Main Reality surged into the Grotto Sanctum first as the visage of Genevieve and others followed, Noah still remaining in the ranks of those from the Pure-Blooded Domains of the Royal Humans as the calm figure of Katelyn wasn't too far away from him.
THUMP!
He could feel the beat of his heart as he remained hidden and waited for the opportunities that would bloom in the unknown lands!

He waited to enter the domain space where he would be making his breakthrough into the stage of Reality as it was bound to be a platform for him to shoot off and also establish himself among the Primordials.
Up front, Genevieve's will came to focus on him as she actually sent a mental message to him after all this time.
"Good luck, Alexander King."
WAA!
She wished him luck as the both of them understood what the other person wanted to do.
Noah's face adopted a devilish smile as he replied vibrantly.
"You as well, Empress."
The two existences- one from the Olden Era and one from the Kainos Era went towards the enlarging Domain Rift before their eyes as soon enough, they disappeared into it like many others!
Two entered...but only a single one of them would be coming out alive, and both Noah and Genevieve knew this!

Like fireflies entering a massive flame- they and many Legions of Primordials from the 5 Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines and those from Cardinal Royal Bloodlines lucky enough to gain a chance to enter...all surged towards the Domain Rift portal.

Glorious stellar Infinite Willow Trees. Majestic kingly Reality Ursidae, humanoid and full-formed incandescent Dragon Phoenixes who emanated pristine power and beauty. Royal Humans and Astral beings that shone with a light of Reality...every single one surged into the vast Domain Rift!

chapters.title: Chapter 1792
paragraphs: Within minutes, no aura of existences in the Firmaments of Ascendancy could be felt in the surroundings as only the aura of LEGENDS were left behind.
Beings like Brightborn who had sent in powerful monsters and geniuses to collect treasures for them smiled as they waited!

Meanwhile, the auras of the 5 Alpha Strata LEGENDS shone brightly as they focused on the pulsing Domain Rift- reading as much destiny and Fate as they could from this unknown land as even they...had no idea what would be occurring within it.
Deaths and conflicts within the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum would remain in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum as nobody would be persecuted once they were out.
This rule of engagement...was something to be remembered as it weighed heavily on the minds of many!
A profound spatial storm unlike anything he had felt before.

Different from entering any Realm or Reality and different from anything else Noah had experienced- this was what it felt when he entered the massive Domain Rift leading into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum!

The very surroundings also twisted and changed as Noah felt a shockingly oppressive and restrictive force wrap around him, his luminous eyes lighting the way forward as he gradually felt the path clearing up.
BZZT!
A surge of silver and gold flashed as after a few moments in the spatial tunnel, he appeared within the Grotto Sanctum.

The first thing he ascertained was how the oppressive and restrictive force..became all the more powerful as while his body appeared in what seemed like the skies- a downward force was pushing down on him that wanted to force him to the ground!
His elevated body with pristine Foundations flashed with fervor, but even this wasn't enough to stop the terrifying gravitational force surging around Noah as it seemed undeniable.
Only when...
WAA!
The aura of TABOO erupted around Noah.
He stabilized in the skies and no longer fell as he gazed around him, this bringing about the second point that was entirely different about this Grotto Sanctum!
He...could not spread his will out for more than 5 meters around his body as he had to gaze at everything with his own eyes!
And the scene before his eyes...
"Holy..."

The figures of Empress Genevieve, Royal Human Adjudicator Legions, and Katelyn were nowhere to be seen as their entrance into the Grotto Sanctum seemed to have teleported everyone to random locations.

Noah had appeared in the skies as around him, liquified rivers of essence flowed pristinely along with sparkling red and blue crystals that dotted the skies and swirled with a mystifying brilliance- being even denser than his Infinite Reality!

The earth below him had vibrant red sand and two enormous mountainous valleys that stretched in the distance, a stellar river of Reality flowing pristinely down the valleys of the two mountains as multicolored trees stretched up to the skies holding swirling crystals and liquified essence.

Noah could feel shockingly dense reserves of all types of essence here, even wisps of the Essence of Reality being seen floating between the multicolored vegetation that littered the paradisiacal mountains as this wasn't the most shocking thing!

After being restricted to where he could only see with his sight and not his will, Noah's gaze turned around the skies to see the spatial warping of the Primordials from the 5 Pure-Blooded Bloodlines as he witnessed a shocking scene.
A Royal Human appeared in the skies as like him, the faced a terrifying gravitational force downwards as his body lit up magnificently.
But...
"What?!"
He was still pressed down as his figure smashed onto the red earth below, breaking the tout branches of the tall trees on his way down as this Ninth Firmament existence was cast down to earth!

He wasn't the only one as Noah's eyes captured many more beings already oppressively pressed down onto the ground and unable to fly up, the visage of a Dragon Phoenix with glimmering pairs of wings that surged with purple flames roaring out in the ground as even after flapping its wings, it couldn't rise.
ROAAR!
pA Reality Ursidae roared out in disbelief as it jumped across the dense vegetation, but it was always pressed back down as it also couldn't take flight!

A stellar Willow Tree took root on the ref earth and resonated with it after it was also cast down- a majority of the beings that entered this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum actually being cast down from the skies and not being able to fly as the restrictive force was too domineering.

"The Natural Laws of Reality..."
WAA!

There was a type of Natural Law- or multiple of them, that were so present in this domain that others could not deny them! The only thing that could possibly do it and was what kept Noah in the skies at this moment...was the aura of TABOO!

Noah wasn't the only one as within the few mile region that his eyes could see, the figures of other distinguished beings in the skies could be seen floating majestically as they were all at least adorned with Solidified Crowns- each one having attained a TABOO Edict as they were geniuses upon geniuses!

Three flaming tails stretched out behind it as they shone with ecstatic beauty and danger, Purple gold flames constantly surging over its scales as it carried a unique sense of power and beauty.

A crown with the letters <EM> swirled above the Dragon Phoenix as its eyes and the eyes of many of the geniuses in the skies were currently locked towards Noah's direction.

Noah, who was currently wearing sleek bbsidian pants and a loose shirt to match it that wrapped around his robust muscles, the one wing behind his back released a pulsing golden light every now and then as above his head, one still couldn't see a crown!
This...was why the genius beings in the skies were gazing towards him.

All those who could remain in the vibrant skies were those who had achieved TABOO...so these geniuses very quickly grasped that this being must be hiding his authority or had unique means to be able to remain in the skies!
BZZT!
The wings of the Dragon Phoenix flapped as he turned into a flaming meteor to near Noah's location.
The eyes of this regal existence gazed at Noah's laid back demeanor as it spoke vibrantly.

"You must have a decent destiny for you to have attained a treasure capable of hiding your authority. You should be over and above a few others in here...so how about you follow me in this Grotto Sanctum?"
WAA!

BZZT!

chapters.title: Chapter 1793
paragraphs: After the appearance of the Dragon Phoenix, the three Royal Humans, Reality Ursidae, and the Willow Trees that were around it also floated over as each of them had solidified crowns alone with nothing else!
They stood on the side of the Dragon Phoenix as one of the Royal Humans looked at Noah while nodding.
"You must be from the Pure-Blooded Domains of the Royal Humans outside of the Pure Reality and thus do not know us. This..."

While pointing to the vibrant Dragon Phoenix that seemed to be the strongest among those teleported in this region of vibrant skies and red earth, the Royal Human continued as his words held a hint of a commanding tone while talking to Noah who should be from outside the main Reality!

"....is the Scion from the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage from the Main Reality. It seems conflicts are inevitable after the Rules of Engagement, so we must stick together and move carefully. What is your name? What Domains are you from?"
A tone of someone of much higher standing stemmed out from this Royal Human as he talked to the Unnamed Kainos Emperor!
Noah couldn't help but have a smile rise up on his face as he spoke lightly.
"Alexander King. I just recently underwent the Bloodline Baptism as a follower of Empress Genevieve."
Noah spoke freely as he did this for a reason- one of those being to establish the identity of Alexander King among Primordials!

"Genevieve...ah, a follower of one of the candidates to oversee become a Bloodline Master." The faces of the Royal Humans and others became even more laid back when they knew Noah's background, their tones becoming even more prideful and domineering even though they knew this being had a treasure that could hide his authority.
"Follow our lead under Emperor Andur of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage, we will scour this domain and divide a percentage of the treasures to those who contribute the most."
The prideful Royal Human from the Main Reality spoke commandingly now without any pretenses as their authority far superseded any follower outside of the Main Reality!
Noah's smile only became deeper and his eyes began to shine with a devilish glint, his tyrannical will about to surge out when...
HOOONG!
An incandescent light shone below them on the red earth.

Besides the stellar river and towards the ascending mountainous valleys, the red earth split open as a shocking burst of essence bloomed, a dense multicolored crystal mountain being unearthed by a Willow Tree that had accidentally taken root in this region!
"Oh?"
"Peak Tier Soul Crystals!"
The eyes of those on the ground and those in the skies shone as they recognized the dense aura of the crystalline mountain that rose up to be...Peak Tier Soul Crystals!
"Wait...no, not Peak Tier!"
Shouts began to rise from this region as the particularly perceptive Dragon Phoenix Andur spoke while quickly flying above the rising mountain.
"The Essence of Reality is contained deep within these Crystals...they are the Supreme Tier Soul Crystals that could aid one in exceeding their Limits in the Soul!"
BZZZT!
A whole mountain of Supreme Soul Crystals!
This was the first thing that appeared before their eyes as the souls of any beings nearby felt nourished and shocked, wanting to get their hands on this as soon as possible!
But...
"Halt!"
The will of Emperor Andur stretched out to the beings below who had begun to move towards this crystalline mountain with fervor.

A TABOO authority was carried within his voice as it caused others to stop moving out of caution and gaze above, the majestic visage of the Purple and gold Dragon Phoenix stopping everyone in their tracks as his three flaming tails shone dangerously.
While gazing at those moving on the mountainous red earth and the few geniuses in the skies, this being made his will known.

"This Core Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage of the Main Reality shall claim this Supreme Tier Soul Crystal Mountain. Those who choose to follow me will get a share of things like this as we explore this Grotto Sanctum!"
WAA!

He let his terrifying identity be known as those on the ground who hadn't even formed their TABOO Edicts stopped dishearteningly while gazing at the mystical mountain of Soul Crystals, sighing in their hearts as they knew the identity of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage.

A Lineage within the Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodline of the Dragon Phoenixes within the Main Reality, their leaders being existences that had exceeded the Alpha Strata and had many among their ranks standing on the Primordial Assembly!
Aside from the Pure power of this Andur who was a Core Scion of this Bloodline, his identity alone was enough for none of them to move against him.

Even the few lone geniuses in the skies in the skies who had forged their TABOO authority looked on carefully as they analyzed the risks and rewards, with none of them moving even though their Souls hungrily wanted the Supreme Soul Crystals below them that formed into an enormous mountain!
The visage of Andur shone brightly as he nodded, with the Royal Human from the Main Reality that had been talking to Noah turning to where he should have been floating.
"You see, this is what will happen while moving under Emperor Andur- you...what are you doing?"
, m The words of the Royal Human came to a stop as he saw Noah ignoring his words and calmly floating towards the crystalline mountain!

The auras of many beings caught this and focused on him, the Dragon Phoenix Andur having its eyes release a shocking brilliance and pressure as coldness permeated within them while speaking out domineeringly.
"What are you doing?"
WAA!
Battle intent rose as the glorious body of this Dragon Phoenix began to shine with the illusion of Ascendancy Halos.
Yet the being he talked to didn't even turn around as he replied.
"This Mountain of Supreme Tier Soul Crystals...I want it."
Calm and laid back.

His loose Obsidian pants and shirt tightly hugged his muscles as his visage became imprinted in the eyes of all beings nearby, most of them understanding that this being seemed to be going against the authority of a Dragon Phoenix that not only stemmed from a terrifying background, but had a solidified crown with a few ecritures on it already!
BZZZT!
Arcs of flames and power began to coil around Andur as the surroundings became heavy.
His voice didn't even echo out again as it was the handsome Royal Human from the Main Reality adorned in red robes who had been speaking to Noah all this time berated out.
"You fool, you actually dare to go against the will of existences from the Main Reality? Especially Emperor Andur? You shall be stripped of our Bloodline when you leave her-"
"Shut up."
OOM!
Floating over the crystalline mountain, Noah finally turned around as his face carried a trace of coldness and tyranny when gazing towards the party of Andur and others from the Main Reality!
The one who was speaking unconsciously stopped from the aura released as he felt if he didn't, something untold would have happened!
Shock and disbelief covered the face of the genius Royal Human that had managed to achieve a TABOO Edict, watching as Noah continued on.
"You consider yourself an Emperor when you bend down and lick the ass of another so easily? Characters like you shouldn't speak so much and need to stay on the side!"
WAA!
The hair atop Noah's head swirled as it began to take on a myriad of colors, waving madly and with a unique sense of power as he actually...admonished those from the Main Reality!

"And you all seem to be forgetting the Rules of Engagement that were just laid out. Any deaths and conflicts in this Grotto Sanctum...shall remain here as we all shall fight to obtain the treasures we want."
"I wish to attain this Supreme Tier Soul Crystal Mountain below me. If you all want to fight me for it, do so. Just know...death is a very real possibility."
HOOONG!
An unyielding and tyrannical will began to weave out.

There was only silence in this region as battle intent began to heavily rise, the eyes of the powerful beings around Emperor Andur contracting as the Core Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage himself....
BOOM!
Erupted with 30 glorious Ascendancy Halos as 60 Reality Passages unfurled behind him.
"You seem to be grossly overestimating yourself...little thing."

A voice filled with power and brutality echoed out from the Dragon Phoenix as surging purple and gold flames overtook the skies, pushing away all others in this region as even those below on the red earth moved back just from the temperature of these Flames!
"Unknown Emperors who hide their authority are nothing but cowards. You...are just one among many."

Filled with brutality and viciousness, the regal Dragon Phoenix expanded its wings as its raging might pushed even its entourage away, the aura of TABOO covering the skies above the multicolored crystalline mountain as only this existence and the visage of Noah remained above this region!
One was a majestic Dragon Phoenix with a solidified crown and three words rotating around it, and the other was a Royal Human who could hide his authority.
The former showed his unbound power and tyranny as a Black Ascendancy Halo toppled 29 others, 60 vibrant Reality Passages shining behind him as the Royal Human known as Alexander King...

His hair color stopped its flashing of multiple colors as it settled on black, pulsing madly with a unique power as he...actually placed his hands behind his back and gazed towards the Dragon Phoenix with a unique expression.

The geniuses and Legend's Visage from Adjudicator Legions and Will Bearers below saw this expression as it caused their minds to buzz...because it very much seemed like the gaze that a grown being would show when they were looking at a newly born child!

His eyes carried a magnetic force of power and devilishness as he showed utmost calm while speaking out, a thin imperceptible Innate Barrier covering his very skin as he floated calmly amidst a spoon to explode storm!

chapters.title: Chapter 1794
paragraphs: The output of power and the damage one could deal in the Firmaments of Ascendancy was unique.

With their own bodies alone, terrifying geniuses could be capable of releasing a force equivalent to the destruction of tens or hundreds of Realities based on the strength of their Aspects of Existence- but more the strength of their bodies!

When they went further to incorporate their Ascendancy Halos, their damage would attain a multiplicative effect as it could reach the hundreds of thousands or even possibly exceed 5 Million Damage Values for the beings who had more than likely exceeded a Limit or two in their Aspects of Existence.

Once could passively use the authority of their Halos as their illusory rings of light would barely be seen, or they could call them out fully and fuse with their Halos to achieve their ultimate state. And when they incorporate the boon of their Reality Passages...they became even more terrifying!
In a battle between powerful geniuses, things could change in an instant as those who were smart moved with care.
This was why Emperor Andur called out his Ascendancy Halos and Reality Passages even though he believed this existence hiding his authority to not be much!
He wanted to be prepared in case the existence who actually dared to ignore his identity and power turned out to be more than expected.
Yet his enemy...
"You still haven't called out your Halos and Passages? Have you succumbed to fear after all that bravery?"
WAA!

Purple and Gold Flames permeated all around as the geniuses from the Main Reality watched on carefully, these Flames stemming from Andur nearly forming into shapes as it seemed like the prerequisite for REIFICATION!
Those who couldn't even fly as they hadn't forged a TABOO concept watched from below as the vast majority were stemming from Adjudicator Legions or Will Bearers.
What did this hidden Emperor have to dare and go against a Core Scion of a Lineage from the Main Reality?

Each of the 5 Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines in the Main Reality were ruled by Lineage Factions and groups within their Bloodlines- these Lineages stemming from the Founding Primordials since the time OPPENHEIMER took reign!
Each of the 5 Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines had three or four powerful Lineages reigning supreme as Andur stemmed from one of the three Lineages within the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline.
Known for their power and might among the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines- these creatures were especially feared when they took on their True Forms by fusing with their Halos!
Yet towards the words of Emperor Andur who was shining with brilliance and power at this moment, the visage of Alexander spoke out calmly with his arms still behind his back.
"I do not need to call out my Halos for a thing like you."
His now dark hair waved calmly in the skies that were turned purple and gold, his voice continuing to resound out in a domineering fashion!
"You've made many mistakes here today, but the biggest one is that before me...you didn't take your True Form instantly."
WAA!
Words that caused Andur's purple gold flaming eyes to constrict erupted as his Halos buzzed!
But not before the Unnamed Kainos Emperor spoke a single word that was accompanied by an illusory flashing black halo around his body.
"Kneel."

Emperor's Haki erupted out as it was cast by the authority of a single Halo that merely granted a 100x multiplier, and the damage was directed solely towards the Dragon Phoenix before Noah's eyes alone!
BOOOM!
Sound traveled too fast as the word carried forth by Emperor's Haki smashed onto the visage of the Core Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage instantly.
Those watching in the surroundings felt their hearts lurch as a shocking scene unfolded!

The single word Noah had uttered out backed with the authority of one Halo didn't just deal True Reality Damage Values...but it dealt True Dimensional Dream Damage Values that only those with Dimensional Physique could understand.

The effect of this alone was frightening as with Noah's base 2850+ Damage Values multiplied by 100...the figure of the glorious Dragon Phoenix shuddered as its eardrums instantly burst into nothingness!
Its soul trembled in pain as this being actually hadn't imposed any layers of Shields on himself yet, facing Noah's attack bare as it was only due to his TABOO authority that he didn't perish.
But this wasn't all.
The majestic expression of this genius Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix became utterly dark as his bright Halos began to dim.
The Reality Passages above him also did the same as even his Three Aspects of Existence seemingly began slumbering towards sleep!
The effects of True Dimensional Dream Damage showed themselves as letting even a single Dimensional Damage Value was enough to start affecting an existence.
Andur had taken tens of thousands as even his soul seemed ready to fall into a slumber!
Yet...
"ROAAR!"
He was still a genius existence that had forged a TABOO Edict before forming his Reality.
The authority of TABOO began to rise up within him to try and rouse his Halos and Reality Passages, his Halos especially buzzing with fervor as they slowly surged towards him to fuse into his body!
His 60 Reality Passages surged to provide him with essence ever do slowly as he was close to achieving this goal.
If he could do this, he could show off the unmatched True Form of a Dragon Phoenix! He would actually be able to display his true power and not be suppressed so easily like this!
Buy alas...
"I said Kneel."
HUUUM!
Noah's True Sanguine Clone spoke out once more as his dark hair waved madly in the wind.
He didn't even cast an ability at this moment as in the skies above everyone still trembled!
THUCK!
A sound as if the sky was being squeezed emanated out as above everyone, a single mountainous Reality Passage appeared as it shone with stellar radiance.

It pressed down with immense fervor as the 60 Reality Passages surging and trying to provide Andur with essence trembled before becoming utterly dim, seeming like small river streams of essence when compared to the massive mountainous Passage that imposed itself on the skies!

sentences.text: The output of power and the damage one could deal in the Firmaments of Ascendancy was unique.

With their own bodies alone, terrifying geniuses could be capable of releasing a force equivalent to the destruction of tens or hundreds of Realities based on the strength of their Aspects of Existence- but more the strength of their bodies!

When they went further to incorporate their Ascendancy Halos, their damage would attain a multiplicative effect as it could reach the hundreds of thousands or even possibly exceed 5 Million Damage Values for the beings who had more than likely exceeded a Limit or two in their Aspects of Existence.

Once could passively use the authority of their Halos as their illusory rings of light would barely be seen, or they could call them out fully and fuse with their Halos to achieve their ultimate state.
And when they incorporate the boon of their Reality Passages...they became even more terrifying!
In a battle between powerful geniuses, things could change in an instant as those who were smart moved with care.
This was why Emperor Andur called out his Ascendancy Halos and Reality Passages even though he believed this existence hiding his authority to not be much!
He wanted to be prepared in case the existence who actually dared to ignore his identity and power turned out to be more than expected.
Yet his enemy...
"You still haven't called out your Halos and Passages?
Have you succumbed to fear after all that bravery?"
WAA!

Purple and Gold Flames permeated all around as the geniuses from the Main Reality watched on carefully, these Flames stemming from Andur nearly forming into shapes as it seemed like the prerequisite for REIFICATION!
Those who couldn't even fly as they hadn't forged a TABOO concept watched from below as the vast majority were stemming from Adjudicator Legions or Will Bearers.
What did this hidden Emperor have to dare and go against a Core Scion of a Lineage from the Main Reality?

Each of the 5 Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines in the Main Reality were ruled by Lineage Factions and groups within their Bloodlines- these Lineages stemming from the Founding Primordials since the time OPPENHEIMER took reign!
Each of the 5 Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines had three or four powerful Lineages reigning supreme as Andur stemmed from one of the three Lineages within the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline.
Known for their power and might among the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines- these creatures were especially feared when they took on their True Forms by fusing with their Halos!
Yet towards the words of Emperor Andur who was shining with brilliance and power at this moment, the visage of Alexander spoke out calmly with his arms still behind his back.
"I do not need to call out my Halos for a thing like you."
His now dark hair waved calmly in the skies that were turned purple and gold, his voice continuing to resound out in a domineering fashion!
"You've made many mistakes here today, but the biggest one is that before me...you didn't take your True Form instantly."
WAA!
Words that caused Andur's purple gold flaming eyes to constrict erupted as his Halos buzzed!
But not before the Unnamed Kainos Emperor spoke a single word that was accompanied by an illusory flashing black halo around his body.
"Kneel."

Emperor's Haki erupted out as it was cast by the authority of a single Halo that merely granted a 100x multiplier, and the damage was directed solely towards the Dragon Phoenix before Noah's eyes alone!
BOOOM!
Sound traveled too fast as the word carried forth by Emperor's Haki smashed onto the visage of the Core Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage instantly.
Those watching in the surroundings felt their hearts lurch as a shocking scene unfolded!

The single word Noah had uttered out backed with the authority of one Halo didn't just deal True Reality Damage Values...but it dealt True Dimensional Dream Damage Values that only those with Dimensional Physique could understand.

The effect of this alone was frightening as with Noah's base 2850+ Damage Values multiplied by 100...the figure of the glorious Dragon Phoenix shuddered as its eardrums instantly burst into nothingness!
Its soul trembled in pain as this being actually hadn't imposed any layers of Shields on himself yet, facing Noah's attack bare as it was only due to his TABOO authority that he didn't perish.
But this wasn't all.
The majestic expression of this genius Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix became utterly dark as his bright Halos began to dim.
The Reality Passages above him also did the same as even his Three Aspects of Existence seemingly began slumbering towards sleep!
The effects of True Dimensional Dream Damage showed themselves as letting even a single Dimensional Damage Value was enough to start affecting an existence.
Andur had taken tens of thousands as even his soul seemed ready to fall into a slumber!
Yet...
"ROAAR!"
He was still a genius existence that had forged a TABOO Edict before forming his Reality.
The authority of TABOO began to rise up within him to try and rouse his Halos and Reality Passages, his Halos especially buzzing with fervor as they slowly surged towards him to fuse into his body!
His 60 Reality Passages surged to provide him with essence ever do slowly as he was close to achieving this goal.

Buy alas...

THUCK!

chapters.title: Chapter 1795
paragraphs: Even the Emperors in the nearby skies felt their bodies enveloped by an oppressive tightness as the one to bear the oppression of this single Reality Passage that glimmered purple, blue, gold, red...felt a horrific weight pressing down.

Andur watched on in disbelief as this weight imposed on him did far more disastrous things, turning his Reality Passages dim and docile an instant later. Even the Essence within his body seemed to stop circulating as his visage became utterly still!

The mind of this genius existence buzzed as Reality finally dawned, feeling every concept and function he had going towards slumber that he couldn't prevent anymore- and he felt like he might never wake up from this slumber if he didn't fight it now.
So he could only struggle to voice out his words as if his power failed...his identity at least should do something!
"I...am a Core Scion of the-"
BZZT!
"You've already said this."

The visage of Noah appeared near the enormous draconic head of this Dragon Phoenix as the raging flames didn't even bother him one bit, his hand coming to land on its crystalline scales as he spoke silently.
"Ascendant Multilayered Possession."
The mind of this terrifying genius buzzed in horror within its last moments of consciousness as before it slumbered, a few thoughts rose in its mind.
'I've forged a TABOO Edict...I'm a talented existence who stands a chance fighting for the seat of the True Emperor...'
The glory he had imagined for the future faded in disbelief and horror as not just his concepts, but everything about him slumbered as his body in the air turned utterly still.
The powerful Emperors in the skies watched on with alarm as many of them were still staring at the newly appearing massive Reality Passage that gave off a tyrannical light.
"What the hell is that!"
Those below shouted in alarm as it didn't look anything like the Passages they knew of, and it was frankly too big!
Many more wanted to open their mouths and express their disbelief, but they felt a sense of restraining fear as most didn't even speak.
This came from fear of the unknown- something they saw first hand to bring a downfall of a powerful genius with a shocking identity!

They didn't want to provoke such a being as especially those who hadn't even reached A Legend's Visage...they began to move away from this place entirely without looking back, seeing if they could locate opportunities elsewhere.

pBut Noah paid no heed to this as after casting Ascendant Multilayered Possession onto this genius existence who wasn't even able to show his True power- boundless memories that carried on for millions of years began to surge into his mind.
Memories of the Primordials.
Memories of the ways of the Main Reality and a clearer picture of the 5 Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines that reigned within it, and the many Grotto Sanctums under their control!
Grotto Sanctums....that looked nothing like the one he and many others were currently in as none of them had restrictions as heavy as thus Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.
Noah learned this and many things, along with the concepts of this existence as from them...
<You have extracted the TABOO Concept of The Flameborn.>
<You have extracted the Quasi-TABOO Concept of The Golden Phoenix, the Dragonian...>
His Soul buzzed as it ridiculously took in a TABOO concept in just a few minutes since his entrance into this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum!
While bathed in taking in new concepts and memories, Noah patted the gloriously shining scales of this Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage as he spoke out shocking words.
"Miniaturize."
HUUUM!

A surge of gold and purple light wrapped around the blankly staring Dragon Phoenix as it rapidly became small in size, becoming the size of a fingernail as Noah didn't plan to crush this enemy's soul just yet!
This was because he was waiting for a certain Edict geared towards Loot to become TABOO so that he couldn't enjoy the greatest benefits!
These were his thoughts, but then there was what others saw.

The Pure-Blooded Royal Humans from the Main Reality that were speaking to him earlier and even the hundreds of Primordials from Adjudicator Legions and Will Bearers below saw in their perspectives an existence merely placing his hands and speaking commandingly towards a Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage, appearing before this distinguished being and seemingly taking control of its faculties as thereafter...

He caused the glorious figure of this Dragon Phoenix to miniaturize as his fingers released a tout string of mana that wrapped around the scales of this existence, this string going forward to be tied beside his waist as he seemed to have been treating the body of this creature as a boon for him to carry!
Alarm rose in the eyes of all those in the surroundings.
The few who had forged TABOO Edicts in the skies backed away extremely quickly as those below didn't even utter a word!

Nobody fought for the mountain of Supreme Tier Soul Crystals as when they gazed at the being who laid claim to it, they only saw a terrifying existence that could incapacitate an Emperor with a solidified crown and a few Ecritures with the mention of a few words.
It wasn't someone for them to compete against as the words of the Alpha Strata LEGENDS rang out within their minds.
"Any deaths and conflicts that occur within this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum will begin and end there..."
If they didn't have sufficient power, their identities might not be enough to hinder beings as crazy as this as many more beings began to move away from this location quietly!

Among those leaving silently, the figure of a Royal Human that had been with Andur was among them as while he tied a living genius existence with a string of man's to his waist, Noah spoke out once again.
"Don't think I've forgotten about you."
WAA!

His word alone caused the hearts of many beings to leap as there was one being who had berated Noah before who felt the terrifying pressure of the massive Infinite Reality Passages from above relocate on his body!

The Royal Human Emperor with a solidified crown felt his heart beat faster as he was moving silently without leaving behind any fluctuations, but he instantly turned into a blazing sun to run the opposite direction.
"HUK!"

Yet like a speeding train that had just begun to blast off, he faced an insurmountable wall as the visage of Noah that should have been a distance away had somehow appeared right in front of the path he was taking and reached out a ridiculously stable hand that now clutched his neck!
A shocking level of speed that as an existence who was a Triple Limit Breaker...it was something simple for Noah.

His hair spun wildly with power as he shook his head while gazing at the Royal Human currently struggling on his arms, his True Dimensional Dream Damage surging into the body of this being and deactivating his chances of even calling out his Halos or Skills- Noah's head shaking with a smile of amazement the whole time!
"It still amazes me that your first course of action wasn't to take on your True Form...<Ascendant Multilayered Possession>."
HOONG!

A glorious light flashed, the body in Noah's hands trembling before it became limp- surging with light an instant later as it miniaturized and was wrapped by a string of mana that was tied to Noah's waist.
SHAA!

Flashes of light occurred in the surroundings as those on the stellar red earth below and those on the stellar skies now bathed by the light of a single Reality Passage scattered rapidly, the branches of Willow Trees stretching over the horizons as they moved away the fastest!

chapters.title: Chapter 1796
paragraphs: After a terrifying show of might from an existence they didn't understand too well, most of the nearby powerful beings scattered as they didn't want their journey that had just begun to end so quickly.

Only a few scattered Royal Humans remained as they saw the terrifying being above to share their Bloodline, and didn't think he would randomly target them as the only beings he had gone against were those who went against him!
Noah didn't even get a chance to say 'anybody else?' as the most powerful beings scattered, a smile becoming etched on his face as he flew towards the mountain of Supreme Soul Crystals.
His image was branded onto the minds of those in the surroundings as a single-winged devilish royal human with dark hair that vibrated with power was bound to be known by many very soon!

He released just a glimpse of his tyranny as he didn't start an all round massacre, and this was because among the many goals that this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum would help him accomplish- establishing the might of Alexander King was one of them.

Not as an indiscriminate fiend that massacred all of the Pure-Blooded Primordial Bloodlines he came across, as even with the 'Rules of Engagement' set up- the fate of his Clone would not be that bright once he left this unique Domain!
No.

What he wanted was to enact the rise of a Royal Human who competed for fortune and authority like all other exceptional Chosen Emperors, coming out of this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum not just with boundless Loot and TABOO Edicts, but a ticket towards the upper echelons of Primordials in the Main Reality.

He wanted those that had seen his actions just now to spread the word when they met up with others, rumors of him taking down distinguished beings from the Main Reality being allowed to spread as thereafter...even more powerful Emperors would come knocking on his doorstep!
'Let your pride and arrogance bring you to me...the more the merrier!'
WAA!
Loot. After everything passed, all he did was stick to the path of what would bring him the most loot.
The TABOO Edicts to come would just be a glorious cherry on top!
'Speaking of TABOO Edicts...'
His eyes gazed at the Prompts he had withheld as he went to collect the Supreme Soul Crystal Mountain.
<You have extracted the TABOO Concept of the Defiler.>
<You have extracted the Quasi-TABOO Concepts of...>

A smile of happiness was etched on his face as he went through the newly attained concepts, feeling a little disheartened inside that he didn't obtain Seeds of TABOO that he could apply to his own Edicts.
This was because as always, the quality of the Edicts of other beings...was just too abysmal compared to his own.

And the Authority of his Black Tier Ascendancy Halos only allowed him to transfer the ranks of Quasi-TABOO Nomological Edicts from one to another, where he had not attained the authority to do this freely with TABOO Edicts!
But this was where the task of his main body came.

Noah's will grasped onto the glimmering mountain below that might be of use to him even though his three Aspects of Existence had seemingly reached an unscalable plateau unless he formed his Reality, but it should be a great thing to boost the power of his people and possibly birth some Limit Breakers.
And after multiplying the enormous mountain that was causing the stellar red earth to crack and rise as Noah lifted it up...the resultant Supreme Tier Soul Crystals were bound to be abundant.
This would be just one of the ways that Noah would utilize to elevate the strength of those around him, with a few more ideas able to be put into play when he gained more Seeds of TABOO.

But right now, he had to remain focused on himself as in the Cosmic Holy Land, his Main Body closed his eyes to undergo the Third Infinite Dream after finding no more ways to exceed his Aspects of Existence- and seeing that the skills within the Infinite Reality Passages that were undergoing REIFICATION were still not ready.

Shifting our attention from the glimpse of the wonders of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, the spotlight shone on Noah's main body once more as his vibrant soul divided into many portions for the Third Infinite Dream.
Not a hundred or a thousand portions of souls but...his Primogenial Strata Soul shone with an incandescent light as it released over 10,000 Portions of his Soul with the waves of Dream Essence!

As he utilized the ever present veils between Dimensions and Reality to impose his will on far away Realities- this process being even faster with his intimate connection with the Dream Dimension after gaining the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique.

Apart from the Infinite Dream occurring at a much faster rate, the chances for Noah to enter Prime Realities and even more unique Realities like the one that had led him to the news of Commander Feng increased.
"Permeate out and bring me back boundless destiny..."

His slumbering voice commanded the portion of souls spreading out as the Cosmic Holy Land gained a level of calmness, leaving behind the few true Sanguine Clones that were currently focused on pulling in wisps of the Natural Laws of Reality to forge another Seed of TABOO as Noah had to depend on his own concepts if he wanted to increase his power greatly.

An example was the fact that he had just attained two more TABOO concepts from two enemies within the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, but they hadn't really elevated his power to a great degree as much as they just granted new ways of attacking...but their results weren't that significant!
The only thing that caused him appreciation was the concept of the TABOO Edict of the Flameborn from the Dragon Phoenix genius.

The TABOO Edict of the Defiler was simply an attack based Edict that utilized an essence of poison and death- its abilities holding abysmal damage Values as its Flames even granted a mere Ultra Rare Bloodline!
But the TABOO Concept of The Flameborn had some applications that even though it didn't majorly raise his power, it was applicable to a certain area he liked to focus on.

This Edict held the TABOO Authority to grant different qualities to the flame abilities one used- being able to grant a TABOO authority and change normal flames into <Thunderous Flames>,<Poison Flames>, <Spatial Flames>, <Sacred Flames>, <Hell Flames>, <Life Flames>, <Death Flames>, <Nuclear Flames>, <Ionizing Flames>...and so on!

The different types of flames each had their own qualities as they introduced more versatility to none other than Noah's [Fireball]...which should be able to show interesting changes after it had undergone REIFICATION.

Flameborn also granted a Supreme Bloodline as the talent of the Dragon Phoenix genius was not little- giving Noah the Flameborn Emperor Bloodline that was merely an extension of the concept onto a Bloodline that had great resistance to the aspect of flames, as well as being capable of dealing more damage with flames!

Something terrific that Noah had to also keep in mind apart from the current boons he had received from these beings was that even now, their solidified crowns still shone brightly above the miniaturized bodies that were hanging by the waist of his Clone.
One's authority...would not fade until their death- or something very similar to it.

So there was this to look forward to, as well as the boons of Loot under a newly elevated Resplendent Treasure Emperor after this Third Infinite Dream that Noah would make sure to be completed even faster than the previous two!

An example was the fact that he had just attained two more TABOO concepts from two enemies within the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, but they hadn't really elevated his power to a great degree as much as they just granted new ways of attacking...but their results weren't that significant!
The only thing that caused him appreciation was the concept of the TABOO Edict of the Flameborn from the Dragon Phoenix genius.

The TABOO Edict of the Defiler was simply an attack based Edict that utilized an essence of poison and death- its abilities holding abysmal damage Values as its Flames even granted a mere Ultra Rare Bloodline!
But the TABOO Concept of The Flameborn had some applications that even though it didn't majorly raise his power, it was applicable to a certain area he liked to focus on.

This Edict held the TABOO Authority to grant different qualities to the flame abilities one used- being able to grant a TABOO authority and change normal flames into <Thunderous Flames>,<Poison Flames>, <Spatial Flames>, <Sacred Flames>, <Hell Flames>, <Life Flames>, <Death Flames>, <Nuclear Flames>, <Ionizing Flames>...and so on!

The different types of flames each had their own qualities as they introduced more versatility to none other than Noah's [Fireball]...which should be able to show interesting changes after it had undergone REIFICATION.

Flameborn also granted a Supreme Bloodline as the talent of the Dragon Phoenix genius was not little- giving Noah the Flameborn Emperor Bloodline that was merely an extension of the concept onto a Bloodline that had great resistance to the aspect of flames, as well as being capable of dealing more damage with flames!

Something terrific that Noah had to also keep in mind apart from the current boons he had received from these beings was that even now, their solidified crowns still shone brightly above the miniaturized bodies that were hanging by the waist of his Clone.
One's authority...would not fade until their death- or something very similar to it.

So there was this to look forward to, as well as the boons of Loot under a newly elevated Resplendent Treasure Emperor after this Third Infinite Dream that Noah would make sure to be completed even faster than the previous two!

chapters.title: Chapter 1797
paragraphs: Noah's journey was unique as it didn't involve a single path that he followed, with a part of Noah's will being in the Infinite Reality, another in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, another in the Mirror and Dream Dimensions...and now thousands of his wills were spreading out towards Emerging, Prime, and many other Realities.

The vast Realities he was in also included countless beings that moved to the weaving of their own destinies as things didn't come to a halt in the outside Realities just became Noah wasn't involved in them!
In a region of the Boundary Between Realities close to the borders of Cardinal Royal Primordial Bloodlines.

Little Henry sat above the enormous figure of the Blight Serpent Dragon whose life had dimmed, this enormous creature actually being one of the Emperors of the Blight Serpent Dragon Bloodline and was actually the partner of none other than Belladonna!

Little Henry's gaze was cold and filled with coiling lights as around him, the myriad of figures of the forces from the Infinite Reality could be seen along with the majestic visage of a Draconic Elephantine Beast, rivers of golden blood surging around this space as the limbs of countless creatures and Primordial Beasts lay strewn everywhere.
The cute expression of Little Henry was a stark contrast to all this as he now seemed just a bit over 10, his eyes locking onto one of the only remaining enemies that was kept alive this whole time.
"Any more beings that will rush to save you, Matriarch? Any other Blight Serpent Dragon Emperors you can notify?"
WAA!
Yes!

Little Henry, Overseer Natalya Rostova, Emperor Penguin...and the singular party of Hyperion had long since eradicated the Legions of Primordial Beasts and their allied Blight Serpent Dragons who were clashing with Legions of the Golden Dwarf Race that had its Legions communicating with Anna and Athena a distance away.

Eradicating the Primordial Beast and Serpent Dragon Legions was easy with the ridiculous number of power and Reality Passages and the means of the 10 year old leading Commander, but Little Henry had actually not eradicated everyone all at once as learning from his father's adventures, he allowed Belladonna to call for as much back up as possible as multiple more Legions of Blight Serpent Dragons had arrived here, along with this last one that included one of their Emperors that was also eradicated!

"Devil spawn..." The eyes of Belladonna trembled with utter fear as she saw the downfall of all those she called for rescue, the means of this young existence being utterly devilish in her eyes as she couldn't help but screech.
"Devil spawn! I should have killed your father when I had the cha- GAH!"
SHIING!

An enormous Serpent Dragon head flew as a terrifying bloody red spinning disc was summoned by Little Hyperion, ending the life of an existence that had lived millions of years compared to the few days of life he had!
His black and blue hair flowed serenely as he shook his head and turned towards the visage of Hyperion.
"There was no remaining Karma to collect. But I sense that there is a lot on your side, Uncle Hyperion."

The terrifying Draconic Elephantine Beast looked at this child with a blank expression as Little Henry kept his politeness since he was talking to a being that could be considered his father's friend, but Hyperion himself felt a disconnect with how powerful this little child was as he couldn't help but sigh!

"Yes, I've located traces of the Legions of the Primordial Beasts and how they plan to distribute them across the Realities to continue expanding on the Chaos. They...seem to be seeking to raise as much chaos as possible at the start of this new Age- or so the memories of some of these Ninth Firmament Enders say."
Hyperion developed a stern expression as his elephantine tusks released a vibrant glimmer of light.

"A belief has begun to spread across the upper echelons of the Primordial Beasts that if the Main Reality is not returned to how it was during this First Age of the Kainos Era...it will be nearly impossible to achieve it in the coming Ages as they will do everything in their power to achieve their aims in this era..."
RAA!

A cry from a nearby Penguin bathed in gold came as he inserted himself with a boisterous voice, a blue Slime currently situated above its head and wiggling happily after devouring many Primordial Beasts in this venture.
"Let's chase them all down, Little Master! We can solve at least one of the Mysteries and help Master gather information on this side."

A glint of battle power radiated from this being as the Oathkeeper beside it nodded his head to the side, the eyes of a titanic Cthulhu in the distance releasing arcs of Aether as all those from the Infinite Reality agreed!
Little Henry nodded his head with a smile as he put the corpse of a Blight Serpent Dragon Emperor into his own exclusive space for grilling later, beckoning towards the still grim figure of Hyperion.
"Mm., it is just clusters of hidden forces stretched out across Realities. For this...we'll follow your lead, Uncle Hyperion."

The mind of this Draconic Elephantine Beast still buzzed with many thoughts while also gazing at the progeny of Noah, and he couldn't help but shake his head and collect himself, terrifying thoughts coursing through his mind.
'Does even your few days old son have to be this ridiculous? What would happen if you have a few more like him?!'
WAA!

Shocking possibilities bloomed as Hyperion pulled upon the memories of Primordial Beast, making a plan to raid Hidden Domains filled with monstrous existence as he brought with him a terrifying set of beings!
"Oh, and don't be afraid if some regions might have a LEGEND Ender of Reality protecting them."
The childish yet majestic voice of Little Henry came out once more to rouse Hyperion from his thoughts as this time, he couldn't help but gaze at this child with utter shock.
"Father has sent me word that we shouldn't be afraid if we happen to run into a LEGEND, we'll just need to let him know the moment we see signs of one appearing."
Not just Hyperion, but even Natalya and others in the surroundings stared blankly at the figure of Little Henry talking as if everything was normal.
His eyes were shining brightly as his little hands pulled on strings of light other beings couldn't see, a terrifying air gradually forming about him as he continued.
"And he wouldn't mention this haphazardly unless he discerned something with destiny...so let's be prepared for what is to come!"
The father and son duo...was enough to leave everyone speechless as those in the surroundings needed a minute before they could fully collect themselves and move out!

chapters.title: Chapter 1798
paragraphs: The Primordial Beast Bloodline was an interesting faction to consider in the vast Realities.
They stemmed from the action of the splitting of the Main Reality as since they came after Primordials, they should theoretically have much less power as they had lived for a shorter period of time.

But...then there was their unique nature of being in tune with the Main Reality as they came from Realities themselves with their only purpose being to destroy these Realities as their essence returned to the Main Reality.
If they chose to not destroy the Reality they came from and exceed its boundaries, they could destroy a myriad of other Realities and increase their strength this way!
Then one had to ask...where did Primordial Beasts operate the most? Where would their core forces lie on wait?

If the Main Reality was at the very center and the 5 Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodline Domains stretched out from it, with immediate Primordial Bloodlines coming right after as their sovereignty spanned towards most of the explored Realities...then the Primordial Beasts had to have been hiding themselves among the Unexplored Realities that fell out the bounds of the Domains of Primordials, or very intricately hidden with Unexplored areas of their Domains!

The number of Unexplored Realities that they had destroyed and returned back their essence to the Main Reality was unknown and uncountable as the strength they gained from this...was it enough to catch up and match the Primordials- especially those that were still here from the Era of OPPENHEIMER?

And their actions of destroying Realities to return them to the Main Reality...in turn also caused the Essence and Laws of this domain to become even denser as the beings who enjoyed this were its current occupants- Primordials!
But then, what if the Essence of the Main Reality that always returned when Realities were destroyed...went into something else?

What if an anomaly that had somehow borne an Infinite Reality sent out his soul in large numbers across the vast Realities and entered thousands of them and began causing them to undergo apocalypse- with him taking the Essence that would have gone back to the Main Reality for himself?!

What would be the product of Noah doing the exact same thing that Primordial Beasts were doing...but forgoing the ultimate destruction of all Cosmos and life forms within a Reality as he instead assimilated them into his Reality and took in a profound essence for his own construct?
<Well, it will for sure bring you problems sooner or later...no matter how grand the idea is now.>

Lavalliere's thoughts came out freely as while bound to Noah's slumbering body, her awareness felt the Emerging Realities that had begun to layer their stellar rivers above the Infinite Reality to begin undergoing Apocalypse and Assimilation already.
The pace that Noah was undergoing for this Infinite Dream was extremely fast, his souls moving rapidly the moment they woke as those who landed in Emerging Realities would come back the fastest!
Of the over 10,000 Portions of souls Noah sent out, the vast majority would be Explored and Unexplored Emerging Realities as Prime Realities and anything unique would make up the low numbers.
But the actions he was doing were still astronomical and would have shocking implications, Lavalliere's will watching it all as a portion of it was in a unique white space right now.
<That's why I brought you two here.>

In this blank white space, Lavalliere's will coagulated as she stared at the visage of a crimson haired figure whose very skin also shone red and gold- her body wrapped with arcs of Ruination as she stared over with a careful look!

Beside her, a stellar radiant form that shifted from a circle to a cube to a prism constantly spun with fantastical light, occasionally turning into an Endless river of stellar bodies every few seconds.
<Your Master is doing some pretty interesting things, and I am bound by too many chains as I can't help him too much. But you two...can do a whole lot more than what you've been doing in the past.>

Lavalliere's languid voice echoed out as she had truly taken a portion of the wills of RUINATION and the Infinite Reality into a unique space- allowing for Noah's treasures to have a meeting for the first time without his knowledge!
Towards Lavalliere's words, the Infinite Reality was silent.
But RUINATION...
<<We are the source of Master's strength from the very beginning. You've come here much later but think you can take the reigns and tell->>
<This has nothing to do with me fighting for status or for the attention of your Master.>

Lavalliere's voice carried immense weight as she stopped RUINATION'S words, her form coagulating into a blinding pristine visage that even the Infinite Reality and RUINATION couldn't make out as she continued!
<What I want is efficiency and communication. Like you...>
A fair crystalline white hand formed from light pointed towards the buzzing Infinite Reality.

<You have ridiculous features that you don't need to be waiting for your master to tell you to utilize in order to get things going. You have a function of being able to put together Edicts? Constantly forge the highest tier ones that you can and just let them flow to your Master. The Blacksmith's Forge can be operated without any of his clones? Go ahead and mass produce Primordial Relics or whatever the highest stage you can achieve without him...>

<You can plant and manage Sacred Herbs...fill entire Cosmos with them and cause the flourishing of seas of essence across this Domain. You all have ridiculous untapped potential that you are sitting on and doing nothing with it- I just want to change that!>
The white space buzzed as RUINATION and the Infinite Reality turned silent.

<Don't even get me started with you...didn't you play a hand in the making of his Infinite Mana? Something like that is rare to see in these barren lands, but something small like you managed to start it- why are you lagging behind now? You can move independently and upgrade yourself as all this time in the Mirror Dimension->
<<We are close to attaining what we need in the Mirror Dimension.>>
RUINATION was the one to interrupt this time around as her crimson eyes shone fiercely!
The Infinite Reality was silent as it gazed between the two clusters of light, a sigh echoing out from Lavalliere as she continued.

<You're going to be required if his Infinite Mana Trait stands a chance of becoming something else when he undergoes the metamorphosis to a Reality. Make sure your capabilities get more geared towards this as everything about you and the Infinite Reality...can be optimized to be much more efficient!>
The buzzing visage of Lavalliere that the two other entities couldn't fully see brightened up as fair hands of light came to tap in the white air a few times.

<So...why don't we start loving the concept of efficiency and start doing things before the say so of your Master? Let's kick off this first meeting with a game plan of things to accomplish before the end of this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum event. First is the restructuring of the Cosmos in the Infinite Reality and the focus of the countless beings within that are only about to increase...do you all know how much Karma your Master has been accumulating with the beings under him? The ways to use this....>
A shocking meeting that even Noah didn't even know about kicked off, the entities involved unknown by many at this moment as their identities in the future would stand for something unfathomable!
