chapters.title: Chapter 1799
paragraphs: Across the spacetime continuum, there were countless concepts not understood by many and a number of Dimensions holding terrifying existences.

Some Dimensions were more unique than others as aside from their inhabitants, their very surroundings were extremely hard to trek as this was what had stopped Noah from making rapid advancements in the Mirror Dimension!

Even the Primordials had only begun entering its deeper depths and setting up their bases there as Noah was only traversing across it with RUINATION for the same of materials required to form TABOO Relics...and also for acceptable materials to elevate the treasure accompanying him that was becoming more in tune with the Mirror Dimension.
And at this moment...
CRACK!

Noah's glorious visage accompanied by the figure of the crimson gold RUINATION broke across a mountain of mirrors that reflected one's attacks onto themselves, Destiny shining bright as Noah could see that he finally made headway.

Before them, it wasn't an expanse of endless mirrors once more as they arrived in a domain- a domain that held the auras of multiple Mirror Beasts in the Firmaments of Ascendancy and a particularly disastrous one that had yet to reach the stage of a LEGEND...but its raging will would even cause some genius Emperors to pause!
But Noah...
"Haha!"

His eyes released a bright light as he laughed jovially- because the center of this domain held an enormous crystalline tree that was budding off pillars of Mirror crystals that surged with Mirror Dimensional Essence, the inhabitants of this domain surrounding this tree and paying homage to it as they were showered with essence in return!

The crystalline pillars of Mirror crystals budding off this Mirror Tree...were unique Natural Treasures that should be more than sufficient to aid in the elevation of RUINATION and possibly the other TABOO Relics Noah needed to forge.

Noah's entrance caused the eyes of many Mirror Beasts to lock onto them, the ferocious gaze of a titanic Mirror Turtle Beast that looked like a moving mountain waking up from the distance being all the more pronounced as it held an illusory crown, its body erupting with 30 golden Ascendancy Halos and 48 silvery Reality Passages at this moment as it roared out with majesty.
"ROAAAR!"
A bellow of a Mirror Beast that far exceeded the stage of A Legend's Visage as it seemed like a continental Mirror Turtle that came to life, carrying with it sharp Mirror Essence as towards this...

Noah's joy was vibrant as his True Sanguine Clone breathed in the surging atmosphere around him, his stellar chest rising as his starry hair flew around wildly- releasing his own vibrant bellow in return that carried with it Emperor's Haki!
"OOOOH!"
BOOOM....CRACK!

The bellow of the Mirror Turtle Beast was erased before it could even reach as a terrifying force descended onto the Mirror Beasts within this domain, a battle about to finish within mere seconds as the Unnamed Kainos Emperor moved to obtain Materials to bright Relics to TABOO!

Beside him, the eyes of RUINATION lit up brightly as her crimson gold hands waved, layers of mirrors protecting and isolating the glimmering treasure tree from afar as a sense of hunger could be seen burning with her gaze...
She wanted to exceed her past self and attain even more profound stages. She wanted to be of more use and never lose value to her Master!
An unheard cry of defiance rang out from a unique treasure in the Mirror Dimension as the weaving of destiny coiled in mysterious ways.

Between the borders of Pure-Blooded Bloodlines, a Domain Rift pulsed silently as multiple Primordial LEGENDS surrounded it- the changes within unknown as they waited to see what Destiny would unfold from it!

But within the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum itself...the Chosen Emperors and monstrous geniuses that had entered found themselves marveling at the shocking wonders within as there seemed to be surprises in every corner.

Even though everyone was randomly teleported to different outskirts of the Grotto Sanctum, they could still communicate with unique tools inside this Sanctum- even though communication was nearly impossible from this domain to the outside Realities.
So knowledge was quickly spread among some connected factions as many beings quickly learned just how vast the Lands they had entered were.

Others appeared above stellar skies and red earth as they realized they couldn't fly unless they attained a TABOO authority, while others appeared in frozen landscapes filled with endless mountains, volcanic mountains spurting out baleful waves of chaotic lava that contained Natural Laws of Reality and could even burn those at the stage of A Legend's Visage, or even green plains with enormous verdant trees!

What was most astounding was the overabundance of treasures and materials that beings were coming across- ranging from regions that held vibrant Sacred Herbs swirling with the Essence of Reality that could be used as Materials to forge Relics or absorbed to forge one's Cosmos, and other regions that held glimmering Soul Crystals- the most pronounced being Medium and High Tier Soul Crystals as a few renowned beings even came to attain a trench of Supreme Soul Crystals!
Fights and blood broke out when it came to the few glimmering mountains of Supreme Soul Crystals that were counted to have been obtained by 4 known beings so far.

In a region of stellar flames burning around the very atmosphere itself, a party of magnificent Dragon Phoenixes flew across the sundering flames while heading deeper into the seemingly endless Grotto Sanctum.
Anger was currently blazing within their eyes as they spoke amongst each other.
"Alexander King?"

"Yes, the word passing around is that he is a follower of a Candidate Emperor of a Regional Domain of the Royal Humans. He was known to be a genius close to breaking the Limits of his Body as he refined multiple Physiques and bathed in Golden Vestigial Flames of Royal Humans."

A sharp glint crossed the eyes of the leading body of a Dragon Phoenix as the flaming tails behind him released a dangerous light, his draconic forehead supporting a floating solidified crown with the words <EMPER> giving off a glint of power as he released a baleful aura while speaking coldly!
"He's captured or killed Andur and also obtained one of the trenches of Supreme Tier Soul Crystals?"

"Yes, the other 3 known beings who've suppressed others to obtain the Soul Crystal Mountains when they arose are Empress Akaris, Juliette...and the one known as Xian- an existence that broke through to become a LEGEND moments after entering the Grotto Sanctum."

Some Dimensions were more unique than others as aside from their inhabitants, their very surroundings were extremely hard to trek as this was what had stopped Noah from making rapid advancements in the Mirror Dimension!

Even the Primordials had only begun entering its deeper depths and setting up their bases there as Noah was only traversing across it with RUINATION for the same of materials required to form TABOO Relics...and also for acceptable materials to elevate the treasure accompanying him that was becoming more in tune with the Mirror Dimension.
And at this moment...
CRACK!

Noah's glorious visage accompanied by the figure of the crimson gold RUINATION broke across a mountain of mirrors that reflected one's attacks onto themselves, Destiny shining bright as Noah could see that he finally made headway.

Before them, it wasn't an expanse of endless mirrors once more as they arrived in a domain- a domain that held the auras of multiple Mirror Beasts in the Firmaments of Ascendancy and a particularly disastrous one that had yet to reach the stage of a LEGEND...but its raging will would even cause some genius Emperors to pause!
But Noah...
"Haha!"

The crystalline pillars of Mirror crystals budding off this Mirror Tree...were unique Natural Treasures that should be more than sufficient to aid in the elevation of RUINATION and possibly the other TABOO Relics Noah needed to forge.

"ROAAAR!"
A bellow of a Mirror Beast that far exceeded the stage of A Legend's Visage as it seemed like a continental Mirror Turtle that came to life, carrying with it sharp Mirror Essence as towards this...

Noah's joy was vibrant as his True Sanguine Clone breathed in the surging atmosphere around him, his stellar chest rising as his starry hair flew around wildly- releasing his own vibrant bellow in return that carried with it Emperor's Haki!
"OOOOH!"
BOOOM....CRACK!

An unheard cry of defiance rang out from a unique treasure in the Mirror Dimension as the weaving of destiny coiled in mysterious ways.

chapters.title: Chapter 1800
paragraphs: Yes!

To obtain immense power and resources in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, genius existences who could break through at any time as they already had the epiphany of resonating their Aspects of Existence to form a Reality...did so right away as their foundations had already been forged for millions or billions of years.

Now, they hoped to attain Grotto Nacres and even more profound resources in this Sanctum to propel their power greatly above others, so the first thing that some beings did was isolate themselves and exceed the Firmaments of Ascendancy!
After all...it would be much easier to suppress others once one attained Reality.
"Hmph."
The leading Dragon Phoenix snorted disdainfully at this as he continued.
"A vestige from the Olden Era suppressing his Realm until now...we can't aim for him or Akaris and Juliette- but this Alexander...who does he think he is?"
A light of brutality flashed as multiple TABOO authorities surged around this distinguished Obsidian Adjudicator Commander of a Dragon Phoenix Legion from the Main Reality.

"Find the whereabouts of this Alexander and exactly what region he's moving in. We shall see whether he has really exceeded a Limit...or if he is merely another genius thinking there are no others like him."

A command echoed out among a connected faction of the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline as other clusters of communicating beings within the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum were also passing around the news of all exceptional events and beings occurring!

Word of powerful existences that had been suppressing themselves this whole time as they finally became LEGENDS the moment they entered the Grotto Sanctum- and these beings moving freely as even though the entrance of the Domain Rift didn't allow anyone at this stage to enter, it didn't kick out those that forged their Reality within the Sanctum.

Word of beings obtaining astounding treasures and destiny spread as among them, the buzzing of the name Alexander King began to spread- especially the fact that he had defeated a young genius Emperor of the Dragon Phoenix race who held a solidified authority with its own Ecritures!

Names of maddened beings that had already become LEGENDS that others steered away from included one known as Xian- a creature crackling with Aether that moved with brutality and purpose as even Emperors with Solidified Crowns stayed away from him.

The outskirts of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum everyone was teleported into were too vast and filled with too many opportunities as no one being could obtain them all, many beings obtaining fortune as the biggest boons of all...would be for those who could pierce deeper into this Grotto Sanctum as this became the main goal for all beings.

If the outer perimeter contained Supreme Tier Soul Crystals and Sacred Herbs that could even act as ingredients for TABOO Elixirs and Relics...just what things would the median and inner regions hold?!
BZZT!
In a region where stellar red earth gradually changed to molten flowing magma that contained the allure of stellar bodies.

A massive rainbow colored leaf sprouted from the stellar and constantly moving lava as it pulled with essence, this leaf holding a budding crimson gold light that gave off ridiculous waves of a naturally formed treasure as multiple beings were currently fighting for it!
A glimmering Willow Tree unfurled countless branches that weaved across space, cutting apart anything they came across as three Reality Ursidae stood against it with majestic gait and visage.

The three stellar Bears were adorned with Solidified Crowns while the Willow Tree had the ecritures <EM> on its crown, these four beings fighting ferociously and with speed as they had just recently found this treasure, and they knew other beings could very likely cross this region and join the fray as they wanted to decide the victor soon!

Glittering Reality Passages flourished behind them as this whole place was bathed with resplendent essence, these beings already fused with their Halos as auroras of rainbow colored Wings sprouted behind them while they fought with fervor.

The Illusory paw of an enormous bears claw would form as it would be disrupted by the sharp piercing power of countless branches that rained down, a single Infinite Willow Tree genius withstanding the three Reality Ursidae as a unique domain seemed to be released from its body that caused an abundant flourishing life force that also constrained the auras of the enemies in its surroundings.
"Fall!"

Its branches exploded in number once more as the battle neared a shocking height, but it was at this moment that these four beings fighting shuddered as all of them gazed upwards at the same time- feeling an overbearing sense of pressure pushing down onto them!
"This..."

Their faces changed as their worries came to fruition, and in the worst ways possible as they saw the visage of a devilishly smiling existence who had a ridiculously massive Reality Passage above him that pressed down with horrific weight.
The three Reality Bears gritted their teeth as the Infinite Willow Tree was unwilling!
"ROAAR!"
It roared out with defiance as the eyes of the tyrannical existence above shone, his voice coming out authoritatively.
"Ascendant Illuminating Soul Star."
The stellar red skies changed color as a blazing star formed above.
It released deadly soul flames that would burn the very souls of those laying their eyes on it.

And like a hammer that struck against their hearts and soul...the ability cast by a mere 100x multiplier that solely targeted the soul caused the faces of the three beings below to wither and nearly fade!
"Ascendant Multilayered Possession."

After being bathed by the True Dimensional Dream Damage Values onto their very souls, these existences were dazed and could barely keep their true forms active as wondrously...none of them had set up strong enough defenses of the soul to withstand Noah's single attack.

Strings of vibrant blue Mana wrapped around the bodies of the three Reality Ursidae and an Infinite Willow Tree as they became miniaturized and floated towards his waist, Noah nodding his head thoughtfully as he went down to collect the Sacred Herb Material below that could very well act as a substitute when forging TABOO Elixirs or Relics!

chapters.title: Chapter 1801
paragraphs: After obtaining the Supreme Tier Soul Crystals, Noah had continued forging forward into the depths of the Grotto Sanctum as this action allowed him to meet 2 more arrogant Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Primordials that were added to his collection on his waist, and he had managed to obtain over 7 incandescent Sacred Herbs and even clusters of High and Medium Tier Soul Crystals on the way here.
And from the three Reality Ursidae and Infinite Willow Tree he had just obtained...
<You have extracted the TABOO Concepts of The Endless Tree, Robust Predator, Imperial Bear Emperor, and Demolitioner. >
<You have extracted the Quasi-TABOO Concepts of...>
His soul felt a euphoric feeling even though it had already reached its limits, becoming bathed in the light of TABOO as Noah exceeded 5 TABOO Edicts within his soul!

His clone was an extension of his main body that even though it was slumbering at this moment...another ecriture began to buzz above his floating crown as the exceeding of 5 TABOO concepts was considered another shocking achievement at this stage as one's authority was elevated.

Noah enjoyed this feeling as his figure continued forward after collecting the Sacred Herb, plucking the glimmering Leaf and the gold light it bore as just the gains of the Grotto Sanctum so far were enough for Noah to leave happy.

But there seemed to be much more in store as his destiny was buzzing powerfully, a golden book appearing in his hands as he continued forward at a fast speed, sensing something much more significant about to occur apart from just Supreme Soul Crystals and Sacred Herbs!

In the flaming region he flew across, those who didn't have TABOO authority and had to walk on the ground couldn't even cross as they had to take the long way towards other regions to move forward, Noah seeing clear fiery skies and no interruptions below as his body surged with multiple astounding TABOO authorities while bearing the weight of the restrictive laws of this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum that seemed to be getting heavier the farther one went.
<It's actually very unique. For the Natural Laws of Reality to meld this well with a Domain Space...there must be something fundamental that caused this change.>
Lavalliere's voice echoed out as Noah nodded, sensing the changes most closely as his will was still restricted heavily where he could only rely on his eyes.
"Just how different is this Grotto Sanctum compared to others?"
<Incomparable.>
The words of Lavalliere were resounding to hear as they further cemented the shocking nature and truth that was waiting within this Grotto Sanctum!
Noah's figure tore across the restrictive skies as he followed the pull of destiny and fortune that he had an overabundance in.
And after a few minutes...his eyes brightened up as they stared at a wondrous scene.
Up ahead, the stellar flaming earth and skies began to change as Noah's eyes captured tout and thickly coiling rivers of Reality that formed into vibrant massive chains.
Chains that sunk heavily into the ground and elevated upwards in the skies, continuing on endlessly as they seemed to be connected to shimmering floating landmasses!

The very skies where the chains of Reality began also underwent a chance as from the crimson red stellar lights, they became Grey as they gradually turned a stellar cerulean, the air condemning as a stellar grey-blue sea began to form from this area forward.
It was utterly dazzling to look at as it felt like the area Noah was coming from was the earth below and the skies above, and now it would be the earth below and a sea above!
The area where this change happened was dreary and filled with clashing essence, but the tout chains of Reality kept everything together as they acted like anchors that paved the way forward.

The chains of rivers of Reality coiled tightly around each other as they surged up the cold stellar sea, connecting to massive landmasses that released a bright allure of Destiny that caused Noah's Primogenial Strata Aspects of Existence to shudder with shocking fervor!
HOONG!
His eyes released beams of lustrous lights as his visage neared the distinction between stellar fiery skies and dreary cold seas that seemed viscous and extremely heavy even before one entered them.
But Noah's eyes were only on the extremely far away and indistinct landmasses that released a radiant light as what lay there...
<Grotto Nacres.>
Lavalliere's voice boomed in Noah's mind as his visage instantly dove forward into this new region.
Something that he had to get his hands on had appeared, but would it truly be so easy to grasp it?
BZZZT!

The moment he stepped onto the dreary cold seas, he felt like he had stepped into an unscalable, viscous, and hard to move in swamp as even with the vibrant TABOO Essences of the Sanguine Emperor, the Flameborn, the Defiler, The Endless Tree...every concept he was utilizing to freely move at this moment seemed like it wasn't enough!

His body...actually began to sink down ever so slowly as it wasn't until he burned more Mana and Essence of Reality to release shocking waves of TABOO authority did he stop, but proceeding forward was still hard as for most people that weren't Noah, they might have to take on their True Forms or use other Unique means to move forward even by a little.
But time was a great factor as the being who ascended across this new region the fastest would be able to attain most of the shocking treasures!
And since the Grotto Sanctum was so vast, Noah knew there must be many of these floating landmasses in this new region that others might be getting their hands on if they cross fast enough.

This caused a stifling feeling in his heart as he felt like things that should be his might to others, so he prepared to unleash his Ascendancy Halos and anything else it would take to forcefully cross into this region that seemed particularly imposing with the Natural Laws of Reality.
<Hold on.>
Yet Lavalliere's voice came as Noah raised his brows.

<Allow me to devour a portion of the Quintupled Supreme Tier Soul Crystals for .25 Uses. I'll be able to speak more freely on this and be able to show you an even faster method to move across this Domain that should you put you ahead of others significantly.>
WAA!

The words of this terrific treasure rang in Noah's mind briefly before he made his mind soon after, his will giving its go ahead as from the Expansive Space- a portion of the newly attained trench of Soul Crystals disappeared.
And soon after...
<The Chains of Reality. Step on them and begin to infuse your Dimensional Essence and Essence of Reality into them.>

Noah stared down at the tout chains of rivers of Reality wrapped around each other and sinking into the earth within the dreary blue sea, his body releasing arcs of TABOO as he allowed the restrictive force to drag him down and towards these chains that rose up!
At the same time, his voice rose to Lavalliere.
"What have you found out?"

<This Sanctum...seems to carry a connection or source from a Dimension. Thus, Dimensional Essence will be most conducive in traversing it, and these Chains of Reality will make it even faster when paired with the Essence of Reality itself.>

"Oh?" Noah's bright eyes illuminated the dreary seas as he came to land on one of the thick Chains of Reality, placing his hands on it and feeling a unique coursing of dark and violent Essence he wasn't familiar to yet!
"Which Dimension is it?"
He asked lightly as he received a stellar answer.
<Not quite sure yet. You'll have to reach much deeper for me to be able to discern it better.>
WAA!
His Origin surged as his eyes lit up brightly.
They pulled from the source as vibrant waves of Dream Essence and the Essence of Reality began to rapidly surge from Noah and into the callous Chains of Reality!

Noah stared down at the tout chains of rivers of Reality wrapped around each other and sinking into the earth within the dreary blue sea, his body releasing arcs of TABOO as he allowed the restrictive force to drag him down and towards these chains that rose up!
At the same time, his voice rose to Lavalliere.
"What have you found out?"
<This Sanctum...seems to carry a connection or source from a Dimension.
Thus, Dimensional Essence will be most conducive in traversing it, and these Chains of Reality will make it even faster when paired with the Essence of Reality itself.>

"Oh?" Noah's bright eyes illuminated the dreary seas as he came to land on one of the thick Chains of Reality, placing his hands on it and feeling a unique coursing of dark and violent Essence he wasn't familiar to yet!
"Which Dimension is it?"
He asked lightly as he received a stellar answer.
<Not quite sure yet.
You'll have to reach much deeper for me to be able to discern it better.>
WAA!
His Origin surged as his eyes lit up brightly.
They pulled from the source as vibrant waves of Dream Essence and the Essence of Reality began to rapidly surge from Noah and into the callous Chains of Reality!

chapters.title: Chapter 1802
paragraphs: Chapter 1802 Ascending the Chains of Reality!
Noah's figure was surrounded by viscous waves of water that seemed to be crashing down all around him with immense pressure.

His simple obsidian pants and shirt that hugged his fair body and his billowing dark hair that was gaining a scintillating light of essence as Dream Essence and the Essence of Reality erupted around him made him seem like a prince of the deepest parts of the seas, his robust hands grasping onto the Chains of Reality as his Essence began to flow into them!
They were unique in a way that even though they seemed like thickly binding rivers of Reality, they didn't have any domain within them even though they swirled with stellar gray colors.

They were callous and hard like cold metal that had been sunk into the deep waters for too long, with their luster bright yet dimmed to what it could be as when Noah began to enter Essence into it...the area he was in began to light up.
<The Essence of Dimensions is unique as even if they are opposing, one can rouse another as when layered with the Essence of Reality that is the foundation, this type of effect can be achieved.>
Lavalliere's voice twinked out as the darkly blue seas around Noah began to surge.

The thick Chains of Reality he stood on began to buzz with a metallic sound as if rusted metal was coming to life, the stellar radiance within them beginning to brighten up starting at where Noah was and arching up the Chains for a few miles!

As Noah counted placing 300,000 Units of the Essence of Reality and 100,000 Units of Dream Essence, he felt the heavy restriction around him begin to waver as the Chains of Reality released a glow of authority that pushed off the oppression in the surroundings.

"Hmm..." He stood on the thick Chains as his body steadily released Dimensional Essence and the Essence of Reality, stopping at 30,000 Units of the Essence of Reality and 10,000 Units of Dream Essence every second going into the Chains of Reality to maintain the authoritative glow being given off close to his body.

It showed a wondrous scene as the far away Chains of Reality leading up to the barely discernible floating land masses seemed dim, and yet the one Noah stood on had a part of it lighting up brightly as if one focused on it...they would see a devilishly handsome existence begin to walk upwards!

Up towards the depths of the unique Grotto Sanctum as his body received surges of Essence from a single visible Reality Passage of massive size with a speed that even beings with multiple TABOO Authorities would not be able to achieve!

And many prominent beings began to realize this as far away from Noah's position, an Olden Emperor turned into a Kainos Emperor gazed at the gradual change of the surrounding from verdant earth filled with lush vegetation and a blue sky onto dreary and cold bodies of water covering the next section of the skies, glimmering Chains of Reality leading upwards to floating land masses as she surged into this area immediately.
HUUM!

But Genevieve's expression changed as she felt her body sinking right away, the many vibrant TABOO Authorities that amounted to over 20 after one counted the ones she had retrieved from her Origin in the Royal Treasury and those she had attained from the beings she devoured so far in this Grotto Sanctum.

Yes. Devoured! She had taken this action as her visage was currently the form of blue haired young man, her authority as a Queen nowhere to be seen as she moved silently to devour the talents she came across.
The Chosen Emperor that was Alexander was a target, but did this prevent her from devouring the foundations of other Geniuses and elevating herself even more?

This Grotto Sanctum was bound to be a land of transformation for her as the moment she heard the news that Alexander had killed those of the Dragon Phoenix Lineage, she knew things were unfolding as she had foreseen where many enemies would be coming for this prideful being who couldn't handle being suppressed below the feet of others!

All she had to do now was move the fastest to attain the most abundant opportunities here, waiting for this being to be receiving attacks from all sides and beings as when he just finished a heavy battle with much of his resources used up...this was the time that Genevieve would swoop in.

Buy it seemed her path would be filled with difficulty as even this new region she had entered made it infinitely hard to continue forward, her holy body being pushed down across the dreary cold waters as she could only redirect herself onto the thick Chains of Reality below, grasping onto them tightly as with heavy steps and while gritting her teeth, she began to take slow step after slow step forward.
"YAA!"

Her body burst with TABOO authority every now and then to lift and ease the heavy shackles around her, but the pace she moved seemed to be unbearably slow as the Golden glimmering land masses in the distance seemed further and further away!
If she happened to see the rapid rate of running that Noah was currently moving up the Chains of Reality with...
Well, it was better for the less fortunate to not know just how lavish blessed beings were, otherwise they would think life to be too unfair!

Even further away from Genevieve and across the outer perimeters of the Grotto Sanctum, powerful Emperors were arriving at this junction of a new area with increased restrictions aa they all surged in only to be dismayed, the Adjudicator Legions and Will Bearers being among those latching onto and fighting for space on the Chains of Reality to ascend upwards.

Fights broke out for those already slowly moving across Chains of Reality as those behind threw attacks towards those upfront, wishing to be the first ones up as they could see the allure of the floating islands in the distance!

chapters.title: Chapter 1803
paragraphs: Chapter 1803 The Tyrannical Emperor's Drastic Plan! l
The trekking into this new area seemed to be for the talented as in one region, a party of Dragon Phoenixes had occupied and began to ascend through one Chain of Reality.
Their bodies gave off a majestic glow of power and grandeur as their eyes reflected the majesty of destiny far above them, but as they were ascending...
BOOOM!

An explosion akin to a bomb shot out behind them as an existence smashed into the change of skies to water at shocking speeds, causing surging waves of sea storms to surge out and pushing even shaking the nearby Chains of Reality as alarm rose in the minds of all those in the surroundings!

When they turned their heads to observe who could act so wildly, they saw the visage of an existence clad in gold Armament all around, pairs of wings flapping below her feet and behind her back as unlike all others who sank when entering the dreary seas filled with oppression...she floated calmly as when the wings below her feet buzzed, she even began to fly upwards as her body released a unique authority.
"This..."
The scalps of those watching tingled as the majestic Dragon Phoenixes on the Chain of Reality looked with unfathomable gazes and envy as one spoke out.
"Akaris..."
The existence that had spoken calmly to even Alpha Strata LEGENDS as her word had started the quick entrance into the Grotto Sanctum.

She didn't seem too horribly phased by the restrictions and oppression around her as her body gave off wave after wave of glowing might, the many pairs of wings on her buzzing with power as she slowly ascended upwards- but at a much faster rate compared to those nearby struggling up the Chains of Reality!
What authority did she have to be able to do this when even TABOO Authorities were not enough to allow one to move freely?!

The leading Dragon Phoenix gritted his crystalline sharp teeth as he continued up with even more vigor, telling himself there were some beings he shouldn't compare himself to as the identity of Akaris was too special even in the Main Reality.

In another region, the allure of a silver white haired young woman took light but quick steps up the Chains of Reality, her body giving off a silvery mirror like glow that buzzed with the chain below and allowed her a level of freedom- causing her beautiful expression to continue gazing at the chain with surprise as she continued to ascend upwards.
Mirror constantly bloomed and shattered to protect her from the heavy restrictions as her speed...was no less than that of Akaris as she went up towards the far away glowing land masses!

Countless Geniuses and Emperors began to arrive in a new region of the Grotto Sanctum as they faced a cold and brutal atmosphere, each one using their own means to ascend upwards as undoubtedly, there was one being in the lead that was moving with utmost haste!
In the Infinite Reality.

Vibrant rivers of Realities layered themselves atop the Infinite Reality and underwent Apocalypse and Assimilation, their Cosmos fusing into this wondrous domain as incandescent True Stars of Conquest constantly formed and rushed down towards the slumbering visage of a single being!

The veils of the Cosmic Holy Land seemingly didn't exist as the milky white stars rushed down with glorious purpose, Noah's slumbering figure having its eyelids constantly vibrating as more and more portions of Souls sank back into him.

His progress in the Third Infinite Dream could be considered astounding to say the least as Emerging Realities took mere seconds for him to reign in the Cosmos and then pull the Realities towards the Infinite Reality, and this record pace of progress gave birth to a ridiculous phenomenon!

Since over 10,000 Portions of Souls were sent out, those who were destined to find Emerging Realities found them relatively quickly as with the seconds of domination Noah did for each of these Realities...he did it all simultaneously.

It also meant that when they were returning back to the Infinite Reality with their dominated Realities in tow, a relatively short period of time would have passed! This created for a situation where hundreds of Realities were layering themselves atop Noah's domain and undergoing Apocalypse, a True Sanguine Clone gazing at the destruction and Assimilation with immense focus as within Noah's slumbering Origin...two concepts were bubbling with majestic fervor!
The Nomological Edicts of Apocalypse and the Tyrannical Emperor.
Every time a Reality perished and was assimilated, the concept of Apocalypse buzzed with a light of Obsidian glory.

Every time that the thousands of Cosmos of a Reality merged into the Infinite Reality and its inhabitants came under the will of the Tyrannical Emperor, this concept also buzzed with a light of glory!
These two evolvable concepts were currently buzzing wildly with their authority as from Quasi-TABOO, they began to make their way towards TABOO.
And they were forging towards TABOO rapidly as within minutes, the Third Infinite Dream had already proceeded to have over 3,000 Realities assimilated.

The Bloodlines of these concepts also burned brightly within Noah's Blood as they experienced a qualitative change, beginning to forge upwards in quality as they didn't seem to be staying at the Tier of Supreme anymore!

Under the banner of glorious Conquest, thousands of True Stars of Conquest also rained down as the milky white light of Conquest painted everything, making the area around Noah seem like a holy land that others should not even be near at this moment.

The more time that passed, the faster the shocking phenomenon of the assimilated Realities became as the 4,000th True Star of Conquest came down...then the 4,100th...4,500th...and within mere minutes that followed- over 5,000 True Stars of Conquest had accumulated within Noah.
An astounding stellar glow also began to bloom at this moment, but it didn't even come from Noah!
It came from all areas of the Infinite Reality.

This was because at this same time, the number of fused Realities into this fantastical domain had long since exceeded the halfway point of the requirement of 10,000 fused Realities before it could proceed forward to an entirely different level!
HUUM!
When this time came, Noah's will began to surge.
His main body remained slumbering, but a True Sanguine Clone rose up to take on an astounding task.

Noah's body occupied the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny as the True Sanguine Clone came to occupy the Throne of Arcadian Tyranny, these two multicolored thrones coming close while facing opposite each other until they came in contact!
The connection between Noah and his Clones was filled with vibrant clarity as at this moment, the stellar eyes of his Clone released beams of light as he spoke out.
<Nomological Regime>.
The Regime of the Tyrannical Emperor was pulled upon!
Then, the domineering Will spoke out grandly as an illustrious white gold milky light began to spread.
"Utilize 5,000 True Stars of Conquest to elevate...the Resplendent Treasure Emperor."
WAA!
Incandescent light began to explode out...but Noah's will was still stirring vibrantly as he pulled upon the authority of the Infinite Reality Passages!

A wild thought and destiny had bloomed within his mind these past days as he knew the elevation of the Infinite Reality was coming. And after the things he learned while in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, his thoughts and ideas became further solidified.
Now that the time was approaching...he got ready for it as the number of Realities would very soon exceed 10,000!
When that time came...

The blooming thoughts within Noah's mind alone began to cause bursts of Destiny, Fate, Karma, and Fortune to bloom as the actions that followed thereafter would be even more disastrous and unbelievable.
Lavalliere seemed to have sensed these changes as well, this vibrant treasure becoming roused up as in the next instant, genuine shock could be heard from her as she voiced out!
<You...what are you planning to do?!>
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 1804
paragraphs: What was Noah trying to do?
Even the visage of Lavalliere who could somewhat grasp his thoughts was shocked when she finally picked up on the idea that had bloomed in his mind.
But there were currently so many things buzzing within Noah's Aspects of Existence currently as even Lavalliere was facing too much 'noise' to fully grasp Noah's intentions!

His will had just given the command for 5,000 True Stars of Conquest to be utilized to elevate Resplendent Treasure Emperor to TABOO, the Cosmic Holy Land shining with a milky golden white light as the dazzling stars surged out and broke down before Noah's eyes- gradually pulling in the wisps of Natural Laws of Reality as they gradually transformed a unique Seed of TABOO that would bathe a chosen concept.

But apart from this, two more Seeds of TABOO were blooming within Noah's body as the Concepts of Apocalypse and the Tyrannical Emperor had taken all their boons from the thousands of destroyed and assimilated Realities as they were evolving towards the next stage!
Too many things were happening.

Wild waves of incandescent essence bellowed about as the Throne of Arcadian Tyranny and the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny spun tightly while glued unto each other, Noah's slumbering body experiencing the greatest changes as even his liquified soul that had reached the absolute peak trembled, the feedback of all existences pledging Fealty to him and giving up a portion of their souls rushing to him this whole time as he didn't have any place to put it!
Since the absolute peak was reached and one couldn't go any further unless they resonated their Aspects of Existence and formed a Reality, where would all this vibrant soul force go to?!

This was yet another factor and process occurring at this moment in time but even this wasn't the center of Noah's attention, his eyes ignoring the gradual formation of three Seeds of TABOO as he focused on his connection to the Infinite Reality.

Every time that he had to upgrade it, it had taken droves and droves of mana as it perfectly complemented him- with the Spiritual Land able to be raised to this level purely because of Noah's Infinite Mana!

This time would be no different as even though the multicolored Essence of Reality would be pulled into it, the connection between Noah and the Infinite Reality would always supply immense waves of mana.
This...was actually one of the places Noah was targeting with a grand plan.
The idea had come as even his Destiny was not too clear on what the result would be- or whether it was the truest course of action!
But his intuition rang out with possibilities as when he thought of the many things he wanted to experience, uncover, and explore...he moved.

As he sensed another thousand Realities assimilate into his connected domain and the total number near 10,000- the 50 Infinite Reality Passages above him were ready and Illuminating everything while showing Noah with immense coiling tendrils and rivers of essence.
Droves of essence...with Noah allowing a particular essence coursing down his Reality Passages to build up around him in abundance!

His slumbering main body was sitting on the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny as if he was awake, his whole visage at this moment lighting up fervently as sandy golden glowing Runic Lines lit up within his body- bringing out the authority of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique with all its splendor.

The Essence building up around Noah...was Dimensional Essence as his Will and Authority erupted out to maintain all of it in the surroundings while his Infinite Reality Passages endlessly gushed down even more of this Essence!
Things finally clicked as Lavalliere's voice echoed out grimly.
She seemed to have figured out what Noah was trying to do as the first thing she said...contained a hint of caution.

<What you saw in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum is just the influence of Dimensional Essence permeating into it- it is nothing like what you are trying to do here...there is no guarantee that it is even viable as you can have a rejection that could cause you a setback.>
"There is no guarantee..."
Noah's voice boomed out majestically from the True Sanguine Clone as even his lips opening and speaking gushed out Dimensional Dream Essence!
"...but my Destiny shines even brighter when I just think about this path!"
WAA!

His luminous eyes released a profound light of tyranny as at that moment, Prime Realities began to fuse and assimilate from those Noah had called back as the requirement that was set so long ago for the Infinite Reality to elevate into a Gourmandizing Reality...was achieved.
Lavalliere didn't speak anymore as her will gazed on silently.
At times, an existence would see a golden path that others could not- a path that only they could follow as others wouldn't be able to understand it.
Even though Lavalliere was terrifyingly proficient in Destiny, Fortune, Karma, and Fate- there were still things about Noah that she couldn't ascertain!
His Undefined Life Line for example.
And the paths he could see that would have exceedingly heavy effects for his future and the future of many others...she also couldn't see through at this moment!
HOOOONG!
A booming sound reverberated out as the hundreds of thousands of genuine Cosmos within the Infinite Reality gave off a flicker of radiant light.

The inhabitants that had been through similar occurrences gazed up in wonder, while those that had just joined the Infinite Reality gazed up in shock, stupor, and wonder as they couldn't fully understand what was occurring.
<<Master.>>

The voice of the Infinite Reality reached out to Noah as the river of time seemingly flowed slower, Noah sensing everything extremely well as he tuned everything out until only the beat of his own heart became clear!
He could feel the vibrant Dimensional Dream Essence surging within his body through interconnected lines that pulsed with life as if they were veins and arteries.
He could feel the profound flow of destiny and fortune that shine brightly all around him!
He could feel the countless lines of Karma that arose from the countless existences that now resided within his Infinite Reality.
THUMP!

He could feel the dense clusters of Dimensional Essence he had collected, as well as his Clones that he had sent in the Dream Dimension who paused their search for Dream LEGENDS and Nightmares and became anchors in this Dimension- their bodies giving off the glow of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique as dense clusters of essence had long since surrounded them for light years!
He could feel all of this as in the next moment, he spoke out calmly as his Will sought out to achieve a terrifying feat.
"Begin."

sentences.text: What was Noah trying to do?
Even the visage of Lavalliere who could somewhat grasp his thoughts was shocked when she finally picked up on the idea that had bloomed in his mind.
But there were currently so many things buzzing within Noah's Aspects of Existence currently as even Lavalliere was facing too much 'noise' to fully grasp Noah's intentions!

His will had just given the command for 5,000 True Stars of Conquest to be utilized to elevate Resplendent Treasure Emperor to TABOO, the Cosmic Holy Land shining with a milky golden white light as the dazzling stars surged out and broke down before Noah's eyes- gradually pulling in the wisps of Natural Laws of Reality as they gradually transformed a unique Seed of TABOO that would bathe a chosen concept.

But apart from this, two more Seeds of TABOO were blooming within Noah's body as the Concepts of Apocalypse and the Tyrannical Emperor had taken all their boons from the thousands of destroyed and assimilated Realities as they were evolving towards the next stage!
Too many things were happening.

Wild waves of incandescent essence bellowed about as the Throne of Arcadian Tyranny and the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny spun tightly while glued unto each other, Noah's slumbering body experiencing the greatest changes as even his liquified soul that had reached the absolute peak trembled, the feedback of all existences pledging Fealty to him and giving up a portion of their souls rushing to him this whole time as he didn't have any place to put it!
Since the absolute peak was reached and one couldn't go any further unless they resonated their Aspects of Existence and formed a Reality, where would all this vibrant soul force go to?!

This was yet another factor and process occurring at this moment in time but even this wasn't the center of Noah's attention, his eyes ignoring the gradual formation of three Seeds of TABOO as he focused on his connection to the Infinite Reality.

Every time that he had to upgrade it, it had taken droves and droves of mana as it perfectly complemented him- with the Spiritual Land able to be raised to this level purely because of Noah's Infinite Mana!

This time would be no different as even though the multicolored Essence of Reality would be pulled into it, the connection between Noah and the Infinite Reality would always supply immense waves of mana.
This...was actually one of the places Noah was targeting with a grand plan.
The idea had come as even his Destiny was not too clear on what the result would be- or whether it was the truest course of action!
But his intuition rang out with possibilities as when he thought of the many things he wanted to experience, uncover, and explore...he moved.

As he sensed another thousand Realities assimilate into his connected domain and the total number near 10,000- the 50 Infinite Reality Passages above him were ready and Illuminating everything while showing Noah with immense coiling tendrils and rivers of essence.
Droves of essence...with Noah allowing a particular essence coursing down his Reality Passages to build up around him in abundance!

His slumbering main body was sitting on the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny as if he was awake, his whole visage at this moment lighting up fervently as sandy golden glowing Runic Lines lit up within his body- bringing out the authority of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique with all its splendor.

The Essence building up around Noah...was Dimensional Essence as his Will and Authority erupted out to maintain all of it in the surroundings while his Infinite Reality Passages endlessly gushed down even more of this Essence!
Things finally clicked as Lavalliere's voice echoed out grimly.
She seemed to have figured out what Noah was trying to do as the first thing she said...contained a hint of caution.

<What you saw in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum is just the influence of Dimensional Essence permeating into it- it is nothing like what you are trying to do here...there is no guarantee that it is even viable as you can have a rejection that could cause you a setback.>
"There is no guarantee..."
Noah's voice boomed out majestically from the True Sanguine Clone as even his lips opening and speaking gushed out Dimensional Dream Essence!
"...but my Destiny shines even brighter when I just think about this path!"
WAA!

His luminous eyes released a profound light of tyranny as at that moment, Prime Realities began to fuse and assimilate from those Noah had called back as the requirement that was set so long ago for the Infinite Reality to elevate into a Gourmandizing Reality...was achieved.
Lavalliere didn't speak anymore as her will gazed on silently.
At times, an existence would see a golden path that others could not- a path that only they could follow as others wouldn't be able to understand it.
Even though Lavalliere was terrifyingly proficient in Destiny, Fortune, Karma, and Fate- there were still things about Noah that she couldn't ascertain!
His Undefined Life Line for example.
And the paths he could see that would have exceedingly heavy effects for his future and the future of many others...she also couldn't see through at this moment!
HOOOONG!
A booming sound reverberated out as the hundreds of thousands of genuine Cosmos within the Infinite Reality gave off a flicker of radiant light.

The inhabitants that had been through similar occurrences gazed up in wonder, while those that had just joined the Infinite Reality gazed up in shock, stupor, and wonder as they couldn't fully understand what was occurring.
<<Master.>>

The voice of the Infinite Reality reached out to Noah as the river of time seemingly flowed slower, Noah sensing everything extremely well as he tuned everything out until only the beat of his own heart became clear!
He could feel the vibrant Dimensional Dream Essence surging within his body through interconnected lines that pulsed with life as if they were veins and arteries.
He could feel the profound flow of destiny and fortune that shine brightly all around him!
He could feel the countless lines of Karma that arose from the countless existences that now resided within his Infinite Reality.
THUMP!

He could feel the dense clusters of Dimensional Essence he had collected, as well as his Clones that he had sent in the Dream Dimension who paused their search for Dream LEGENDS and Nightmares and became anchors in this Dimension- their bodies giving off the glow of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique as dense clusters of essence had long since surrounded them for light years!
He could feel all of this as in the next moment, he spoke out calmly as his Will sought out to achieve a terrifying feat.
"Begin."

chapters.title: Chapter 1805
paragraphs: The vast Cosmos within the Infinite Reality halted their rotation for an instant.

The connection between this treasure that used to be a small Floating Island was the only thing focused on at this moment as a vast blue cylindrical string of light that connected Noah and the Infinite Reality was buzzing at this moment!

One side was Noah, the other was symbolized by a constantly expanding and contracting prism that changed into pulsing stellar rivers of branching Realities that formed into what seemed like an endless tree.
The endless stellar rivers pulsed with light as they pulled upon the connection of their Master!
The 10,000 Realities requirement was reached as this domain could elevate once more, and it asked for the Mana of its owner like always as for this instance...Noah actually denied it!
If he proceeded forward like normal, the Infinite Reality that was currently classified as a Seed of Reality would become a Gourmandizing Reality.
But Noah's sight had been expanded as he had experienced too many things, and he had lived millions of years in his dreams.
So he had dared to ask himself that when the time came to elevate the Infinite Reality into a Gourmandizing Reality...why stop there?

And after he saw the uniqueness of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum and Lavalliere letting him know that it seemed to be influenced by the Essence of a Dimension...Noah further agreed with his thoughts as he definitely would not just stop here!
So when the time came to elevate the Infinite Reality as it sought essence from its Master...
It wasn't Mana that he sent.

The first essence that Noah sent stemmed from the 500,000,000 Reserves he held within himself first as Nkah sent in pure Dimensional Essence as the first source of energy for the Infinite Reality to eat up.
HUUUM!

Incandescent sandy golden light bloomed as it surged across the massive cylindrical string of connection that was shared between Noah and the Infinite Reality, bathing it entirely gold as it surged into the transforming Seed of Reality with fervor!

Boundless droves of essence surged in the Infinite Reality Passages as it gushed out even more, Noah directing this essence and the Dimensional Dream Essence in the surroundings to all surge towards the evolving Seed of Reality.

The True Sanguine Clones within the Dream Dimension that were pulling in essence for many light years around them also trembled as everything was sucked in by Noah's main body and directed towards the Infinite Reality, everything becoming bathed by a sandy golden color as Noah was actually seeking for a shocking result from the elevation of the Infinite Reality this time around!

After the surging sandy gold Dimensional Essence traveled up the line of connection and bathed the Infinite Reality, only then did Noah's cerulean blue Mana gush out in encompassing waves as it reinforced the Dimensional Essence and caused it to sink into the evolving Seed of Reality even faster.

Noah's Will observed this process with immense focus as he only felt the tug of destiny become even more vibrant, but the surging Seed of Reality that had begun to evolve into an illusion of an endless Reality trembled with instability.
Dimensional Essence was foreign as it was packed into its core, and Mana aided in its assimilation as it suffused and made it interconnectedly fuse into the Infinite Reality even more.

But there was still one more thing that had to be used to complete this as vibrantly, the glimmering multicolored Essence of Reality then left Noah's Origin as it surged across the line of connection with fervor!

It covered and filled the gaps between the vibrant blue Mana and the sandy gold Dimensional Dream Essence- all three types of essence surging into the evolving Infinite Reality and causing everything to become extremely stable!
HUUUM!

But Noah didn't stop there as after that, the allure of Destiny, Fate, Fortune, and Karma all came to wrap around this cluster and amalgamation of raging essence as they wrapped over everything like a bow tie.
<The Infinite Reality has begun its elevation.>
<The result is currently unknown.>
A radiant light of glory began to pervade outwards as a shocking transformation began at this moment!

Lavalliere watched it all silently as her will was currently ready to erupt if anything unfathomable happened as even though her restrictions would be even tighter- she had to make sure that this being before her wouldn't perish.
There were the Infinite Realities...and then there were the 9 Dimensions.
Each of these were boundlessly vast and filled with shocking intricacies!
This was the state of affairs after the actions of OPPENHEIMER.

Lavalliere referred to the Infinite Realities as barren lands as what were Dimensions considered to be? And what Noah was doing now as he took in Dimensional Essence to be a source of the elevation of a terrifying treasure...just what shocking implications would this have?!
The more that Lavalliere looked at it, the more serious her will became as it wasn't the fact that it was failing...but that it seemed to be proceeding smoothly and with shocking seamlessness!
How was the Dimensional Essence not being rejected? Even with Mana and the Essence of Reality supplementing this process, what was occurring was not something that conformed with nature.
How was this treasure under the banner of this being capable of accepting such a change and bringing all of this to fruition?!

In the Cosmic Holy Land, two glorious Thrones of Authority spun as the eyes of Noah's True Sanguine Clone were opened luminously, gazing at the vast Infinite Reality as his voice began to echo out tyrannically.
"Elevate not just to a new form of Reality...but attain traces of a Dimension at your core."
HUUM!
The vast Cosmos within the Infinite Reality buzzed with fervor.
Within an extremely Small World in a Galaxy of the Novus Universe located in a cluster of Universes within a larger Cosmos.

A young boy was practicing swinging a sword that released arcs of purple lightning in a field of verdant lush greenery as he stared at the occasional bursts of milky white and gold light that he barely grasped where they stemmed from.

Amidst his observations...he suddenly focused on the skies as he saw billowing sandy golden clouds beginning to form, these clouds carrying a shocking essence that caused this young boy's heart to tremble and gaze at in shock as it wasn't something he had ever come across before!

The sandy golden clouds erupted out and spread with shocking speed, coming to paint everything a hazy gold as even the layers of the verdant lush greenery around this boy began to be covered by a thin layer of golden sand.
This process occurred in this small world...and in over half of the countless worlds across many Galaxies within many Universes of the Hundreds of thousands of Cosmos within the Infinite Reality!
Over half of the Domains of the Infinite Reality began to be covered by wisps of Dimensional Dream Essence!

All around, the allure and wonders of Dimensional Essence began to pervade outwards and bloom as Noah's will spread to understand and observe all of these changes while glorious prompts began to rise before his eyes.
<The Infinite Reality is undergoing a fundamental change.>
<Dimensional Dream Essence has begun to proliferate.>
<The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality is coming to fruition!>

chapters.title: Chapter 1806
paragraphs: <The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality is coming to fruition!>
Such a prompt rose as incandescent light began to permeate across more than half of the domains of the Main Reality!
Dimensional Essence permeated the very foundation of this Reality as it was used as one of the core essences to elevate it during an extremely crucial upgrade!

The sheer size of the Infinite Reality was vast as within what could be considered its center- close to the veils of reality within the blue planet that used to be Noah's home world that was currently a paradisiacal stretch of land...the Dimensional Essence was the most concentrated here.

Waves of billowing sandy gold essence permeated this area the most as its source was stemming from the veils of space, where the only being that could see through it was Noah himself! When he followed his connection with the Infinite Reality, he could visualize what should have been a starry blank space hidden in the center of this Reality- but he currently saw an area shining with a glorious golden color as an octahedron crystalline structure could be seen constantly spinning and pulsing with Dimensional Essence, and the illusion of thousand of snaking rivers of Reality surged within it with utmost wonder and majesty!

Noah's very soul felt a surge of profound waves of authority that he couldn't explain from being connected to this crystalline octahedron structure, his Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique buzzing with activity and shining with even more splendor as his multicolored crown and its spinning ecritures were covered with an even denser cluster of a sandy golden light- a light that didn't leave the ecritures alone as it forcefully coagulated and gradually formed a golden ecriture that read <D> behind the ecriture of <ETHEREAL>!

Noah's eyes released luminously bursts of light at this progression as at the same time, Lavalliere's will focused on the pulsing crystalline octahedron that was constantly releasing Dimensional Essence while also surging with the illusion of thousands of surging rivers of Realities.
<A Dimensional Core...?>

Her words held a hint of hesitation as she couldn't be sure of what she could see budding- where to her, it seemed like a barely countable budding core of a Dimension but at the same time...it wasn't.

Noah's will wasn't hindered by the specifics as with his connection to the Infinite Reality, his mind was currently being fed with boundless information and prompts that allowed him to see just what the wondrous changes occurring were.
Mind you, at this same period of time...three Seeds of TABOO were still budding within Noah!
<The Infinite Reality has been elevated in its classification from a Seed of Reality to a Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.>
<The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality has lost the past Ranking as a Sui Generis Enlightened Primordial Relic, with its new ranking not able to be defined.>
The Infinite Reality wasn't able to be classified as Quasi-TABOO or TABOO, or even what lay beyond that as it was actually Undefined!
And what this glimmering octahedron could do...
<A Mutated Dimensional Reality Core that can produce Dimensional Essence has formed within the Infinite Reality.>
The production and sustenance of Dimensional Essence.
'That's it...'
Noah's will bubbled with a light of power as this was what he sought!
The definition had to also be very clear as even though he utilized Dream Essence to bring about this shocking result, he didn't want this to be the end.
Because...
'Why stop at a single Dimension?'

Yes! Noah wasn't only planning to have a semblance of the Dream Dimension in his Infinite Reality- with the path he could visualize in his mind being filled with the connections of multiple Dimensions as soon as he was able to attain large reserves of their essence and be connected to them in a way that would allow him to fundamentally connect them to his Infinite Reality!
The Dream Dimension was merely the first.
And the boons of this alone were bound to be ridiculous as the whole Infinite Reality was fundamentally changed.
<All features of the Infinite Reality have undergone extreme qualitative changes as some features have been integrated or entirely elevated.>

Noah's mind buzzed with information as while sandy golden waves of light began to pump out of the octahedron Dimensional Reality Core, the glorious text box of the Infinite Reality rose before his eyes!
[Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality Management]
[Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality](Infinite Reality)

Many changes occurred to the old abilities of the Infinite Reality as a few new features bloomed!
The first new feature was named after the Infinite Reality itself- being termed <Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality>.
Another thing to note was the fact that at this moment, the way forward past this stage was unknown as it would depend on Noah to find out exactly where he would take the Infinite Reality.
But in the meanwhile...there were terrifying boons for him to learn of and old features that were entirely modified for him to grasp!

Features- Size Regulation(Unlocked), Dimensional Movement(Unlocked), Architecture(Unlocked), Dimensional Barrier(Unlocked), Offensive Maneuvers(Unlocked), Time Dilation(Unlocked), Treasure Hunter (Unlocked), Domain Space(Unlocked), Dimensional Blacksmith's Forge(Unlocked), Division(Unlocked), Dimensional Alchemy Hall(Unlocked), Library(Unlocked), Integration(Unlocked), Dimensional Gateway(Unlocked), Pocket Dimensional Reality(Unlocked), Assimilation(Unlocked), Trait Blessing(Unlocked), Concept Birth(Unlocked), Dimensional Empowerment(Unlocked), Cosmic Singularity (Unlocked), Dimensional Holy Land(Unlocked), Soul Library(Unlocked), Dimensional Atlatl of Reality(Unlocked), Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality(Unlocked), Infinite Dream Automatons(Unlocked), Aspect Transference(Unlocked)...#^$%#(Locked)

Many changes occurred to the old abilities of the Infinite Reality as a few new features bloomed!
The first new feature was named after the Infinite Reality itself- being termed <Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality>.
Another thing to note was the fact that at this moment, the way forward past this stage was unknown as it would depend on Noah to find out exactly where he would take the Infinite Reality.
But in the meanwhile...there were terrifying boons for him to learn of and old features that were entirely modified for him to grasp!

chapters.title: Chapter 1807
paragraphs: Noah's will covered the incandescent lands of his domain as he saw the proliferation of the Dream Essence, the Cosmic Holy Land that was actually renamed into the Dimensional Holy Land undergoing the most changes as it was closest to the octahedron Dimensional Reality Core hidden in the folds of space at this moment.

Many of the areas of the Infinite Reality were undergoing reconstruction and restructuring at this moment, Noah seeing the will of this Dimensional Reality moving by itself to organize all the Cosmos and even begin enacting fantastical architectures as it allowed his thoughts to focus on other things.
At this moment, his attention was on the feature of <Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality>!

<Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality> :: The Infinite Reality has gained the capability of autonomous mobility as it can drift across the boundaries of Dimensions and Realities. When coming across Realities on its path, the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality will assimilate them unto itself as when it crosses into the veils of Dimensions, it will devour and assimilate the surrounding lands and Essence. The act of drifting utilizes pure Mana, with 100,000 Units of the Essence of Reality required to assimilate Emerging Realities, 1,000,000 to assimilate Prime Realities, and 1,500,00 Units to assimilate Unique Realities. To devour surrounding areas and Essence of a Dimension, 1 Million Units of the Essence of Reality and 50 Million Units of any Dimensional Essence per second are required. This ability is a core feature of the Infinite Reality as it will pave the way for its future pathways and possibilities...
A dreadful ability rose as the elevation of the Infinite Reality truly did what it said it would!
Autonomous Mobility.

Like a Vessel, it could move across the bounds of space like a giant living and breathing beast- such a phenomenon only required pure Mana as this...was something that Noah would have no problems with.
Noah could simply allow his Infinite Reality to drift around the vast regions of space as whatever Realities it came across...it can just swallow them!

The feature was unique as it showed the expenditure for the action of simply devouring the Realities to have high Essence of Reality costs, and this was different in that if Noah utilized Infinite Dream- he had to personally submit the Cosmos of the Reality to agree with the connection to his Infinite Reality, and he could then bring them to assimilate with the Infinite Reality.

The <Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality> bypassed all that work with the usage of Essence of Reality to simply devour everything it came across instantly as when it came to Dimensions...the cost was even higher!
But...this ability was something utterly crucial for the future as it would pave the way for more than just the Dream Dimensional Essence to permeate across the Infinite Reality.

As soon as things settled and its transformation finished- a transformation that was still occurring right now as essence was liquifying into seas all around while the beautiful allure of the sandy gold light of the Dream Dimension began to permeate across the domains.
While this occurred, Noah's eyes landed on the second new feature to arise!

<Infinite Dream Automaton>:: The autonomous Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality can forge Infinite Dream Automatons to defend it, the creatures being generated at the Cosmic Filament Realm as they can be elevated in power from being granted concepts in the Soul Library or from being fed the newly unlocked Sacred Herbs of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality. Their unique Basic Dream Physiques allow them to undergo 5 Cycles of refinements of any High Tier Physiques under the Unnamed Kainos Emperor, with there lying a possibility to exceed the Limits of the Firmaments of Ascendancy in a single Aspect of Existence- the Body. To generate a Dream Automaton, the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality has to utilize 1,000,000,000 Units of Dimensional Dream Essence. To try and exceed the single allowable Limit of the Body of a Dream Automaton, 10 Billion Units of Dream Dimensional Essence are required along with the usage of Sacred Herbs and other materials. The Realm and Aspects of Existence of the Dream Automatons can be raised naturally with Dream Essence and Sacred Herbs, but other means of progression can also raise its rate of progress...
Noah was utterly silent as his luminous eyes stayed on this feature for a long time.

The past Spiritual Island that was the source of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality was capable of producing Spiritual Beasts like the Emperor Penguin. Now, this elevated treasure had gained the capability to generate Infinite Dream Automatons as the cost of it alone...was entirely too dreadful!

But it provided Noah a source where he could mass produce LEGENDS- with the problem of foundation solved so long as these Dream Automatons were provided 10 Billion Units of the Dream Essence. Thereafter, Noah would have them break to the stage of Reality as their realms could be elevated ridiculously fast with Sacred Herbs or even Seeds of Reality.

The only issue came with the requirements of the large reserves of Dream Essence...but the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality had already begun producing Dream Essence by itself as Noah would have to grasp just how much it could produce every day and what its reserves were, as well as how that complemented his own 500 Million reserves of Dream Essence.
But this ability alone was enough for the boons of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality to show itself, but there was one last ability to put a bow on it all.
It was Aspect Transference!

<Aspect Transference>:: Beginning at the Primogenial Strata- the resonated Aspects of Existence, Realm, Reality Passages, Destiny, Fortune...and all of the achievements of a Reality Realm Dream Automaton can be stripped off and transferred onto an inhabitant of the Gormandizing Dimensional Reality that is at the Seventh Firmament of Ascendancy or higher. The process only works among those who have pledged Fealty to the Tyrannical Emperor, with 2 Million Units of the Essence of Reality and 250 Million Units of the Dimensional Dream Essence required to conduct the transference. A being can only accept transference thrice in their lifetimes, with any further possibilities lying with the advancement of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality itself....
The path forward not just for Noah, but also for his people...had opened up in a glorious fashion!

chapters.title: Chapter 1808
paragraphs: The three new features of the Infinite Reality were <Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality>, <Infinite Dream Automaton>, and <Aspect Transferance> as the three were of shocking utility!

Noah looked over their details multiple times as aside from <Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality>, he really wanted to take a look at <Infinite Deam Automaton> and exactly what results he could bring out from this.
But before he forged forward too fast, his eyes landed on the old features that were renovated or entirely assimilated into a single feature.

His main Body still slumbered as the portions of Souls that had arrived within Prime Realities were just a bit slower to return, and two Portions of his souls actually entered Unique Realities that he had begun to explore at this moment!
The eyes of the True Sanguine Clone sitting opposite Noah's main body was the one expressing most of his will currently as he voiced out with luminous eyes.
"Summarize the most important changes to the old features."
WAA!
He gave the command as the Infinite Reality complied soon after.

<Relics and Elixirs forged with the Dimensional Blacksmith's Forge and Dimensional Alchemy Hall carry traces of Dimensional Essence as Relics that can deal or protect from True Dimensional Damage Values can be born, or elixirs capable of carrying profound changes and reality altering effects equivalent to mimic a semblance of the Absolute Dream Authority have a chance of being born.>

<Unique Dream Cosmos can now be passively forged under Cosmic Singularity, these cosmos carrying traces of the Dream Dimension as their proliferation will increase the authority of the Gourmandizing Infinite Reality into the stage of Dimensions.>

<In the Dimensional Holy Land, Time can be dilated to a ratio of 20,000:1 as it reaches a dangerous level, occasionally capable of causing rift storms of the Law of !#$@%%# that could irreparably damage one's Aspects of Existence if enveloped within .>
Noah raised his hands as all prompts paused.
He had to pause them because a shocking prompt had appeared that had indecipherable words within- words that represented a stage he was beginning to touch upon!
The Natural Laws of Reality.
The time dilation effect had reached such a ridiculous reality altering level that it could actually cause rifts storms of a Natural Law of Reality by chance! But...
"What is the Natural Law?"
Noah voiced out as he asked both the Infinite Reality and Lavalliere.
Both were silent briefly before the Infinite Reality replied.
<<I cannot decipher it yet, Master.>>
Noah nodded calmly at this as he still remained quiet, waiting for the other treasure that seemed to have all the information to speak!

And in time, the unique voice of Lavalliere resounded out as it was filled with a trace of seriousness- her will still gazing at the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality and what its implications would be.

<I can let you know if you want to waste 5 Uses and an inordinate amount of the treasures you've obtained in the Grotto Sanctum so far. Or you can wait for a little and gradually find out when you become exposed to it. Things like this have costly Karma to be paid if you don't know anything about them first...so I suggest for you to just wait. As you get familiar with incorporating the dredges of the Natural Laws around you to form Seeds of TABOO, you'll gradually begin to understand and differentiate the different types of Natural Laws...and when you can isolate and incorporate a single one into a Concept- the stage above TABOO can be grasped little by little.>
She spoke a great deal this time around as Noah's eyes shone with a glimmer of destiny.
Wisps of the Natural Laws of Reality granted one the authority of TABOO.
But if one could distinguish the Natural Laws of Reality and incorporate the essence of a single one into a concept...they could go past TABOO!

<We're jumping over many things here...but I don't want us to just move past what you've just done. Do you truly realize how hard you've made things for yourself by bringing about this Mutated Dimensional Core?>
Lavalliere's words carried a trace of seriousness as towards this, Noah only nodded lightly!
"I may not know the full implications...but my very being tells me it is the path I must follow."
His will was resolute as once he had started with the aim of incorporating Dimensions into the Infinite Reality, he wouldn't just stop midway as he would follow this path all the way!
<...I need another .25 Uses to speak freely.>
The words to be said seemed too abstruse as Noah smiled and gave a nod, a chunk of Supreme Tier Soul Crystals disappearing once more as Lavalliere sighed and continued.

<Before the end of Age of Destiny, there was only the single Main Reality and the 9 Dimensions. Each was separate...but they shared distinct interweaving of connections. At the end of the Age of Destiny as a certain being took Power, his actions of bringing about Infinite Realities didn't just affect the Main Reality...the impact of this stretched towards the 9 Dimensions as well!>

<As for what the impact actually was, I can't speak to that at this moment- but just know that the current Infinite Realities have their purpose, and the 9 Dimensions have their own purpose. Your task of assimilating Infinite Realities was already hard enough, but incorporating even a single Dimension has made it all that much harder as any further progress you make in this...the existences that have capability across the Ages on the depths of the Dimensions will be alerted as they will come for you before can fully grow.>

This seemed to be the reason for Lavalliere's seriousness. The forceful swallowing of the 'lands' of Dimensions he planned to carry out with Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality would possibly alert the existences living at the depths of the 9 Dimensions that even Primordials were still expanding their Domains into!

There were so many more questions and mysteries surrounding it all as while the Infinite Reality underwent changes fundamentally connecting it to a Dimension, Noah was beginning to slowly unravel just what lay in wait for him!
