chapters.title: Chapter 1809
paragraphs: <The 9 Dimensions have their own restrictions- and it is why you don't see all that many Dimensional Creatures moving about in the vast Realities. But towards an existence who is the same as them- like a certain guy with grandiose distinctions and titles who happens to have a Dimensional Physique that can rival Dimensional Royalties at the core dominions of a Dimension...they can move against you with an increased level of freedom as the moment that they truly know what you are doing, it won't just be the forces of a single Dimension hunting you down, but all 9.>
HUUM!
Terrific words left Lavalliere as Noah maintained his calm, watching from his throne as Dream Essence began to permeate abundantly in the Dimensional Holy Land.
Towards Lavalliere's shocking words, Noah attained a hint of a smile as he asked lightly.
"Are you afraid?"
"Is the great Lavalliere that terms the vast Realities to be Barren Lands and everything beneath her actually afraid of the forces of Dimensions?"

<I am not afraid of others. What I am afraid of...is an existence that already has an astounding destiny and boundless possibilities at his fingertips increasing his chances of being cut down too early.>
Her voice still carried seriousness, but a sense of pride also rose as she spoke the next words!

<What I don't wish to see...is an existence who can help me achieve my own goals take great risks without knowing everything. I've said it before, but what you and I have is a give and take relationship. What's done is done in the Aspect of the Infinite Reality as we can only move on from that and how to best face what will come from it, I just want to let you know the sheer gravity of the path forward after this. Even though it is extremely dangerous, I understand the most that therein lies the most fortune and destiny...which means all the more loot for me to devour as I recover faster.>

<What I wish for...is not for you to look at me as a mere tool to utilize, but as someone you can discuss crazy ideas like this with as I could at least aid you in better preparing for it. Using Absolute Dream Authority to mask you somewhat, increasing the chances of success...anything.>
Lavalliere spoke a great deal as Noah pondered over her words slowly. Eventually giving a light nod in the end!
"There is no harm in being more careful. I'll attain more Loot soon to increase the number of Uses as whatever Absolute Dream Authority is required to mask my current actions will be utilized."
His words were firm as he seemed to assuage Lavalliere, this terrific existence becoming quiet as Noah saw the prompts of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality continue once more.

<The Soul Library can now hold TABOO Concepts and up to Keystone Ascendant Skill Trees. It also holds the new feature of Librarian Domain that allows the inhabitants of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality to comprehend the formation of high-tier Edicts.>
<Domain Space can now design a Dimensional Domain with extremely concentrated Dream Essence that will over time condense into wisps of Absolute Dream Authority.>

<Dimensional Atlatl of Reality now grants a Base increase of +500 True Reality Damage Values and +500 True Dimensional Damage Values passively when just equipped by the Main body of the Tyrannical Emperor, and it further grants an extra +500 True Reality Damage Values and +500 True Dimensional Damage Values when its own skills or other skills are cast through it. The Damage Values will rise as major progress is made in the inclusion of more Realities and Domains of Dimensions. The sub abilities of [Dimensional Rupture], [Aspect Piercer], and [Massive] have also been unlocked.>
Noah glimpsed over the remaining prompts explaining some lesser interesting features as his focus came to land on the newly improved Atlatl of Reality!

When abilities were cast through it, it ridiculously granted Noah an extra 2,000 Damage Values that nearly caught up to his actual Value of 2,850+ that he had garnered after much hard work with multiple Physiques.
Noah still felt like the potential of this feature could be disastrous as his True Sanguine Clone raised his hand and beckoned while calling out lightly.
"Dimensional Atlatl of Reality."
BZZZT!
Boundless splendor rained down as from the skies, a spatial Rift bloomed that called out an incandescent spear of light that instantly landed in Noah's hands!
It released a shocking light of power as the space around it buzzed terrifically, Noah's eyes locking onto a glorious two-pointed spear that released a radiant light.

Its spear shaft swirled with rivers of Cosmos that shone a stellar purple, blue, and Gold, while the two spear points shone with a deadly stellar light! To top it all off, tendrils of vibrantly gold Dimensional Essence were snaking over the Dimensional Atlatl of Reality as they eventually snaked over Noah's hand and went on to surround his entire enthroned body!
The weapon gave him a sense of shocking power as with it in hand, Noah's figure rose up from the glimmering throne as he seemed like a mythical Emperor from a long lost Age.

He floated across the constantly changing Dimensional Holy Land as he oversaw the results of his work, appreciating everything that was occurring as he floated towards a section of the Holy Land that had an altar rising up.
It seemed like a golden pyramidal mountain that was rising up as it was filled with dense Dream essence, its peak showing constantly swirling bursts of sandy gold essence!
"This is?"
<<The area where we can generate the Infinite Dream Automatons, Master.>>
The Infinite Reality replied succinctly as Noah pondered while sensing his own remaining reserves of Dream Essence.
<Have you quantified your reserves and rate of generation of Dimensional Essence? Do we have enough to try a Dream Automaton right now?"
Yes.
Noah's will was so wild that he wanted to test whether he could elevate an Infinite Dream Automaton to the stage of a LEGEND in a relatively short period of time since he had all the tools available!

<<Due to the eruption of Dimensional Essence with the formation of the Mutated Dimensional Core, I currently hold 2,385,529,573 Units of the Dream Dimension. When things stabilize, I'll be able to grasp my rate of generation and maximum Reserves.>>
The words of the Infinite Reality caused a smile to deepen on Noah's face as he commanded calmly.
"Then...let's take a look at an Infinite Dream Automaton, shall we?"
WAA!
His will surged out as the Infinite Reality moved to complete it!

Things were moving rapidly as his clone of Alexander neared the vibrantly gold islands amidst the dreary coldness of the seas in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, and he had to garner as many possible sources of strength as he could just in case.

At the same time, the three Seeds of TABOO that would elevate Apocalypse, Tyrannical Emperor, and Resplendent Treasure Emperor were slowly forming and automatically incorporating wisps of the surroundings Natural Laws of Reality- being nearly formed as his strength would explode from these concepts too!
While grasping onto a stellar spear surrounded by arcs of Dimensional light, Noah watched the glory he had enacted before his eyes as a pyramidal golden mountain shone with incandescence...

<I am not afraid of others.
What I am afraid of...is an existence that already has an astounding destiny and boundless possibilities at his fingertips increasing his chances of being cut down too early.>
Her voice still carried seriousness, but a sense of pride also rose as she spoke the next words!
<What I don't wish to see...is an existence who can help me achieve my own goals take great risks without knowing everything.
I've said it before, but what you and I have is a give and take relationship.

What's done is done in the Aspect of the Infinite Reality as we can only move on from that and how to best face what will come from it, I just want to let you know the sheer gravity of the path forward after this.
Even though it is extremely dangerous, I understand the most that therein lies the most fortune and destiny...which means all the more loot for me to devour as I recover faster.>
<What I wish for...is not for you to look at me as a mere tool to utilize, but as someone you can discuss crazy ideas like this with as I could at least aid you in better preparing for it.
Using Absolute Dream Authority to mask you somewhat, increasing the chances of success...anything.>
Lavalliere spoke a great deal as Noah pondered over her words slowly.
Eventually giving a light nod in the end!
"There is no harm in being more careful.
I'll attain more Loot soon to increase the number of Uses as whatever Absolute Dream Authority is required to mask my current actions will be utilized."
His words were firm as he seemed to assuage Lavalliere, this terrific existence becoming quiet as Noah saw the prompts of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality continue once more.
<The Soul Library can now hold TABOO Concepts and up to Keystone Ascendant Skill Trees.
It also holds the new feature of Librarian Domain that allows the inhabitants of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality to comprehend the formation of high-tier Edicts.>
<Domain Space can now design a Dimensional Domain with extremely concentrated Dream Essence that will over time condense into wisps of Absolute Dream Authority.>

<Dimensional Atlatl of Reality now grants a Base increase of +500 True Reality Damage Values and +500 True Dimensional Damage Values passively when just equipped by the Main body of the Tyrannical Emperor, and it further grants an extra +500 True Reality Damage Values and +500 True Dimensional Damage Values when its own skills or other skills are cast through it.
The Damage Values will rise as major progress is made in the inclusion of more Realities and Domains of Dimensions.
The sub abilities of [Dimensional Rupture], [Aspect Piercer], and [Massive] have also been unlocked.>
Noah glimpsed over the remaining prompts explaining some lesser interesting features as his focus came to land on the newly improved Atlatl of Reality!

When abilities were cast through it, it ridiculously granted Noah an extra 2,000 Damage Values that nearly caught up to his actual Value of 2,850+ that he had garnered after much hard work with multiple Physiques.
Noah still felt like the potential of this feature could be disastrous as his True Sanguine Clone raised his hand and beckoned while calling out lightly.
"Dimensional Atlatl of Reality."
BZZZT!
Boundless splendor rained down as from the skies, a spatial Rift bloomed that called out an incandescent spear of light that instantly landed in Noah's hands!
It released a shocking light of power as the space around it buzzed terrifically, Noah's eyes locking onto a glorious two-pointed spear that released a radiant light.
Its spear shaft swirled with rivers of Cosmos that shone a stellar purple, blue, and Gold, while the two spear points shone with a deadly stellar light!

To top it all off, tendrils of vibrantly gold Dimensional Essence were snaking over the Dimensional Atlatl of Reality as they eventually snaked over Noah's hand and went on to surround his entire enthroned body!
The weapon gave him a sense of shocking power as with it in hand, Noah's figure rose up from the glimmering throne as he seemed like a mythical Emperor from a long lost Age.

He floated across the constantly changing Dimensional Holy Land as he oversaw the results of his work, appreciating everything that was occurring as he floated towards a section of the Holy Land that had an altar rising up.
It seemed like a golden pyramidal mountain that was rising up as it was filled with dense Dream essence, its peak showing constantly swirling bursts of sandy gold essence!
"This is?"
<<The area where we can generate the Infinite Dream Automatons, Master.>>
The Infinite Reality replied succinctly as Noah pondered while sensing his own remaining reserves of Dream Essence.
<Have you quantified your reserves and rate of generation of Dimensional Essence?
Do we have enough to try a Dream Automaton right now?"
Yes.
Noah's will was so wild that he wanted to test whether he could elevate an Infinite Dream Automaton to the stage of a LEGEND in a relatively short period of time since he had all the tools available!
<<Due to the eruption of Dimensional Essence with the formation of the Mutated Dimensional Core, I currently hold 2,385,529,573 Units of the Dream Dimension.
When things stabilize, I'll be able to grasp my rate of generation and maximum Reserves.>>
The words of the Infinite Reality caused a smile to deepen on Noah's face as he commanded calmly.
"Then...let's take a look at an Infinite Dream Automaton, shall we?"
WAA!
His will surged out as the Infinite Reality moved to complete it!

Things were moving rapidly as his clone of Alexander neared the vibrantly gold islands amidst the dreary coldness of the seas in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, and he had to garner as many possible sources of strength as he could just in case.

At the same time, the three Seeds of TABOO that would elevate Apocalypse, Tyrannical Emperor, and Resplendent Treasure Emperor were slowly forming and automatically incorporating wisps of the surroundings Natural Laws of Reality- being nearly formed as his strength would explode from these concepts too!
While grasping onto a stellar spear surrounded by arcs of Dimensional light, Noah watched the glory he had enacted before his eyes as a pyramidal golden mountain shone with incandescence...

chapters.title: Chapter 1810
paragraphs: The Mutated Dimensional Core pulsed with the sandy gold essence of Dreams as it already surged with over 2 billion Dream Essence.

Much of it was being used to alter and change the domains of the Infinite Reality, but 1 Billion Essence was used up at this moment as a creature that would come to be a stout defender of the Infinite Reality for the future to come was called upon.
BZZT!
The pyramidal golden mountain shone with luster as dense Dream Essence surged into a fantastical storm at the very peak!
An outline of a creature gradually formed as it was titanic in size, being multiple times larger than normal humans as Noah saw a glistening golden form coming to be.

It gave off a crystalline metallic sheen as Noah squinted when he observed sharp weaponized hands that looked like sickles, where the shoulders ended in a round oval shape as they floated grandly- connected to the Main body by a thin golden line!

And this main body was simply a vibrant oval structure that had a smaller oval head with two cold golden slits floating above it, and robust golden limbs that were just as sharp as the arms- the crystalline metallic surface of this Infinite Dream Automaton being inscribed by the Runic Ecritures of DREAM all over.

On the back of the floating oval chest was a radiant pair of white wings that were being paid homage to with glimmering DREAM ecritures- all of the structures of this Automaton seeming capable of separation as they were connected by robust lines of essence!
It felt like a creature that could easily pull apart its limbs and body parts or move them to different positions if it wished!
"This is the creature I can easily raise to a LEGEND..."

Noah stroked his chin as he saw this Automaton forming, the golden slits on its oval head opening and gazing towards him with respectful fervor as this Automaton floated off the golden pyramidal structure and came to bow its unique body towards Noah.

The Tyrannical Emperor nodded with appreciation as his will moved out with many commands, waving his hands to call out Shards of a Seed of Reality as he also sought to observe the newly unlocked Sacred Herbs that would be crucial for the growth of these beings!
How could the influence of the Infinite Reality attaining a Mutated Dimensional Core best be shown throughout the vast lands of this domain?

An extremely clear example was something that showed just what fundamental changes would be occurring in the future to come- and how it would begin on a small scale and how that could affect everything on a larger scale.

Many geniuses rose within the vast Realities, and by pure statistics alone, there were bound to be a significant number of geniuses and those loved by destiny rising from Noah's Infinite Reality itself.

One such being was currently changing his gloves as he moved from one room to another in a crystalline skyscraper that held over 500 floors- being one of the largest buildings atop a floating island just above the past lands of the Blue Planet that Noah stemmed from.
This being had golden hair shining gloriously on his head as he was adorned with radiant blue scrubs that had a name tag that listed <Dr. Hall, MD> in shining gold letters!
With his fair skin, he looked like a devilishly handsome doctor that one could only see in unrealistic TV shows.

Before the apocalypse of the Blue Planet, he had the profession of a Doctor that he loved with all his heart, but he nearly discarded it as Mana and magical solutions and abilities became more prevalent over the past year- with him even taking on the role of a Healer in dungeon teams.

This all changed when the concepts of Nomological Edicts arose as during a time when he was treating heavily injured existences who nearly had their Origins irreparably damaged from one of the Cosmic Dungeons, he came to comprehend a shocking evolvable Edict that was termed the Origin of Nature.

With it, he saw profound mysteries of the Origins and Bodies of the existences he healed, and he even became proficient in seeing injuries of the soul as after this...he decided to go back to the field of medicine he loved and use the Edict of The Origin of Nature to understand mysteries of life and diseases that had eluded him and many others in his profession over the years!
He mastered all areas of medicine in a relatively short period of time with his talents and comprehension as he could treat and take on the role of anything in the field of medicine.
For him, dungeon diving and being battle crazy like many wasn't an allure- his heart seeking to understand the mysteries of life itself.

His comprehension rose crazily over the past month as this single Nomological Edict reached peak Insuperable, with the gaze of Dr. Hall being able to peer through shocking secrets of the bodies, souls, and Origins of different races as he came to understand the three Aspects of Existence.

And in the past hour, he had been doing his job of helping anxious pregnant Hunters who still chose to go the traditional route of having a doctor present while giving birth when his Edict of the Origin of Nature actually elevated to Quasi-TABOO.

This didn't happen by itself- it just so happened to coincide with the time that Dimensional Essence began to proliferate across the Infinite Reality as the hospital he was in was enveloped by sandy golden waves of essence!

When he delivered a baby boy right when these changes began, he nearly sighed in frustration as he wondered what their ridiculous Emperor was doing now to cause such crazy changes, but everything changed soon after as he saw the child being born exhibit changes he had never seen before in the past month.

All the infants he delivered were unique as they were tainted by Mana and other profound essences that were liquified in the Infinite Reality, and they carried a level of intelligence even while born as they would smile and giggle at Dr. Hall and their parents!

But the infant he delivered after the proliferation of Dimensional Essence had its eyes shining with a golden allure of light, and his Edict of the Origin of Nature had seen shocking changes occurring in its very Aspects of Existence as traces of the newly proliferating Essence could be seen within!
Through understanding the Mysteries of this new essence, the single Edict he focused on seemed to have seen an entirely different field of Nature as it was elevated.

Dr. Hall measured the Soul strength among other things of the newly born infant to be significantly higher than others in the past, and he affirmed this again and again in the next hour as he delivered three more infants.

He didn't even realize when the Nomological Edict of the Origin of Nature had reached Quasi-TABOO as even now, he walked across the hospital hall to another room to deliver for one more family until he was off for the day- plans that he now chose to change as he wanted to experience all the changes brought by the hands of their Emperor and whatever crazy things he was doing now.

The eyes of Dr. Hall swirled with unknown light while his chest showed the Illusory glow of Cosmos, seeming entirely absorbed in understanding the Aspects of Existence of all beings closely, not knowing how rapid the advancement of his single Quasi-TABOO Nomological Edict that actually rivaled something a certain Tyrannical Emperor could make!

He wanted to understand the changes of those being born under these constantly changing environments as this unknown being in the Infinite Reality...would actually be among the very first apart from the Unnamed Kainos Emperor to achieve a stage of TABOO based purely from his uniqueness and path that he sought.
But his experiences so far showed that those born in the Infinite Reality had traces of Dimensional Essence within them as the effect of this...was bound to be astronomical for the uncertain future!

As he watched the sliding glass doors open into another room where another patient lay waiting, his golden hair weaved silently while his eyes shone with a genius light, speaking out words only he could hear.
"Primum non nocere...and then, uncover the Mysteries of whatever the hell our Emperor is doing!"
Geniuses were bound to arise across Realities, and it would be especially so in a land full of abundant destiny as those from the Infinite Reality were bound to show shocking surprises...

chapters.title: Chapter 1811
paragraphs: In the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

Noah's figure was ascending the metallic Chains of Reality with astounding speed as his body surged with essence that entered these chains vibrantly, a single massive Reality Passage being shown above him even though he was enjoying the boons of all 50!

Dimensional Essence continued to leave his body and sink into the Chains below him along with the Essence of Reality, his body showing robust Essence nonetheless as every part of him seemed full and vibrant with life.

This was due to increasing boosts and Nourishment from the Infinite Reality Passages and the boons of the countless souls pledging Fealty to him and giving up a portion of their souls that seemed to have nowhere to go, his Aspects of Existence adamant on staying where they were until he resonated them and opened up the pathway to Reality...and it seemed only then would these raving waves of essence be consumed!
When they were, he had no doubt that the moment he entered the genuine Primogenial Strata of the Realm of Reality, he would shoot up straight to its peak.
'But for now, let's figure out exactly what this Grotto Sanctum is made of...and why its restrictions are like so!'

His thoughts were steady as he felt the higher up and further in he went as he ascended the Chains of Reality, the surroundings only became colder and dreary as even the blue luster of the water began to lose its color, the only thing showing light being the golden glow of the floating land mass that was gradually nearing Noah's vision.

The restrictions of his will being restricted to very little area around him and his eyes only being able to see for a small distance with clarity remained- with things only being clearer when he layered his will and vision with TABOO authority and Dimensional Essence.

<The coldness and increasingly dark atmosphere so far is already causing me to narrow it down to two possible Dimensions...but again, I'll need another .25 Uses to speak freely without incurring Karma.>
Lavalliere's voice came at this time as Noah contained his slightly aching heart at the continued devouring of loot that wasn't done by him!

10% of the Supreme Soul Crystal Mountain would fade after this as he had to replenish his reserves of Loot very soon, and the figures of multiple geniuses tied on his waist would help with this when he crushed them after the Resplendent Treasure Emperor became TABOO.
BZZZT!

Arcs of essence left his body as he neared the very end of the Chain of Reality, the floating island slowly becoming clear before his eyes as the golden glow faded and Noah saw what was within this land with clarity.
And what he saw...caused his luminous eyes to tremble and shine with a shocking light as the scene wasn't one that he expected!

The golden glow that seemed to have encompassed the whole island from afar was actually concentrated in one central area from afar, where Noah could see an encased golden crystalline dome that caused his heart to feel a shocking feeling of greed.
His very Origin buzzed when he felt the pull of whatever lay behind that golden crystalline dome as this structure...was the only thing shining with color on the massive floating landmass.

Everything else was utterly dreadful to look at as the husks of crystalline trees showing unmoving dead Cosmos were stretched throughout, the waters here beginning to freeze over as it was terrifically cold and dreary with Noah feeling an assimilated law within him buzz with a bit of fear and excitement...the Law of Death!
What was most shocking was that apart from the barren dead reality trees, Noah could see the monstrous skeletal figures of...
"Lions? Tigers?"

Noah was surprised to find the bony figures that seemed to resemble mountainous feline creatures- the forms of these existences being entirely made of silver-gray bones as blue flames shone brightly from their empty sockets.

Hidden amidst winding bony protections and what seemed like natural bone armor, the dense silver-gray light of a surging Origin could be seen within the chest of every one of these monstrous skeletal beings as this wasn't the most dreadful thing.

What was the most dreadful aspect...was the fact that Noah felt no auras from these creatures on his way here, and nor did he feel any dense auras from them now as he felt like if he blinked, they wouldn't be there again when he opened his eyes!

It wasn't that their Aspects of Existence were dead or that they were mere husks- with Noah being able to affirm this as the moment he stepped off from the Chains of Reality and onto the barren dreary landmass with a golden crystalline dome in the far distance...3 of these skeletal creatures with blinding blue flames in their eye sockets had locked their gazes into him.
From them, he could feel an aura of immense death.
From them...he could feel traces of a foreign Dimensional Essence!

Two were massive Skeleton Tigers with bone wings stretching from their wide backs, and solidified crowns above their heads as their deathly bodies gave off a profound sense of dread and power that exceeded even the Andur who had a few ecritures on his crown that Noah had defeated with ease multiple times over.
Amidst their bone-armored chests, Noah could see the allure of glimmering silver-gray Cosmos lying dead and yet surging with light.
The Third creature was a Skeleton Lion that showed grandeur and grace even in death, brilliant silver-gray bone wings also sprouting from its back as it similarly held a solidified crown!
But what caused Noah's eyes to constrict was the fact that among the gaps of its bone armored chest, he could see the dead Origin that was made up of half Cosmos and half....a Reality.
It seemed like a failed Ascendance as this being's Origin had half-formed into a Reality and then simply didn't go any further!
Yet the aura this creature released was dreadful as it seemed no less than a genuine beginner LEGEND.
THUMP!
Noah's heartbeat could be felt with clarity as his will began to light up with wonder and excitement when he looked at these skeletal monstrosities.
This was because their appearance here would confirm what the traces of the Third Dimension that Noah would come across were!

Looking at the scene of skeletal monstrosities with terrific power before his eyes, Noah felt annoyed that he even had to ask when the being in question had already swallowed the Supreme Soul Crystals!
"Lavalliere?"

<Yeah, I know. I was lost in thought as it is wholly unexpected to find traces of this Dimension here. But seeing these three...it confirms that this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum somehow shared a connection with the Dimensional of savagery and death...>
She paused for no reason whatsoever as Noah listened intently.
"The Niflheim Dimension!>

"The Niflheim Dimension!>

chapters.title: Chapter 1812
paragraphs: The Niflheim Dimension!
Somehow, the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum actually had connections leading back to this Dimension that Noah was learning about at this moment.

<It's a unique Dimensional filled with coldness and death, where Dracolich Dimensional Emperors, Chthonian Dimensional Emperors, Abyssal Human Lich Abominations, Ice Titans, Abyssal Beasts, and many others lead hordes of Legions. Though it is a mystery why traces of this Dimension would be present in an Unexplored Grotto Sanctum...>
A Dimension filled with death as it only caused Noah to look forward to gaining any traces of it at all!
Dracoliches, Chthonian Horrors, Ice Titans, and many more!
"These creatures before me..."
<Should stem from the Abyssal Beast Lineage of the Niflheim Dimension...but their presence here alone is not something normal.>

Lavalliere seemed to be thinking of many things as Noah's gaze was only on the creatures before him, his feet stepping fully into the dreary floating landmass as the blue flames in the eyes of the skeletal existences lit up.
His Eyes of the Kainos Emperor shone over these creatures as information rose up.
<Abyssal Undead Tigris> #%#$*
<Abyssal Undead Tigris> $@*$&
<Abyssal Undead Lioness> #$*$&
Much of their information was jumbled as Noah got very little info from them, with the cause being attributed to the unique protection of the cold and dark essence from the Niflheim Dimension!

And they seemingly knew this as the two Abyssal Undead Tigris moved behind the Undead Lioness, the surroundings of this creature buzzing with arcs of dreadful gray energy as the strongest one stayed at the forefront.

They were smarter than many as they had unique senses that told of the dangers that Noah posed somewhat, the most powerful among them coming forward while 29 dazzling golden Halos and one Black Halo fused into it entirely.
HUUM!

The surroundings burst with an intense sound as silver gray Ascendancy Halos burst from above, showing down with stellar essence while the bodies of the Abyssal Undead before Noah's eyes enlarged multiple times over, radiant silver aurora pairs of wings wrapping around them as they didn't utter a single word to Noah!
They only moved with power and efficiency as Noah heard Lavalliere's voice ring out.
<You're about to experience the uniqueness of creatures from this Dimension.>
The uniqueness of those from the Niflheim Dimension! The first thing Noah had noted was how he didn't sense them when he was coming here, and he couldn't feel them except for his own vision!
At this moment, the eyes of the Abyssal Undead Lioness shone with blazing flames of death as its silver and bony wings flashed.
It seemed to be moving forward as in the next second...
SHAA!
It disappeared.
It wasn't the only one as the other two less powerful Undead also disappeared!
And everything turned silent as only the cold waves of the dreary bodies of water in the surroundings could be felt.
Glacial clusters of ice that had begun to form cracked in the distance as to his wonder, Noah truly couldn't see or feel where the Abyssal Undead had disappeared to!
<Across the 9 Dimensions, experts from Niflheim are known as the Emperors of Assassination. When a truly powerful Emperor moved against you...you won't even know how you died.>
Dreadful existences that you couldn't even sense until it was too late.
And yet...Noah hadn't even fused with his Ascendancy Halos nor cast any defensive skills.
He didn't seem the least bit bothered as he continued walking forward to the only dome of golden light in the distance!
He even talked freely with Lavalliere in the meanwhile when other beings in his position would be grim and be ready for an attack from any direction at such a time.
"Then, I need to find a way to attain control over this essence as well. It will essentially be giving me wings to fly even more ridiculous routes!"
WAA!

His visage was astounding and carefree as even the Abyssal Undead hiding in gaps of Reality that couldn't be discerned that easily even by LEGENDS paused for a second before attacking when they saw his demeanor.
Why wasn't he calling out his Halos and attaining his most powerful state?
Or even preparing a little? Why did it seem like this being was walking across this Domain so freely like it was his home?
BZZT!

The blue flames on the most powerful Abyssal Undead with half of Origin that held a dead Reality surged as its body focused its unique essence and brutality into a single claw that formed into a bony point that would pierce and eradicate the bodies and souls of any existences that couldn't withstand at least 5 Million True Reality Damage Values!
And even if they could, they would still find a dreadful type of Damage coming through as those attacking were utilizing Dimensional Damage Values.
Directionless...an attack shot out!
The sockets of the most powerful Abyssal Undead Beast released baleful flames as its dreadful attack chose to come from above, targeting the head full of dark hair as things moved in slow motion.
SHAA!
The movement of essence and time itself in the surroundings slowed.

The Abyssal Undead Beast could feel its Failed Undead Origin pulse with power as it was an inch away from the dark hair of its enemy when a shockingly cold chill crept within its Origin as its blue flames wavered!

This was because in the next instant, the carefree visage of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor rose his head upwards where the attack essence coming from, a sly smile on his face as the dreadful attack carrying over 5 Million Damage Values thundered towards his very skin!
And even now...no defensive ability or anything was cast.
The Abyssal Undead found this scene unfathomable as its flames began to surge with alarm when its attack landed!
BZZZT!
Space shuddered and became twisted as a shocking scene nearly caused the flames of the Abyssal Undead to dim.
Its dreadful attack that should be capable of even injuring if not defeating a careless beginner LEGEND...was not able to bypass a single inch to even touch a strand of the hair of its target!
And how could it?
How could it pierce the Innate Primogenial Defense Barrier of a monstrous existence with a foundation that was worthy of distinction across the Ages?!

chapters.title: Chapter 1813
paragraphs: BZZZT!
The blue flames of the Abyssal Undead Lioness gazed on in a stupor as it felt like it hit an impenetrable wall that it couldn't pass through no matter what!

This was an Innate Primogenial Defense Barrier that only LEGENDS normally had, but Noah had attained it after exceeding his Limits as it passively wrapped around him with half of the maximum Defense Values he could reach with his strongest form.
Currently...even this half had long since exceeded 10 Million Defense Values as now, it was even tainted by True Dimensional Defensive Values!
BOOM!

The body of the Undead Beast was rebuffed as its silver gray bony aurora of wings kept it floating in the cold seas, gazing at its sharp bony claws and back to the small Royal Human below that was still gazing up with a smile.
An eerie silence came as even the two hiding Abyssal Undead Tigris didn't come out, the most powerful Abyssal Undead just staring dazedly at Noah as it didn't seem to know what to do!

Yet the Tyrannical Emperor nodded as 30 clear white Ascendancy Halos erupted around him- causing the wills of the Abyssal Undead Beasts to swirl with utter disbelief at seeing the weakest type of Halo erupt from this being- and all 30 at that!
The Abyssal Undead Beasts wanted to roar out to this being a unanimous set of words....
'As if we'd believe that!'
Yet Noah didn't even call upon the 10 extra Halos from LETHE as he fused with the authority of 30 Halos.
"Let's call out something simple to test some things out...the Infinite Willow Tree True Form should do."

An incandescent light short from Noah as faced with an Abyssal Undead Beast with traces of the Niflheim Dimension that could rival a beginner LEGEND, he brought forth a portion of his power to see just how much he had grown!

As the Unnamed Kainos Emperor moved to quickly and efficiently terrorize monstrous Undead Beasts, other beings were also making progress towards the floating landmasses that Chains of Reality stretched down from.
Most had their goals to ascend upwards towards the depths of these fantastical cold seas, but others had their own aims and way of doing things!
Midway up one of the metallic Chains of Reality.
A figure was shrouded with a dark gray cloak that melded with the surroundings, but it couldn't hide her thick curves as one could see the outline of a great deal of things beneath this cloak!

This existence was uniquely lying flat on the Chain of Reality, her hands letting out a stellar sheen as she was of the Astral Bloodline...and at the same time not as a blue glow surrounded the Cosmos and stellar bodies shining throughout her body. This blue sheen had a unique signature that could only be found...from the Spirit Race.
A bright solidified crown with the ecritures of <DESO> shone brightly over her head as glimmering radiant hair was tied into a stellar bun.

Her vibrant hands were currently holding on to a shocking weapon that released waves of TABOO, a weapon that seemed to be towards the pinnacle of Technomancy as it glowed with incandescent purple and blue Runic ecritures etched onto an obsidian metallic weapon that had a long cylindrical barrel releasing a terrifying light- this Relic most closely resembling a sniper rifle as it held a vibrant tactical rifle scope that shone with a golden light!

The stellar blue eyes of this unique genius were looking through this scope as she locked on to Pure-Blooded Primordials climbing up the Chain of Reality, the golden scope shining a beautiful white light when it locked on to some beings while realizing a dreadful dark light when landing on others.
The meaning of these lights were only prevalent to this being as the barrel of her TABOO sniper gun focused on the existences that shone with a dark light.
"Little Barrett...let's kill some baddies."
WAA!

She stroked the rifle as it buzzed with terrific power, her finger beginning to squeeze the trigger as a light pull from her actually caused dense TABOO authority to surge into the gun as it aimed at a Royal Human from the Main Reality who was adorned in a solidified crown and climbing up with a cold expression!
The weapon in her hands released a terrific light as in the next instant...
SHAA!
<Nuclear Firmament Piercer>.
A burst of dark and red light flashed.
The curvaceous flesh of this woman trembled from the recoil as her blessed parts trembled.
A genius Emperor below then felt a tingling sensation of doom as before he could even raise his head...
WAP!
A terrifying bullet filled with TABOO authority entirely erased the whole upper half of his body, utterly eradicating his Aspects of Existence in a mere instant!

Chaos bloomed in this region of the Chain of Reality as geniuses from behind looked at this in alarm, their Halos blooming out to fuse with them as in the next instant, the Empress far above the Chain of Reality pulled the trigger another two times as she targetted another two existences that were covered by a dark light on her scope.
PA! PA!

Like bubbles popping, the chest and Origin of a Dragon Phoenix on the same Chain of Reality was eradicated as a large hole appeared, and the majestic visage of a Reality Ursidae with a shining solidified crown had half of his body blown away before he could even react.

Essence exploded out as all those who had witnessed this shocking scene jumped off the Chain of Reality and used the oppressive force of the surroundings to carry them towards the earth as soon as possible, their faces grim as they didn't wish to die from an unknown enemy!

The visage of the existence carrying Astral and Spirit Race Bloodline rose as she breathed out lightly, hoisting the terrifying TABOO Relic behind her back as her will gazed at her solidified throne that was condensing the Ecriture <L>.
With a spring to her step, TABOO authority and Essence of Reality wrapped around her as she continued upwards- no competition behind the Chain of Reality she was on as nobody dared to ascend it!

This existence and a few others were some of those distinguished in this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum...and those that destiny was weaving around them most as each one moved separately at this moment, but those with astounding destinies were bound to meet and clash very soon!
On another one of the dreary Chains of Reality in a different region.
A figure clad in arcs of Aether walked steadily up the Chains of Reality, his body releasing dangerous waves of power at the stage of a LEGEND as he didn't seem like any normal beginner LEGEND!

There was actually someone beside him releasing similar fluctuations of shocking power, this being a man with a brown complexion and devilish handsomeness as he carried two sickles that dripped with a poisonous light.
"You're sure she has that type of body?"
The voice of this genius LEGEND that was in the Firmaments of Ascendancy not too long ago rang out towards Xian who replied with a smile of cruelty and power.

"Yes. And she's actually untouched even now as the only thing I've come to learn as a reason for this is that her father is an Alpha Strata LEGEND from the Royal Humans. But with the established Rules of Engagement here...we can move freely!"
WAA!
A devilish expression pervaded his face as he continued.

"Can you imagine having a Dimensional Royalty under you? After Dual Cultivating with her enough, you can attain the Mythical Meretricious Mirror Physique! Seeing her abundant power...you should have no problem draining more of her vital essence to attain this as well. Since she might be problematic, working together is naturally a solution..."
Mythical Meretricious Mirror Physique! Not a Natural Born Physique, but something that one gained when they took the vital essence of unique existences for themselves.
A look of carefulness and ingenuity crossed Xian's mind as he had learned from his last encounter with this being and how she had reflected his attack easily.
Thus, he sought to work with another being as after finding traces of Katelyn in this region, everything was all but a matter of time.
His eyes released a ferocious flash of Aether as he imagined the silver white hair and the glazed eyes of the arrogant woman below him, his heart already buzzing with excitement as he couldn't wait!

chapters.title: Chapter 1814
paragraphs: Atop a barren island filled with death and coldness, an Abyssal Undead with a failed ascendancy to Reality buzzed with terrific power as it felt a tremendous threat stemming from the Infinite Willow Tree that was radiating color and power!

The blue flames in this existence flashed with worry as Dimensional Essence swallowed its body, disappearing into the surrounding space seamlessly as it could see the enemy was a dreadfully powerful existence. But with the means of the essence from the Niflheim Dimension...they could at least hide in the folds of space as they studied to find any gaps of weakness in their enemy.
Could he truly block an attack equivalent to the power of a beginner LEGEND multiple times?
HUUM!

Essence buzzed as the Abyssal Beasts moved in sequence, ready to unleash hidden attacks with care as at this time...the voice of the being that had taken the True Form of an Infinite Willow Tree buzzed out.
"Oh?"
The Endless branches of the Infinite Willow Tree began to shine with incandescent glows of golden light at this moment.
It was the light of TABOO authority that was many times higher than normal TABOO concepts!
It was something budding and new...it was the light being spread from Noah's True Sanguine Clone after his main body succeeded in the formation of three Seeds of TABOO for three terrifying Edicts.
Each one went to envelop its concept, but one seed in particular was radiating a shocking golden light as it was the Resplendent Treasure Emperor that buzzed with wonder!
An Edict geared towards Loot that Noah had been waiting for this whole time as he hadn't killed any beings in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum yet.
But now...
"There are guinea pigs in front of me and around my waist..."
A devilish will bloomed from Noah's visage as the hidden Abyssal Undead felt a cold chill that shouldn't have even been a possible thing for existences like them to feel!
In the Dimensional Holy Land.

Dimensional Essence was permeating throughout as Noah's slumbering body was soon to wake, within even the two unique Realities some of his souls had landed in about to be resolved as the Third Infinite Dream would soon be complete.
But the budding Seeds of TABOO had incorporated enough wisps of the Natural Laws of Reality as they bloomed at this point in time.
The Clone seated upon the throne felt the changes beginning to echo out as the True Blood of the Main body bubbled madly, Three Bloodlines within it beginning to be elevated past Supreme!
The prompts filled with information began to rain down soon after.
<The Concept of Resplendent Treasure Emperor has been elevated to TABOO.>
<The Concept of Apocalypse has been elevated to TABOO.>
<The Concept of the Tyrannical Emperor has been elevated to TABOO.>
HOOONG!
A resounding sound blared out as Noah's body was bathed with incandescence!
But the light works were only the beginning as colorful essence surged around Noah's visage as he shone with ever-increasing radiance.
Most of all, his Blood was boiling madly as glorious prompts rose from this!
<The Bloodlines brought forth from the Flames of the Resplendent Treasure Emperor, Apocalypse, and the Tyrannical Emperor are undergoing simultaneous elevation.>
The rank of the Supreme Bloodlines began to rise as for this, Noah was expectant...while also curbing his enthusiasm.

This was because he knew the result of attaining a VENERABLE Bloodline from the Sanguine Emperor was special, with this Edict having already been assimilating many Bloodlines to raise itself whenever he gained new Edicts as even before the upgrade of Sanguine Emperor to TABOO- he had its Bloodline at an extremely high level, and it even carried the distinction and authority of the Kainos Era in its name!
So even though the results of the blooming TABOO concepts might not be as wondrous, he still looked forward to it as even then...he was still amazed.
<The Quasi-VENERABLE Ancient Bloodline of the Destiny Stone has been unearthed by the Resplendent Treasure Emperor.>
<The Quasi-VENERABLE Ancient Bloodline of the Outer Azaggoth Terror has been reborn under Apocalypse.>
<The Quasi-VENERABLE Ancient Bloodline of the Reality Horned Lion Emperor has been called upon by the Tyrannical Emperor.>
WAA!
From the three Nomological Edicts, three Quasi-Venerable Ancient Bloodlines were unearthed as they were all Lineages of creatures that appeared in the Olden Era!

Noah somewhat knew about them as the memories of the Olden Will of the Forgotten Reality were nearly assimilated by the Infinite Reality, knowledge of the structure and way of power in the past Age slowly opening up before Noah as the three Lineages he had unlocked...were each unique even though they hadn't reached the VENERABLE stage.

And based on the few memories Noah could claim on the past Age of Destiny, he could almost make an assertion that the Quasi-Venerable Tier of Bloodlines back then had more power, history, and status than the Quasi-Venerable Tier Bloodlines of the current Age!

An example was how the Pure Arch-Royal Human Bloodline that had reached the Quasi-Venerable stage under Noah gave very few renowned boosts, but it was incomparable when putting it face to face with the Lineages of Destiny Stone, Outer Azaggoth Terror, and the Reality Horned Lion Emperor.
The trio of concepts becoming TABOO each held astounding information that continued to surge into him as Noah focused on the Resplendent Treasure Emperor first!
Just what abundant things did it unlock?
The first prompt started off with a bang.
<The Resplendent Treasure Cache has gained 3 additional uses.>

<Absolute Looter has been elevated as now, the Unnamed Kainos Emperor has the choice to forgo all of the Loot of the killed target and instead allow for the formation of a Randomized Loot Crate that when opened, it will provide random items that have appeared before in Resplendent Treasure Caches.>
An incandescent smile rose from Noah's face as he stared at this golden prompt.

<Randomized Loot Crates>!!!

The blue flames in this existence flashed with worry as Dimensional Essence swallowed its body, disappearing into the surrounding space seamlessly as it could see the enemy was a dreadfully powerful existence.
But with the means of the essence from the Niflheim Dimension...they could at least hide in the folds of space as they studied to find any gaps of weakness in their enemy.
Could he truly block an attack equivalent to the power of a beginner LEGEND multiple times?
HUUM!

Essence buzzed as the Abyssal Beasts moved in sequence, ready to unleash hidden attacks with care as at this time...the voice of the being that had taken the True Form of an Infinite Willow Tree buzzed out.
"Oh?"
The Endless branches of the Infinite Willow Tree began to shine with incandescent glows of golden light at this moment.
It was the light of TABOO authority that was many times higher than normal TABOO concepts!
It was something budding and new...it was the light being spread from Noah's True Sanguine Clone after his main body succeeded in the formation of three Seeds of TABOO for three terrifying Edicts.
Each one went to envelop its concept, but one seed in particular was radiating a shocking golden light as it was the Resplendent Treasure Emperor that buzzed with wonder!
An Edict geared towards Loot that Noah had been waiting for this whole time as he hadn't killed any beings in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum yet.
But now...
"There are guinea pigs in front of me and around my waist..."
A devilish will bloomed from Noah's visage as the hidden Abyssal Undead felt a cold chill that shouldn't have even been a possible thing for existences like them to feel!
In the Dimensional Holy Land.

Dimensional Essence was permeating throughout as Noah's slumbering body was soon to wake, within even the two unique Realities some of his souls had landed in about to be resolved as the Third Infinite Dream would soon be complete.
But the budding Seeds of TABOO had incorporated enough wisps of the Natural Laws of Reality as they bloomed at this point in time.
The Clone seated upon the throne felt the changes beginning to echo out as the True Blood of the Main body bubbled madly, Three Bloodlines within it beginning to be elevated past Supreme!
The prompts filled with information began to rain down soon after.
<The Concept of Resplendent Treasure Emperor has been elevated to TABOO.>
<The Concept of Apocalypse has been elevated to TABOO.>
<The Concept of the Tyrannical Emperor has been elevated to TABOO.>
HOOONG!
A resounding sound blared out as Noah's body was bathed with incandescence!

Most of all, his Blood was boiling madly as glorious prompts rose from this!
<The Bloodlines brought forth from the Flames of the Resplendent Treasure Emperor, Apocalypse, and the Tyrannical Emperor are undergoing simultaneous elevation.>
The rank of the Supreme Bloodlines began to rise as for this, Noah was expectant...while also curbing his enthusiasm.

This was because he knew the result of attaining a VENERABLE Bloodline from the Sanguine Emperor was special, with this Edict having already been assimilating many Bloodlines to raise itself whenever he gained new Edicts as even before the upgrade of Sanguine Emperor to TABOO- he had its Bloodline at an extremely high level, and it even carried the distinction and authority of the Kainos Era in its name!

<The Quasi-VENERABLE Ancient Bloodline of the Outer Azaggoth Terror has been reborn under Apocalypse.>
<The Quasi-VENERABLE Ancient Bloodline of the Reality Horned Lion Emperor has been called upon by the Tyrannical Emperor.>
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 1815
paragraphs: The concept blooming before Noah's eyes was astounding enough as he paused incoming prompts to focus on it ever so briefly.

<Randomized Loot Crates>:: Depending on the slain target, different Tiers of Loot Crates will arise from White, Blue, Purple, Gold, and Black Gold. In higher Tier Loot Crates, the rarest items that appeared in Resplendent Treasure Caches in the past and other items similar to them can be obtained. The Bloodlines, Skills, Cores, Edicts, and any other potential loot will be utilized in exchange for the formation of the Randomized Loot Crate...
Different Tiers of Loot Crates existed as Noah got more information on what he could obtain from them!

Apart from the items that had appeared in the Resplendent Treasure Caches in the past, he could also attain similar items as an example would be the Warring Emperor Set items that he had gotten only 2 of so far...he would be able to now get similar items and stand a chance of completing the set.
Then there was something like the Ascendant Dimensional Essence Shard that could nullify resource cost that Noah wanted to get more of!

There was an overabundance of possibilities from this as Noah felt satisfied with the boons of Resplendent Treasure Emperor so far, letting the prompts continue to rain down as he already had Abyssal Undead Beasts and Pure-Blooded Primordial Bloodlines around his waist to crush and see what Loot Crates would form!

<Resplendent Treasure Cache>:: The items found within Resplendent Treasure Caches greatly exceed the spacetime continuum as the Loot found within can be pulled from the Ages of the Last Era of Reality and Dimensions. The Randomized Loot can now include Bloodlines, Techniques, Modus Operandis, Skills, and other rare things that stretched out over the Ages...
The Resplendent Treasure Cache that Noah had regained 3 more chances to use became even more glorious as the variety of things he could attain vastly increased.
And now...this included items across the Ages of the Olden Era!

The idea of this prompted Noah to question...just how many Eras were there before the Olden Era, and how many Ages were in each of them? As for the Kainos Era that was just beginning, how many Ages would it have?
"And where will I be across this Age and the ages to come..."
Noah's voice became heavy and mesmerizing to hear as he pondered of the future, Lavalliere's voice ringing out at this time.

<The one thing I can't fault you on is just how interesting you managed to make your Edicts. For your Resplendent Treasure Emperor to be capable of stretching its fingers across the spacetime continuum to reach back so far due to the sacrifice of your enemies...it should be even more interesting when you can infuse the essence of a single Natural Law of Reality into it.>

She spoke of a dazzling future possibility when the Resplendent Treasure Emperor rose past TABOO, Noah wondering just what it would take for him to be able to visualize and grasp onto the very Natural Laws of Reality while vibrant prompts continued to cascade down.

<While in the Destiny Stone True Form, even more authority over Loot is granted to you as you can gain a glimpse into the possibilities of unopened Resplendent Treasure Caches and choose specific items for a certain price. Taking on the True Form will also grant you the much sought-after ability of Destiny Stones that allows them to see get a glimpse of where the most fortune, Loot, and destiny lies in the region they are in- with the distance covered being as vast as a Grotto Sanctum. This form will also stand a chance to increase the quality of Loot from the Loot Crates that form from slaying enemies not chosen as targets for the Resplendent Treasure Cache...>

The Ancient Bloodline Noah had unlocked with the Resplendent Treasure Emperor rose up once more as its uniqueness and utilization caused Noah's will to focus on it much more, his True Sanguine Clone in the Dimensional Holy Land continuing to observe the prompts and changes that cascaded over his eyes while his Clone of Alexander in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum put it to use!
In the dreary coldness and barren underwater floating landmass where he was facing three hidden Abyssal Undead Beasts.
BZZT!

The many branches of the Infinite Willow Tree were filled with soul flames and currently coiling around the bodies of these massive beasts who thought they couldn't be found after they hid with their unique Dimensional Essence, but Noah had only spread his many branches across space as they buzzed with Dream Essence, instantly locating these existences as <Ascendant Iridescent Soul Flames> had shaken their souls and put them near death with ease!
The enormous bony undead now floated listlessly in the cold and gradually glacial seas, Noah's branches receding as the Infinite Willow Tree form disappeared while he called out lightly.
"Destiny Stone."
HUUM!
An Ancient Bloodline tracing back in the Olden Era.
A bloodline that was filled with destiny and fortune- and something that would bring Noah the allure of boundless loot!
A light of gold bathed the cold and dark seas of this barren island as a radiant and regal form was brought out.

Immensely round and glistening with enticing beauty, a massive smooth stone with an aurora of wings floated with grace as one couldn't see any distinguishing features on it- and below this golden stone, seas of the golden essence of destiny bubbled and fell down like a waterfall to the lands below!

It didn't hold any distinguishing features, but in the next second- a pair of golden slits opened while a wide devilish smile arced across its crystalline stony gold surface, a smile and a pair of eyes that locked onto the suspended bodies of the Abyssal Undead Beasts as a Commandment echoed out from the Destiny Stone.
[Perish].
BOOM...CRACK!

A Commandment backed with an astounding multiplier of the Quasi-Venerable Destiny Stone that had a multiplier of 750 for every 10 Ascendancy Halos that Noah fused with! With the mere 30 Halos Noah fused with, the Dimensional Damage Values of his words or commandments alone were enough to exceed the base 5 million Damage of a LEGEND as these Undead turned into broken bones that were ground to dust an instant later.

The surroundings turned eerily quiet as from the decimated bodies of the three Abyssal Undead Beasts, golden radiance began to shine as ridiculously, two white boxes adorned with thin golden lines and a cerulean box adorned with slightly more vibrant golden lines appeared!
The Unnamed Kainos Emperor had ridiculously forged a reality altering concept that now turned his enemies into glimmering Loot Crates for him to explore!

chapters.title: Chapter 1816
paragraphs: Arcs of dark blue light crossed the underwater region as they caused glacial regions to form and break.

Amidst it was a floating island that connected to the earth below with a chain of Reality, and there were two more Chains of Reality that led further upwards towards an unknown location that wasn't visible to the naked eye!

An incandescently gold Destiny Stone with an aurora of wings behind it and surging seas of destiny below it falling down into waterfalls stared at three glimmering Loot Crates that came from the decimation of three Abyssal Undead Beasts.

Noah had already imposed his will upon them through Ascendant Multilayered Possession before he caused them to perish with a mere word, gaining another TABOO Edict as apart from this- he didn't see anything that would give him a glimpse or access into the Niflheim Dimension!
Even the memories of these Undead were jumbled and a mess of information as from them, Noah barely got to see flashes of vast regions of endless coldness and darkness.
Instead, Noah saw that a possible pathway to the Niflheim Dimension could open up if he had abundant enough fortune when opening the Loot Crates!
The description mentioned one would receive Randomized Loot from these Crates, with High Tier Crates even being capable of bringing out the rare Loot that had appeared in Resplendent Treasure Caches.
Randomized Loot Crates. Everything that would come from them was unknown as Noah wondered what would be considered a High Tier Crate that would bring out the rarest Loot he had attained before.
"Gold? Black?"
The golden eyes of his Destiny Stone true form blazed with a glorious light as his devilish smile remained, his gaze locked onto the glimmering boxes of loot before his eyes!
Two that were White Tier and 1 Blue Tier Loot Crate.
"Open the white Tier Randomized Loot Crates."
HUUM!

Pillars of golden light shot out from the top of the White Crates as they bathed the dreary seas with gold, the waterfall of destiny light below Noah surging as the fortune of the Ancient Bloodline of the Destiny Stone was simply too vast- this form alone giving Noah an increased edge far exceeding the Destiny Goblin Emperor when it came to loot.
<A Precious Bone that an Abyssal Undead Beast has nourished for a million years has been obtained.>
<A Quasi-TABOO Nomological Edict of the Undead Knight has been obtained.>
A concept was added to his soul as apart from this, a radiant white bone in the shape of a crown floated silently above the opened White Tier Loot Crate that was disappearing.
Noah was silent as what he had received...was utterly rubbish!
His eyes scrutinized the 'Precious Bone' of an Abyssal Undead as it didn't do anything aside from looking majestic and having some memories of the Undead that nourished it for a million years.
Meanwhile...the Quasi-TABOO Concept was just that. Noah had thousands of these now!

These were the Randomized rewards of the lowest tier Loot Crate as they caused Noah's radiant form to nearly turn dark, his focus carrying a hint of a threatening tone as it locked onto the Blue Randomized Loot Crate from an existence that had failed their Ascendancy to Reality.
"Surely..."
His eyes were expectant as his destiny shone brightly.
<The TABOO Interchangeable Dimensional Material that can be molded or added to the design of any Relic has been attained.>
<A single Supreme Dimensional Bloodline Shard has been attained. Attaining 10 Shards will allow for the birth of a Supreme Niflheim Dimensional Bloodline.>
Destiny shone brightly as the Blue Tier Randomized Loot Crate did not disappoint!
Two Loot from one crate, and one was a new item that would allow Noah to attain a Supreme Dimensional Bloodline so long as he obtained 9 more of them!
It was a brilliantly shining silver gray crystal Shard that looked like a piece of a puzzle, waiting for 9 other pieces to make it whole.
The other...was a ridiculous material.
<Interchangeable Dimensional Material>.
Something that Noah could add when forging Relics as any born Relic that contained this...would gain abilities leaning towards the Essence of a Dimension.

Noah looked closely at the material that he took into his Expansive Space, seeing a constantly fluctuating crystalline structure that released dense waves of cold and deathly essence as any TABOO Relic made seemed like it would have the dreadful qualities of an essence from the Niflheim Dimension!
"Mmm..." Noah nodded his head at this as he adopted a thoughtful expression.

The enemies on this barren island were killed as he obtained unique new Loot from them, and there was the cluster of gold covering the only Loot of this location as his form of the Destiny Stone floated towards it!
It was still the same crystalline dome that shone with vibrant loot light, and it left behind no gaps or anything to even see what lay within it.

Noah floated above this treasure dome silently as it seemed unbreakable, but his senses as a Destiny Stone told him that something profound lay waiting for him so long as he could get past this barrier!
As for how to do it?

<It's a unique domain barrier that will absorb all attacks and just strengthen itself. The way to get past it is to infuse it with essence- with Dimensional Essence and Essence of Reality being the most efficient.>

Lavalliere's voice echoed out as she still had small decimal points of uses that allowed her to speak freely, Noah's golden round form descending towards this dome as his body began to release waves of Dream Essence downwards.
While this occurred, his will weaved out and pulled out the strings of Mana that he had always tied around his waist- strings that held geniuses of the Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines!
SNAP!

One such string was snapped by Noah as with the Resplendent Treasure Emperor at TABOO, he could eradicate and farm these beings by turning them into Loot Crates or simply choose to eradicate them and attain Loot the old fashioned way with all his Increased Loot Quality and Quantity.
But...would he really kill them just like that?

The snapped Mana string released a handsome Royal Human whose eyes blinked as if he was waking up from a slumber, his gaze coming to land on the profound golden Destiny Stone and the vibrant golden dome it floated on top of.
A sense of fear was instilled in this Primordial's mind when he gazed forward as he could still feel the form of the devilish Alexander that had utterly decimated him from this Destiny Stone!
And the nightmare wasn't over for this being as he heard a voice that made him question everything.
"Hey, go ahead and break through."
WAA!
"A genius with a profound foundation, right? Why don't you...step into the stage of a LEGEND right now?"

The devilish smile on the Destiny Stone only deepened as wondrously, he wanted to see which of his enemies was actually able to become a LEGEND so that his farming was bound to be even more spectacular!

And the nightmare wasn't over for this being as he heard a voice that made him question everything.
"Hey, go ahead and break through."
WAA!
"A genius with a profound foundation, right?
Why don't you...step into the stage of a LEGEND right now?"

The devilish smile on the Destiny Stone only deepened as wondrously, he wanted to see which of his enemies was actually able to become a LEGEND so that his farming was bound to be even more spectacular!

chapters.title: Chapter 1817
paragraphs: Noah had a wondrous control of beings that he had placed under Ascendant Multilayered Possession, but he couldn't do something as pristine as control their Aspects of Existence to undergo a change in Realm- something that as a major undertaking as most couldn't even do it!
But the beings Noah had captured were geniuses who held tens of Reality Passages- beings that stemmed from the Main Reality and were guaranteed to be future LEGENDS!

His will imposed itself on the Royal Human whose body instantly sunk to the ground- the restrictive pressure in this region too high for him to even handle as his eyes carried a trace of profound fear when staring at Noah.
"Go on."
The Tyrannical Emperor's voice thundered in his mind.
"You want a chance to live, right? This is it. You might be able to get past this with the power of a LEGEND."

The words were sweet and terrifying at the same time as at this moment, this genius Royal Human with a head full of golden hair and devilish handsomeness felt his destiny was entirely dark and gloomy.
It meant his path was near its end!
Unless...he took this chance.
BZZZT!

The fear within him when he gazed at the unfathomable existence before his eyes was repressed as his Origin began to move and rotate in a manner described by a unique Runic Ecriture of Modus Operandi.

His Origin came to life as in the next second, his body and soul were also suffused with light as above him, 39 Reality Passages gushed with essence as this being would have no trouble resonating his Aspects of Existence to become a single Strata!
Noah watched on with a sharp gaze as this process was something he had to go through himself, and it eluded many beings even if they had all the requirements.
But a genius was a genius nonetheless.
The terror and fear this Pure-Blooded Primordial had felt along with his immense foundation erupted out at this moment, his three Aspects of Existence beginning to buzz as they sought synchrony.

Noah still had his will imposed on this being as he could feel all of this, seeing fundamental changes beginning to occur as the rotating stellar bodies within this being began to release a fantastical light that gradually formed a stellar barrier!
A long stellar barrier that was clumping all his 100 Billion Cosmos together in a unique manner as they went to actualize a Reality.
HUUUM!

The surroundings buzzed with this being as the vast reserves of Essence from the Reality Passages above his suffused over his body, the resonance between his Aspects of Existence blooming in full as his Soul began to solidify!

It solidified into a vibrant sea that went on to bathe the rotating Origin and Body- these three Aspects of Existence releasing a sound of utter glory as over the skin of this Royal Human, an Innate Primogenial Defense Barrier began to form.
His body released his Ascendancy Halos as they also bathed their authority onto his Aspects, everything about this being undergoing a fundamental change!

At the stage of Reality, a being gained an innate barrier that could defend 5 Million Damage Values as the lowest base, with this barrier only becoming more powerful as they ascended the Strata of this stage.
Along with this...was also their base damage.

Every single skill cast and every strike would also carry at a minimum...5 Million Damage Values. The body of a LEGEND naturally pulled upon the synchronized Aspects of Existence and the authority of their Ascendancy Halos to grant this power, and they would only be bolstered when they attained their True Forms!
"OOOOOH!"
Feeling the boundless power beginning to course through him, this Pure-Blooded Primordial finally felt his fear fading away.
As he felt the barrier of strength form over his body...he felt like he might be able to get out of this situation alive!
HUUM!
A unique blaring of resonance flashed out one last time as within the chest of this being, the allure of a genuine Reality formed.
"Haha..."
As boundless power coursed through this being, his Reality Passages pumped with even more fervor as his confidence returned!
Amidst his changing emotions, he didn't have time to ponder why this being would allow him to become a LEGEND.
"Pride will always be the fall of many, you shouldn't have allowed me to break thro-"
"Sever."

The body of the Pure-Blooded Royal Human had begun to buzz with power as he was about to release all his frustrations when all of sudden, a piercing ray of stellar light filled with malevolent essence a Dimension thundered down at a speed this being couldn't even follow- shredding apart his newly formed Innate Primogenial Defense Barrier and blasting his Primogenial Body, Soul, and Origin into a splatter of stellar pieces!
PAH!

The surroundings quieted down as Noah gazed at all this calmly, focusing on the shattered visage of this being as this time- it formed into a vibrant Purple treasure box that was inscribed with golden runic lines.

A Purple Tier Loot Crate was what formed from a newly risen LEGEND falling under Noah's hands as his will surged into it, causing a flourishing of golden essence to bloom as loot turned into a streak of light that appeared in Noah's Expansive Space!
<10x False Grotto Nacres have been obtained.>
<300 Olden Orbs of Transmogrification have been obtained.>
<A TABOO Reality Jewel has been obtained.>

The allure of wondrous loot bloomed as Noah finally nodded his massive golden body, his devilish smile only becoming wider as the next test he planned to do was the normal method of attaining Loot as he wouldn't choose the option of Loot Crates!
Another string snapped as the figure of a Reality Ursidae enlarged, regaining its senses as its body sank into the barren earth while it heard an undeniable voice echo in its mind.
"Hey, go ahead and break through."

Apart from the wondrous Randomized Loot from Loot Crates, Noah wanted to also kill others and attain their Bloodlines as his goal was to also have all of the 5 Pure-Blooded Primordial Bloodlines under his belt soon enough!

A majestic and kingly Reality Bear heard Noah's words as a terrifying reality unfolded once more in this region, the golden dome protecting the loot of this barren and deathly island slowly beginning to thin under Noah's surge of Dimensional Essence at the same time!
