chapters.title: Chapter 1818
paragraphs: As Noah gave a chance to Pure-Blooded Primordials to break through to the Reality Realm and farmed them thereafter, his will that pervaded over the Dimensional Holy Land was going through the information of the changes brought by through Apocalypse and the Tyrannical Emperor reaching TABOO!

<Under the authority of the Outer Azaggoth Terror, the ability of Reality Devourer is released from its shackles and becomes usable. Requiring 1 Million Units of the Essence of Reality to activate, Reality Devourer forgoes all of the Loot that the Unnamed Kainos Emperor would receive from slain enemies at the Reality Realm in exchange for devouring everything about them with the apocalyptic essence of a Telos. You can also devour genuine Realities with the same cost as the product is receiving a greater understanding of the very Essence of Reality, increasing your Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality as you can better grasp their identity and usage...>

Things paused once more as Noah focused on this singular upgrade that came from Apocalypse. Telos were particularly dreadful existences as they could eat up Realities or parts of Realities- the Ancient Bloodline of Outer Azaggoth Terror falling among those existences that could devour parts of the Main Reality before OPPENHEIMER had caused the proliferation of boundless Realities.
It now seemed their true terror lay in the fact that they could be more in tune the more they devoured Realities- becoming closer and close in affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality!

For one to get past TABOO, they had to be more and more proficient in pulling in the Natural Laws of Reality into their concepts as when they forged enough TABOO Concepts in the hundreds...they could more easily feel the types of Natural Laws around them as the moment they became so familiar that they isolated the essence of a single Natural Law in a concept, they would be able to exceed TABOO.

Telos was one of the Bloodlines that could reach past TABOO even if they weren't extremely talented, and Noah who was an existence who was extremely talented and had boundless destiny...had attained just such a Bloodline as he would have many choices to make in the future!

When he killed LEGENDS, should he allow for their essence to become normal Loot, or select the route of Randomized Loot Crates, or simply devour their Reality for the sake of increasing his Affinity to Natural Laws of Reality as this would allow him to form TABOO concepts faster and eventually open up the pathway for a higher stage?
There were many choices for Noah to make, and his mind buzzed briefly with possibilities before he continued to look at the descending prompts.

<The Domain of Apocalypse has been elevated to the point that when enemies that fall within it are slain without the Authority of their Ascendancy Halos being devoured- the authority of the Halos can instead be added to the Unnamed Kainos Emperor as the pathway past TABOO can be slowly ascended.>

<As the Herald of Ragnarok within the Domain of Apocalypse is elevated, you can now call upon the souls of Eldritch Terrors who have forged their Reality with a sufficient cost of 2 million Units of the Essence of Reality. The Eldritch Terrors last 1 minute within the Domain of Apocalypse as stronger Eldritch Terrors with even more duration can be summoned if Dimensional Essence is inserted in the Domain of Apocalypse. Each summoned Reality Realm Eldritch Terror will take on the role of a Cardinal Sin for a total number of 7 allowable Terrors, with the effects of Outer Eldrich Corruption pervasively spreading throughout the Domain of Apocalypse as unless you perish- those within the Domain cannot leave. Exceptions to those who might be capable of leaving the grasps of the Domain of Apocalypse include those proficient in Dimensional Essence...>

<Apocalyptic Erasure has been elevated to the point that even those with a few TABOO authorities cannot withstand attacks stained with the Essence of Apocalypse. Their very Origins, Bodies, Souls, Memories, Concepts...everything about them can be erased under the banner of Apocalypse if they do not hold sufficient Authority to protect themselves.>

The other surprises of TABOO Apocalypse included a renovation of the skills of Domain of Apocalypse, Herald of Ragnarok, and Outer Eldritch Corruption among others, with the deadliest thing being the fact that now...Noah could actually call upon Reality Realm Eldritch Terrors if he paid a pricy cost of 2 million Units of the Essence of Reality- something that only somewhat powerful Primogenial LEGENDS could afford to pay as even this would leave them entirely drained!
Yet now, an existence like him who had not even tapped the Realm of Reality could call out terrifying existences of this level- albeit for a minute unless he pumped in Dimensional Essence.

Noah loved the effect of the Domain of Apocalypse locking down everything the most as this meant however many existences he locked in this Domain to be his loot...would have a very hard time escaping!
"Mmm..." He gave a nod of appreciation as he moved his eyes over the prompts of the Tyrannical Emperor.

<The Benevolent Light of Empowerment has been elevated to allow for a Third Empowerment that costs ten times more than the Second Empowerment. Everything under the banner of the Tyrannical Emperor can be Empowered- from their Aspects of Existence to their Bloodlines and all the way to his subjects.>
The first round of Empowerment cost 1 True Star of Conquest! The second Empowerment needed 10...and the third Empowerment that just became available required 100 True Stars of Conquest!

The only solace in this was the fact that Noah had close to over 10,000 True Stars of Conquest as his 10,000+ portions of Souls finished returning, so he would be able to empower multiple things about himself thrice.

Part of the reason that Noah might exceed others so much was because his strongest Edicts were Empowered...his Aspects of Existence were empowered...many things about him were as now, they would all be able to undergo a third round of Empowerment.

Noah was planning to be careful with this as he still had not given up on building his foundations even more in the stage he had reached...even if his Aspects of Existence were laying still no matter what he did as they truly foretold that he had reached the absolute limit!

The essence of Conquest would be among the tools Noah still wanted to try utilizing at a destined time as the glorious light of Empowerment...could even this not bring any changes to the Limits of his Aspects of Existence?

chapters.title: Chapter 1819
paragraphs: The surprises of the Tyrannical Emperor weren't done as prompts continued to descend.

<The Nomological Regine disdains the shackles imposed on the concepts of the Tyrannical Emperor as the more Realities that have fallen under his banner, the smoother the path past TABOO becomes as the Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality will be passively increased. When 500,000 Realities have fallen under your banner of Conquest, a dense enough authority and affinity to the Natural Laws would be built up to allow for one chosen concept to exceed TABOO...>
'Are you serious?'
Noah's eyes released beams of light as he wanted to very loudly ask this question!

Only 5,000 True Stars of Conquest were required for him to elevate Resplendent Treasure Emperor to TABOO, with the upgrade past TABOO at this moment not even requiring True Stars of Conquest as it only needed Noah to pass 500,000 Realities in his Dimensional Gourmandizing Reality.
This number was a ridiculous jump from 5,000 Realities as Noah was waiting to see something like 50,000!
His thoughts were buzzing with activity as he sighed at this reality when the voice of Lavalliere interjected.

<Dude...the elevation past TABOO is impossible for most Alpha Strata LEGENDS as only the geniuses of the last Strata of Reality or those past this Realm can have the capability to isolate and include the essence of a Natural Law of Reality in their concepts. Just the sheer ridiculous fact that you can attain this as long as you continue your Infinite Dreams and have your Infinite Reality move around devouring Realities is...haa, I really can't at times...>
Noah didn't even retort back to this ancient treasure as different beings could look at this issue from different perspectives!
Lavalliere thought as she did based on her abundant energy as she knew the norms of Realities and Dimensions...but why should Noah stick to similar norms or even define himself with them?
His thoughts ran wild with tyranny as more prompts cascaded down.

<The Unlocked Quasi-VENERABLE Ancient Bloodline of the Reality Horned Lion Emperor shines with boundless tyranny, this race of beings never falling under the conquest of others in the Age of Destiny as they either perished or became victors of their domains. The unique feature of [Ruler of the Pride] is granted as a sub-ability to [Tyranny of the Soul> as you gain special boons for the existences under your banner of Conquest. A part of their Fortunes, Destiny, Karma, and Fate are culminated and drawn towards you as with the status of the Ruler of the Pride, you shall lead them to boundless glory...>

<Due to increasing reality-altering concepts, authorities, and Physiques attained and displayed solely by the Tyrannical Emperor, the feature of [Oath to Emperor] cannot accurately replicate and strengthen the vassals as stated with its current level of authority. Due to this, the entire authority of Oath to Emperor was redistributed and focused on a single Aspect of the Tyrannical Emperor for strengthening of the Vassals- the Soul. As one of the Aspects of Existence that can be elevated the most without causing a dangerous imbalance, the Soul Strength of the Vassals of the Tyrannical Emperor will be raised proportionally to the other Aspects of their Existence- up until it reaches the maximum point that their Bodies and Origins can handle without bringing about instability due to imbalance...>

The ability of Oath to Emperor was unique as in its description, it theoretically granted Noah's vassals a 50th of his power or even a tenth of his power...but it didn't live up to its description as its authority wasn't enough to truly do what it stated, with the reality-altering authority required to do something like this simply not being enough for a concept that was at Quasi-TABOO and now at TABOO!
So the ability was modified as it now focused on a single Aspect of Noah's.

The soul was the area that Noah had exceeded first, liquifying it and gaining a Primogenial Soul as even then, the strain on his other Aspects of Existence wasn't too horrendous to cause a dangerous imbalance!

Now the souls of his people would be raised to the highest stage they could handle as this...would be the biggest boost for them to build a strong foundation- solely based on how hard it was to elevate one's Soul.
Noah's eyes were filled with thoughtful light as he gazed at one last prompt that showed the wonders of his newly elevated TABOO Edicts.

<Emperor's Haki can now become a tangible force that conceals to oppress your enemies, with those weaker than you in authority finding themselves not even capable of meeting your gaze as the oppressive strength of your Will imposes on them. Haki can be infused into your words, thoughts, or mere movements as those affected by it will lose 50% of their battle capabilities. This ability can now be activated passively to display its effects at all times with the expense of 1,000 Essence of Reality every second. Those who can gaze at the Tyrannical Emperor freely have a level of talent as even then, the only fate waiting for them is to yield or perish!>
The unbound tyranny of this concept could be felt as Noah gained a passive ability that could pressure those below him in stature the moment they stood in his mere presence!
"Good!"
He was happy with the results of the elevation of TABOO for the concepts of the Resplendent Treasure Emperor, Tyrannical Emperor, and Apocalypse as his will moved on to complete more things.

There was the upgrade of RUINATION and forging of other TABOO Relics to be done, the making of an Infinite Dream Automaton to the Realm of Reality, the search for Dream LEGENDS for his Clones to subjugate...and many more things!

Some things like the forging of the ecritures of VITALITY and branding them to his True Blood- the number of these ecritures having exceeded 98 at this point in time as Noah's Blood had yet to reach a limit.

The Infinite Dream also neared completion as only 2 souls were finishing up in two unique Realities Noah had landed in, one being a Forgotten Reality that held unique Relics and history from the Olden Era- but nothing to do with Commander Feng, and the other being an empty Domain full of destructive essence that even weak LEGENDS would treat seriously.

Each had their own intricacies for Noah to go over as the large majority of his focus right now would be placed over the Grotto Sanctum his clone was in...and what he could find here that might give him a chance in exceeding his already exceeded Limits!
Could he really not do anything else unless he became a LEGEND and forged his Reality?
This was a question that needed an ultimate answer as his focus shifted to the dreary deathly landmass where a majestic Reality Ursidae roared out while establishing his Reality.
"POWER!"

The kingly Reality Bear roared out with majesty as dazzling Reality Passaged resonated with his newly formed Primogenial Will, his Aspects of existences suffusing into each other as his soul resplendently bathed his Origin and Body!

The crown above his head dripped with majesty and wonder as his body now glimmered like a collection of Reality, gazing at Noah while bellowing out grandly once more, blades of Quasi-Reified swords beginning to form behind it as it roared out.
"POWEER!"
BZZZT!

Noah looked at this existence he had allowed to break through for the purposes of loot with disdain as his Destiny Stone True Form shone, Emperor's Haki becoming activated passively on this day as the will of the Tyrannical Emperor congealed, Noah's own voice booming out with the same word as the Reality Ursidae as an eradicating will that moved to erase every opposition before his eyes.
The same word...but utterly disastrous and different results bloomed.
"POWER!"

Noah's eyes released beams of light as he wanted to very loudly ask this question!

Only 5,000 True Stars of Conquest were required for him to elevate Resplendent Treasure Emperor to TABOO, with the upgrade past TABOO at this moment not even requiring True Stars of Conquest as it only needed Noah to pass 500,000 Realities in his Dimensional Gourmandizing Reality.
This number was a ridiculous jump from 5,000 Realities as Noah was waiting to see something like 50,000!
His thoughts were buzzing with activity as he sighed at this reality when the voice of Lavalliere interjected.

<Dude...the elevation past TABOO is impossible for most Alpha Strata LEGENDS as only the geniuses of the last Strata of Reality or those past this Realm can have the capability to isolate and include the essence of a Natural Law of Reality in their concepts.

Just the sheer ridiculous fact that you can attain this as long as you continue your Infinite Dreams and have your Infinite Reality move around devouring Realities is...haa, I really can't at times...>
Noah didn't even retort back to this ancient treasure as different beings could look at this issue from different perspectives!
Lavalliere thought as she did based on her abundant energy as she knew the norms of Realities and Dimensions...but why should Noah stick to similar norms or even define himself with them?
His thoughts ran wild with tyranny as more prompts cascaded down.

<The Unlocked Quasi-VENERABLE Ancient Bloodline of the Reality Horned Lion Emperor shines with boundless tyranny, this race of beings never falling under the conquest of others in the Age of Destiny as they either perished or became victors of their domains.
The unique feature of [Ruler of the Pride] is granted as a sub-ability to [Tyranny of the Soul> as you gain special boons for the existences under your banner of Conquest.
A part of their Fortunes, Destiny, Karma, and Fate are culminated and drawn towards you as with the status of the Ruler of the Pride, you shall lead them to boundless glory...>

<Due to increasing reality-altering concepts, authorities, and Physiques attained and displayed solely by the Tyrannical Emperor, the feature of [Oath to Emperor] cannot accurately replicate and strengthen the vassals as stated with its current level of authority.
Due to this, the entire authority of Oath to Emperor was redistributed and focused on a single Aspect of the Tyrannical Emperor for strengthening of the Vassals- the Soul.

As one of the Aspects of Existence that can be elevated the most without causing a dangerous imbalance, the Soul Strength of the Vassals of the Tyrannical Emperor will be raised proportionally to the other Aspects of their Existence- up until it reaches the maximum point that their Bodies and Origins can handle without bringing about instability due to imbalance...>

The ability of Oath to Emperor was unique as in its description, it theoretically granted Noah's vassals a 50th of his power or even a tenth of his power...but it didn't live up to its description as its authority wasn't enough to truly do what it stated, with the reality-altering authority required to do something like this simply not being enough for a concept that was at Quasi-TABOO and now at TABOO!
So the ability was modified as it now focused on a single Aspect of Noah's.

The soul was the area that Noah had exceeded first, liquifying it and gaining a Primogenial Soul as even then, the strain on his other Aspects of Existence wasn't too horrendous to cause a dangerous imbalance!

Now the souls of his people would be raised to the highest stage they could handle as this...would be the biggest boost for them to build a strong foundation- solely based on how hard it was to elevate one's Soul.
Noah's eyes were filled with thoughtful light as he gazed at one last prompt that showed the wonders of his newly elevated TABOO Edicts.

<Emperor's Haki can now become a tangible force that conceals to oppress your enemies, with those weaker than you in authority finding themselves not even capable of meeting your gaze as the oppressive strength of your Will imposes on them.
Haki can be infused into your words, thoughts, or mere movements as those affected by it will lose 50% of their battle capabilities.
This ability can now be activated passively to display its effects at all times with the expense of 1,000 Essence of Reality every second.
Those who can gaze at the Tyrannical Emperor freely have a level of talent as even then, the only fate waiting for them is to yield or perish!>
The unbound tyranny of this concept could be felt as Noah gained a passive ability that could pressure those below him in stature the moment they stood in his mere presence!
"Good!"
He was happy with the results of the elevation of TABOO for the concepts of the Resplendent Treasure Emperor, Tyrannical Emperor, and Apocalypse as his will moved on to complete more things.

There was the upgrade of RUINATION and forging of other TABOO Relics to be done, the making of an Infinite Dream Automaton to the Realm of Reality, the search for Dream LEGENDS for his Clones to subjugate...and many more things!

Some things like the forging of the ecritures of VITALITY and branding them to his True Blood- the number of these ecritures having exceeded 98 at this point in time as Noah's Blood had yet to reach a limit.

The Infinite Dream also neared completion as only 2 souls were finishing up in two unique Realities Noah had landed in, one being a Forgotten Reality that held unique Relics and history from the Olden Era- but nothing to do with Commander Feng, and the other being an empty Domain full of destructive essence that even weak LEGENDS would treat seriously.

Each had their own intricacies for Noah to go over as the large majority of his focus right now would be placed over the Grotto Sanctum his clone was in...and what he could find here that might give him a chance in exceeding his already exceeded Limits!
Could he really not do anything else unless he became a LEGEND and forged his Reality?
This was a question that needed an ultimate answer as his focus shifted to the dreary deathly landmass where a majestic Reality Ursidae roared out while establishing his Reality.
"POWER!"

The kingly Reality Bear roared out with majesty as dazzling Reality Passaged resonated with his newly formed Primogenial Will, his Aspects of existences suffusing into each other as his soul resplendently bathed his Origin and Body!

The crown above his head dripped with majesty and wonder as his body now glimmered like a collection of Reality, gazing at Noah while bellowing out grandly once more, blades of Quasi-Reified swords beginning to form behind it as it roared out.
"POWEER!"
BZZZT!

Noah looked at this existence he had allowed to break through for the purposes of loot with disdain as his Destiny Stone True Form shone, Emperor's Haki becoming activated passively on this day as the will of the Tyrannical Emperor congealed, Noah's own voice booming out with the same word as the Reality Ursidae as an eradicating will that moved to erase every opposition before his eyes.
The same word...but utterly disastrous and different results bloomed.
"POWER!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1820
paragraphs: The Reality Ursidae had roared out the word twice as he bolstered his pride and power after being captured the first time, and Noah returned his word simply as under Emperor's Haki, his voice was sharper than anything in the surroundings!

The majesty of the Reality Ursidae trembled as the forming Quasi-Reified titanic swords trembled before being eradicated completely, the majestic visage of this Reality Bear also being torn apart as his Innate Barrier was shredded along with its body- cracks spreading throughout as stellar golden blood overflowed!
PAH!

The Shockwave of the Haki and the sound waves of the word 'Power' were shockingly the last thing this Reality Ursidae heard, its soul buzzing in disbelief that its newly formed Primogenial Strata could actually be eradicated in such a manner.
Calmness descended as an illusory river of Reality shattered, prompts beginning to shower Noah's eyes as he chose one out of the many methods he had to loot this being.

He could spend 2 Million Units of the Essence of Reality to cast Reality Assimilator as his Infinite Reality Passages would use a unique authority to actually rip out the Reality of his enemies and infuse it onto Noah- granting effects similar to Grotto Nacres!
For this, he wouldn't be able to obtain any loot in the form of Cores as he would still attain their Bloodlines, Concepts, and other forms of loot.

He could also spend 1 Million Units of the Essence of Reality to cast Reality Devourer as this ability erased any chances of loot, devouring everything about the Chosen target as it all went towards increasing the affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality.
Or he could choose the path of the Randomized Loot Crate route and hope his fortune and destiny grant him stupendous items!
Or he could kill them normally like this LEGEND and obtain their Bloodlines, Cores, and whatever other forms of Loot that LEGENDS granted.
Such was the situation now as Noah chose this last option after already experiencing Randomized Loot Crates, wondrous prompts of loot rushing over his eyes soon after.
[+10 Primogenial Blood Pearls have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+1,000 Physique Refining Pearls obtained.]
[+10 Liquified Soul Dews have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+10 Liquified Soul Seas have been obtained.]
[+10 Seeds of Reality have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+10 False Grotto Nacres have been obtained.]
[+100,000,000Trillion Skill Points obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+10,000 Reality Resource Points obtained.]
<The effects of Absolute Looter are applied.>
<...You have already attained the Edicts of the slain enemy.>
<The Racial Bloodline of the Reality Ursidae has been attained.>
"Hmmm..."
Noah's eyes shone with luminous lights as there were new forms of loot for him to go over, and there was also the unique phenomenon of the concepts of killed enemies!

He had already cast Ascendant Multilayered Possession on the slain Reality Ursidae and had copied all of its concepts- so he would just be handed the same concepts he already knew when he killed them! What he didn't have that he attained though...was the racial Bloodline of the Reality Ursidae that he could now take as a True Form when fusing with his Halos.
A racial Bloodline that would also have its Aspects pulled into the Unnamed Kainos Emperor Bloodline as it would just continue to be strengthened!
"Then there's the loot..."

Another string of mana broke as two more Reality Ursidae appeared, Noah beginning to peruse through the details of the new loot while his voice nonchalantly rang out towards the waking geniuses who began to gaze around them with a sense of fear and disbelief as Noah spoke calmly just like before.
"Go ahead and break through to Reality, maybe then you can live."
His words were chilly as always as the two geniuses looked at each other with gloomy faces, feeling the restrictions around them in this region as their destinies saw only one possible path forward.
"OOOOH!"
They bellowed out their yells as they began the process of breaking through, Noah ignoring these two future loot sources as his eyes focused on the details of the Loot from LEGENDS.

<Physique Refining Pearl>:: A dense cluster of unique Reality altering essence that can refine the aspect of the Body beginning at the Primogenial Strata. The True Blood and strength of the Body will continue to be refined to a greater level as it can accept more and stronger Physiques...

<Liquified Soul Sea>:: A vast collection of soul power into a surging sea that is suitable for expanding one's soup towards crystallization, and it is even more usable after the crystallization of the soul...

<False Grotto Nacre>:: An imitation of the unique Grotto Nacre that is naturally formed from the densest Domains of Grotto Sanctums over time. It can refine two chosen Aspects of Existence beginning at the Primogenial stage at the same time while granting a slight increase to the Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality...

The description of the False Grotto Nacres that also appeared from a Randomized Loot Crate finally showed themselves as they were tools that cultivated one's Aspects of Existence along with the Physique Refining Pearls and Liquified Soul Seas!

They were stupendous tools for Noah to attain as all this time, his Aspects of Existence flowed uninterrupted as they didn't accept anything else- truly saying they had reached the limits of all limits as nothing would happen to them.

Yet Noah still wanted to try as in the Dimensional Holy Land, the True Sanguine Clone near the main body took out a False Grotto Nacre that stemmed from a Quintupled one- RUINATION having already listened to Noah's Will to only multiple one Nacre before her Upgrade and subsequent capabilities to multiply things to an even greater level.
The False Nacre looked like a massive mineral forged from the stars holding within it a massively flowing river of Reality that constantly coiled around this mineral like a snake!

It had a rounded bottom and golden crystalline edges that shot upwards, Noah's True Sanguine Clone bringing this above the main body before crushing it with his will as stellar golden nectar began to leak out from this False Grotto Nacre and wash over Noah's body.
It sank and wrapped into his vibrant Origin and Soul as it sought to sink into the Trillion Cosmos within and the vast liquified blue sea that couldn't expand any further, but...
Nothing occurred.
HUUM!

The dreadfully vibrant energy that was full of life from the False Grotto Nacre could not pervade into the Cosmos nor cause the blue soul sea to expand or crystallize as it only slid into the gaps between Noah's Origin and lay calmly- telling him once more to simply resonate his Aspects of Existence and forge his Reality for him to use all this essence!
Once more, Noah was denied exceeding already exceeded Limits as even loot from LEGENDS that was usable for those who had forged the Realm of Reality...was not usable for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1821
paragraphs: Yet another failure in this aspect of his tasks as Noah truly could not make any headway into exceeding absolute limits- everything telling him his current foundation that was distinguished across the Ages was more than enough as he should just forge forward!
But...

'Could OPPENHEIMER really not also be a Triple Limit Breaker? I'm sure there are Single and Dual Limit Breakers in this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum alone...much less to say those who didn't come from the mean Reality.
He pondered whether others with astounding foundations could have also reached this stage as for him...it meant it wasn't enough!
This was because they had lived for Millions and billions of years to get to their extreme foundations while he....he had only started for over a year.
He still had time to explore and make sure that his foundation...would be something that those in the Ages past and those in the Ages to come could not replicate!

But this still didn't prevent him from becoming slightly frustrated as just when the two Reality Ursidae LEGENDs began to roar out with power after achieving Reality in the gradually freezing seas above the Chains of Reality, a glimmering laser of stellar Dimensional light shot out and blasted one of them apart while the other...became suspended as his Reality Passages dimmed when a Massive Infinite Reality Passage appeared above the cold seas.

One Reality was shattered as it turned into a Randomized Loot Crate, the other taking the experiment to have their Reality Assimilated and pulled out through the Infinite Reality as Noah's Haki oppressively wrapped around this being and caused a horrific phenomenon!
With his vibrant Reality Passages dimmed, the flow of essence actually reversed as Noah paid 2 million Units of the Essence of Reality to bring about this shocking result.

Essence reversed as instead of washing down vibrant waves of power, this being own Reality Passages began to tug and pull on his Origin as above Noah, a massive Infinite Reality Passage swirled with a terrifying pull!
And like a gory scene of a Skeleton being pulled out from the muscles and organs of the body, the chest of the Reality Ursidae split apart as a glimmering illusory Reality began to be pulled out

Pain and disbelief filled the genius who had just stepped into the Realm of Reality as his eyes dimmed soon after, his very forged Origin flowing from his body and through his dimming Passages as it was then transferred into Noah's massive Infinite Reality Passage.
And just like essence nourishing Noah, it turned into a massive cluster of stellar light that glowed from his passages to enter into his very body!
HUUM!

The genuine Primogenial reality of another existence suffused into him as it should have raised his own Strata even by a little...but nothing occurred as the Essence once more converted into wisps of golden rivers that sank into the gaps of his Cosmos and body- waiting to be used when he broke through.
[+5 Primogenial Blood Pearls have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+500 Physique Refining Pearls obtained.]
[+5 Liquified Soul Dews have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+500 Liquified Soul Seas have been obtained.]
[+50,000,000 Trillion Skill Points obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+5,000 Reality Resource Points obtained.]
<The effects of Absolute Looter are applied.>
<...You have already attained the Edicts of the slain enemy.>
<...You have already attained The Racial Bloodline of the Reality Ursidae.>

The other Ursidae had been turned into a radiant Purple Tier Randomized Loot Crate that shone with an even brighter shade of gold than the Crate that came from the failed Reality Abyssal Undead Beast as the prompts apart from Noah gaining False Grotto Nacres came, with the rest of the Loot even being reduced by half as Noah had pulled out the Reality of his target that had resonated with the Soul and Body for the purposes of <Reality Assimilation>.

He faced the same result as after butchering newly advanced LEGENDS freely for his own purposes, he wanted to wrap everything up and continue with the exploration and mysteries of this unique Sanctum he was in- with the Golden barrier his form of a Destiny Stone was floating above thinning and nearly disappearing at this moment to reveal the allure of multicolored Loot that should be real Grotto Nacres!
SNAP! SNAP! SNAP!...

Multiple Mana strings snapped as Noah freed all his current captives, the visage of Andur, an Infinite Willow Tree, and another Reality Ursidae...multiple genius Pure-Blooded Primordials that had grand destinies and prospects all appeared, Noah nonchalantly voicing towards them with the same level of coldness.
"Break through to Reality and stand a chance to live."
Despairing words as while they were still under Noah's Ascendant Multilayered Possession, the prospect of escaping was sensed for them as they could only fight!
ROAAR!

The bodies of the enlarged beings glittered with light as they each did what they could to fight for their lives, Noah's focus going into the golden-domed barrier that finally shattered after he infused waves of Dimensional Essence into it, revealing the wonders within as instead of luminous joy when Noah saw it...
His will buzzed with carefulness.

Enormous multicolored crystalline stellites with rounded bottoms and pointed crystalline edges that rose like rivers of Reality could be seen, but they were situated in such a manner as they read into an ecriture!
An ecriture...that meant <WELCOME>!
WAA!

It was a simple word that glowed gold due to what materials were used to make it, but immense coldness and brutality could be felt from it as anyone who came across it would feel anything but what the word intended.
Noah's destiny began to buzz with activity.

His Fate, Fortune, and Karma also began to wake as he felt the tides changing- a sense of danger that someone like him should not feel in a place like this beginning to rise when his will stared at the ecriture of WELCOME outlined by incandescent Grotto Nacres!
It was a terrifying finding as it meant these fantastical loots that even LEGENDS fought for...were arranged neatly and then surrounded by a dome through the will of another.

It meant...this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum was actually not Unexplored as there should lie a Will or multiple Wills within, the cold and dreary seas around Noah seeming all the more suffocating at this truth!
"Lavalliere?"

<...It is a naturally formed Grotto Sanctum by all means, with it being under heavy restrictive laws that should have been made possible with the influence of the Niflheim Dimension. But it seems there is something more at work here as you can only find out if you keep on going forward. Buy one thing remains the same, since the formation of this Grotto Sanctum, the obstruction of this from the Reality Realm and above from entering has remained the same. So all beings who entered through here...had to have been in the Firmaments of Ascendancy.>
WAA!
Lavalliere's words rang out in Noah's mind as his Destiny Stone Form adopted a devilish smile even as he felt the sense of danger!
"So long as this remains to be true...let's see who is bold enough to be leaving behind Grotto Nacres as enticement!"

His Fate, Fortune, and Karma also began to wake as he felt the tides changing- a sense of danger that someone like him should not feel in a place like this beginning to rise when his will stared at the ecriture of WELCOME outlined by incandescent Grotto Nacres!
It was a terrifying finding as it meant these fantastical loots that even LEGENDS fought for...were arranged neatly and then surrounded by a dome through the will of another.

It meant...this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum was actually not Unexplored as there should lie a Will or multiple Wills within, the cold and dreary seas around Noah seeming all the more suffocating at this truth!
"Lavalliere?"
<...It is a naturally formed Grotto Sanctum by all means, with it being under heavy restrictive laws that should have been made possible with the influence of the Niflheim Dimension.
But it seems there is something more at work here as you can only find out if you keep on going forward.
Buy one thing remains the same, since the formation of this Grotto Sanctum, the obstruction of this from the Reality Realm and above from entering has remained the same.
So all beings who entered through here...had to have been in the Firmaments of Ascendancy.>
WAA!
Lavalliere's words rang out in Noah's mind as his Destiny Stone Form adopted a devilish smile even as he felt the sense of danger!
"So long as this remains to be true...let's see who is bold enough to be leaving behind Grotto Nacres as enticement!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1822
paragraphs: In the floating landmass surrounded by glacial waves of deathly sea water.

Enormous multicolored crystalline stellites with rounded bottoms and pointed crystalline edges that rose like rivers of Reality were grasped into Noah's hands, information about them entering his mind as these were the true and genuine Grotto Nacres!
False Grotto Nacres that Noah could attain as loot could only strengthen two Aspects of Existence. But the genuine Grotto Nacres were much different.

<Grotto Nacre>:: An amalgamation of Reality altering essence that is naturally formed from the densest Domains of Grotto Sanctums over time. It can refine all of one's Aspects of Existence beginning at the Primogenial stage at the same time while granting a slight increase to the Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality, and also a strengthening effect to one's Reality Passages.
Stupendous treasures that LEGENDS sought as they cultivated everything of their Strata simultaneously while increasing their Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality.
Even more, they could achieve a strengthening effect on their Reality Passages as this was something sought after by the masses of geniuses!

This was different for Noah as his Infinite Reality Passages were already massive and unique, and they were also about to undergo a change as the Third Infinite Dream finished and the Infinite Reality completed its change to a Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.

Noah was lost in his own thoughts as he wondered about the identity of those leaving behind the <WELCOME> while playing with the Grotto Nacre with his will, but an explosive storm of Essence erupted before him as Andur and the others released their foundations to achieve Reality!

The Infinite Willow Tree and Reality Ursidae got ready to attack Noah while Andur...he actually reigned in his aura as the majestic form of a Dragon Phoenix with layers of flaming tails caused the swathes of the freezing glaciers in the surrounding seas to melt.

He gazed towards Noah with calmness and solemnity as this genius with multiple Runic ecritures was also proficient in Destiny, and he saw that even after becoming a LEGEND...the darkness around his destiny didn't change as he had truly kicked a dangerous snake this time around!
Even after forming a Reality, this being that had actually possessed him already didn't even seem approachable in terms of power.

So he didn't attack while the other two that had just formed their Realities moved against the vibrant form of the golden Destiny Stone, his voice actually resonating out to say words it never thought it would say in its lifetime.
"Spare me."
HUUUM!
The other two geniuses who were moving with restored pride and fervor trembled in shock at hearing such words from the strongest of them- especially a prideful existence from a distinguished Lineage!
"Andur, what are you doing?! We have achieved Reality while he is just at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy still! He can't withstand attacks from three LEGENDS all at once!"
The words of the Reality Ursidae echoed out as his solidified crown shone with majesty, but Andur still contained his power as he still didn't make a move.

The more he stared at the vast Destiny Stone before them that twirled with Grotto Nacres as if they were nothing, the more his destiny told him how abysmal things were as for the sake of survival, he forcefully destroyed his pride and...
The majestic form of the Dragon Phoenix actually bowed its head.
HUUM!
"Please. Spare my life."
A scene that the Infinite Willow Tree and Reality Ursidae couldn't fathom occurred as a being with a solidified crown and multiple ecritures actually bowed himself to another.
Why didn't he even try when it was the three of them against a single being?!
The majesty of the Reality Ursidae rose crazily as his illusory Reality shone with his bellow.
"Why the fu-"
BZZZT!
A deadly ray of stellar multicolored light filled with the oppressive might of a Dimension shot out as it smashed into the Reality Ursidae before chaining onto the Infinite Willow Tree as well.

The souls and wills of these existences trembled as when they gazed at their bodies, they found their Innate Primogenial Defense Barriers that should have exceeded 5 Million in Defense Values utterly shredded as their bodies were breaking apart to follow them soon after.
'So...that was why he bowed his head...'
This was the last thought in the mind of the unwilling Reality Ursidae as his will faded!

Amidst this shocking progression of events, Andur kept his head down as he ignored every will of pride and arrogance ingrained from the Main Reality- bowing even further down until the glittering scales on his chest touched the cold seafloor.
His millions of years of Existence were telling him to fight!
His very Aspects of Existence and authority as a Kainos Emperor Candidate were trembling as they couldn't accept an Emperor bowing his head, the ecritures surrounding his crown trembling!
Yet his head did not rise up as he could see that his destiny did not turn entirely dark.
"Hmm."
He heard the mesmerizing voice of the being without a crown above his head as he could sense the life forces of two newly Risen LEGENDS were no more!
"I was going to kill you."

Such dreadful words echoed out as the vibrant Destiny Stone shone with light and faded, the radiant devilish handsome existence adorned in Obsidian loose pants and shirt appearing as a single golden wing flapped behind him.

His visage was mesmerizing and would be the downfall of many women as he floated towards the bowing Dragon Phoenix, his dark hair glowing in the cold seas as he appeared right in front of the majestic draconic head that had purple gold rising horns swirling with the Essence of Reality!
Andur stayed silent while bowing as he felt like a crucial moment had come that would decide everything.
The being in front of him had unfused with his Ascendancy Halos as if Andur made a move now, he might just be able to take him by surprise!
But before this thought rose, Andur saw his destiny entirely turn black as an instant later his body flashed, his Ascendancy Halos parting away from his body.
The Illusory Reality Passages above him faded as he took away all his forms of protection, an action that went against every cell in his body as he spoke once more!
"Please."
It was an unfathomable action, but Noah nodded towards this astounding Candidate Emperor of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage of the Main Reality as he spoke out simply!
"Offer your Blood."

chapters.title: Chapter 1823
paragraphs: A devilishly handsome figure of Noah's clone floated above a bowing majestic Dragon Phoenix as the scene would shock any knowledgeable geniuses from the Main Reality!

Noah's eyes shone with tyranny as he spoke, the claws of Andur rising silently as they tore open the chest of this magnificent Dragon Phoenix and caused radiant stellar crimson gold True Blood to flow out without so much as a delay.
Hematopoietic Progenitor was activated as all this blood surged into Noah's body, a prompt appearing soon after.
<The Racial Bloodline of the Dragon Phoenix has been attained.>
Noah's body shone with incandescent radiance as he nodded, his next words being even more domineering!
"Offer your Fealty."
The heart of a genius Emperor from the Main Reality trembled as never in a million years would he have foreseen doing this in order to keep his life after entering the Grotto Sanctum!
The Essence of the Tyrannical Emperor roared out and wrapped around this majestic Dragon as the identity of this being appeared within Andur's mind.

His darkened destiny was gradually brightening up as this Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage sighed in his heart, knowing this action would forever cut him off at the possibility of the seat of the True Emperor as while suppressing his pride with every part of his will, he bound himself!
"I pledge Fealty..."
The solidified crown above Andur shone and flashed as the ecritures above it shockingly began to crumble!
"...to the Tyrannical Emperor."
CRACK!

The ecritures floating above his solidified crown fractured in a shocking manner as his heart felt like it was being pierced by millions of stellar needles, Andur binding himself to another being as at the same time...he was shocked to find that began to feel a sense of...
'Freedom?'

The heart of this genius resigned itself as compared to the other beings that had perished in Noah's hands, he could be considered smart to do what he did as at this moment, it allowed his life to be saved.
But this wasn't all.

A change was happening with his authority as just when he felt like even his solidified crown would shatter, immense authority washed down from the being he had pledged Fealty to as golden incandescence began to suffuse over his crown!
From the shattered remains of ecritures, new ones actually began to form as with disbelief, Andur's will watched as the letters <VAS> formed above his crown with splendor.
This wasn't all as soon after, the effects of Oath to Emperor kicked in as Andur shockingly felt his Primogenial Soul...begin to rise up powerfully in strength!

The Primogenial Soul of a being at the stage of Reality....was being strengthened by an existence that had yet to form his Reality as Andur finally understood just why this unfathomable being could erase genius LEGENDS with relative ease.
His bowed head raised for the first time in a while to gaze upon the one he had pledged Fealty to as his eyes nearly dimmed.
Above the devilishly handsome visage of this Tyrant, Andur could see a gloriously multicolored solidified crown that had the shocking ecritures of <ETHEREAL DIME EMPEROR>!

Ecritures that caused the mind of this being to buzz- and they were the ecritures that had come by through Noah's very hard effort of wiping out the few LEGENDS with Solidified Crowns in the past few minutes.

He used to have <ETHEREAL D EMPEROR> after he became bound to Dimensional Essence and set himself on an unshakable path, a path that showed his crown was bound to have Ethereal Dimensional Emperor at its helm as his authority shone with boundless glory.
Seeing the shocking visage of this being and the shockingly surging strength of his Primogenial Soul, Andur let go of everything as he called out with difficulty!
, m "...S-Sire."
A term that his parents would be shocked to hear him say that the Elders of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage would find it treasonous and preposterous!

Yet he couldn't help but say it as this existence let go of his qualifications to be a True Emperor and learned that the term genius truly shouldn't be applied to many of the existences within this Grotto Sanctum.
"Mmm."

Noah gave a light smile to the Dragon Phoenix as he patted its head, his figure going forward to stand between the golden purple horns of the draconic head of this genius as he gazed at the new mount he had gotten.
Yes.

A Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage could only serve to be his mount as he appreciated the Dragon Phoenix whose scales glimmered purple and gold, its wings feathered and glorious stretching from its back with the same vibrant colors as flames even blazed around them.
Three flaming tails stretched out behind it as they released powerful waves of heat that even melted the surrounding coldness!
A LEGEND Dragon Phoenix that had just forged its Primogenial Strata...would serve as his mount!

Noah's feet stable stood above the draconic head of this majestic creature as he looked around the barren land he had taken the treasures of and destroyed the Abyssal Undead Beasts, multiple chains rising from this landmass that went upwards endlessly as the sea further ahead was solidifying into pure glacial ice- making ascension upwards a near impossibility for many.

The gains of this floating landmass were many as even more recently, Noah attained two more glimmering Purple Tier Randomized Loot Crates that stemmed from the killed Infinite Willow Tree and Reality Ursidae that he put away to open later.

When he gazed at the snaking Chains of Reality leading to an unknown location, Noah wanted to begin heading upwards right away...but his destiny was telling him that for even more glory, there was another direction he needed to head to.
"Dictum Emperor needs to be TABOO soon to make things even clearer..."
He spoke out simply as the Dragon Phoenix below him trembled while speaking out.
"Where shall we go, Sire?"

It sought for direction as this genius entirely erased its pride when it continued to feel its Primogenial Soul still strengthening until it couldn't anymore because it had vastly exceeded his Body and Origin!

Whatever repercussions his Fealty would have towards his Lineage and the larger picture didn't matter now as Andur's Will began to undergo reformation to understand this new being he had bound himself to.

Noah turned away from the Chains of Reality snaking upwards endlessly as he turned right and left, seeing a Chain of Reality in each direction that led to other floating landmasses in this region as he waved his hands to pull out a golden book that shone with Destiny.

Lines began to appear on it as Noah adopted a thoughtful look before keeping his head to the left side, going forward and sitting in front of the horn on the right side of the head of the Dragon Phoenix below him as he treated this area like it was his throne- his hand patting the scales of this Vassal as dense Dream Essence and the Essence of Reality surged from him to wrap around its whole body!
"Let's go."

Noah chose the direction as his Dragon Phoenix flapped its flaming wings, its four golden purple scaled limbs cracking apart the frozen lands below it as it shot to the left of the barren island filled with coldness, the speed being no less than Noah's own as Andur was feeling great shock while being bolstered by vibrant Dream Essence!

Its golden purple claws stepped on the Chains of Reality as it shone with dazzling light, the restrictions loosening slightly as a new mount and its Master began moving across it towards an unknown location.
It was a scene that anyone coming across would question as they might not even trust their own vision!

chapters.title: Chapter 1824
paragraphs: In a different region of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

The fantastical scene of a mesmerizing young woman adorned in a silver dress could be seen, one of her fair hands gripping tightly onto the cylindrical end of a weapon that only became larger and larger towards the opposite end that was the form of a crystalline silver mirror like hammer!
This being was adorned with a crown that had the words <SACRALIZED EM> on it, grasping the massive hammer that was many times her size as it even seemed unnatural.

It caused the surrounding space to buzz as even though the cold seas were extremely stable with the space of this Grotto Sanctum being made extremely stable, it still crackled and buzzed as she swung this hammer effortlessly downwards- bringing with it terrifying swirls of Dimensional Essence!

The poor target of this strike was a badly malformed Abyssal Undead Anaconda who seemed to have already formed its Reality, its body covering nearly a fourth of the barren and cold landmass as much of its bones were currently broken or turned to dust.
BANG!

The hammer thundered on this Abyssal Undead Anaconda once more as its serpentine draconic head began to cave in, this Undead at the level of a LEGEND screaming out unfairness as it felt its very Dimensional Bloodline be oppressed by this young woman before it.
BANG!
As she swung the Mirror Hammer effortlessly with her gaze calm, the blue flames on the sockets of the Abyssal Undead Beast turned dim with unwillingness as its Origin broke apart!
'Why is a Dimensional Royalty like you here bullying little old me? Ah!'

A melancholic thought passed through its mind as it was the last thing, the ravaging Mirror Essence that had permeated the surroundings sinking into and shattering its origin into countless Mirror Shards at this moment.
The Undead Reality of the Anaconda shattered and faded as the culprit to do all this- the Adjudicator Katelyn, floated across the cold waters calmly as the Mirror hammer faded away.

She came to float above the pulverized Abyssal Undead Beast as she patted its shattered skull, her expression showing complex emotions as she sighed and moved forward to the dome shaped golden barrier at the center of this landmass that swirled with a treasured light of destiny.

Her fair finger landed on this tough barrier for a few seconds as she felt its indestructible defense, but she uniquely didn't start infusing the barrier with essence or attack it as instead- an illusory authority of a black Halo flashed while she tapped onto the golden dome once!
BZZZT!

In the next instant, a unique scene manifested as a thin silver line appeared above the golden dome, this line showing a reflection of the dome barrier as it shockingly recreated the whole nearby area to be reflecting onto itself!

Katelyn's eyes flashed with a terrifying silver light as her hands reached into the crystalline silver mirror like reflection of the golden dome, her eyes lighting up as she pulled out a cluster of glimmering Grotto Nacres from it.
Nacres...that were clustered into the ecriture of <WELCOME> that when Katelyn saw, her gaze became even sharper.
CRACK!

The Mirror line she had drawn faded as the reflection of the golden dome faded- but the treasures within were already gone as a silver gateway appeared beside Katelyn where all the Grotto Nacres disappeared into!
It was a wondrous and unique power, and the existence to wield it was even more unique.

She gazed around the barren land around her thoughtfully as the words <WELCOME> flashed over her eyes that soon turned up to see the Chains of Reality leading to unknown areas forward, about to continue her ascension when all of a sudden...
"Oh?"

She couldn't help but speak out as she felt terrifying malice and Essence rising from behind her- from the Chain of Reality that should be leading all the way down to the first region of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum!
SHAA!
With valor and power, two terrifying auras rose up from the Chain of Reality as the oppressive might of two LEGENDS appeared.
They flashed with utter wildness and malice as at the very forefront, the figure of Xian could be seen as his whole surroundings were bathed by storms of Aether.
Beside him was a brown skinned young man with an air of poisonous allure, two sickles with a deathly green light buzzing in his hands as his eyes released a green hue!
"Haha!"
Xian let out a wild laugh as his gaze landed on Katelyn, the concentration of Aether around him getting even denser as he walked forward fearlessly.
"You haven't forgotten me yet, right? I couldn't freely make moves back then with Brightborn there, but you...you're really a fruit that I truly cannot pass up."
BZZZT!

His words were powerful as 30 dazzling Ascendancy Halos erupted and were ready to merge into him, the other monstrous genius from the Olden Times beside him doing the same as he released a horrific verdant light when he spoke.
"You really weren't lying Xian! Why don't I take first dibs with her? I'm sure you can feel how dangerous this will be."
Yes!

These two existences appeared here with their own aims, and they affirmed their target as well as the fact that their destinies told them it would be an extremely difficult task to achieve their goal!
"I might have had to run away with nothing if I came alone." Xian nodded his head as his Will tried to discern destiny and Karma.

He had lived in the Olden Era as he knew how important understanding destiny was, and he wouldn't normally take risks that showed the level of danger that he was feeling right now when facing this calm young woman before him.
"But if she was easy to take down, then she wouldn't be a Dimensional Royalty. Let's not tarry too long...make your move, Dion!"
WAA!

His lips curved in a devilish smile as he spoke, his figure shooting to the left while Dion shot to the right, circling Adjudicator Katelyn from different directions as they prepared for a tough battle!

sentences.text: In a different region of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

The fantastical scene of a mesmerizing young woman adorned in a silver dress could be seen, one of her fair hands gripping tightly onto the cylindrical end of a weapon that only became larger and larger towards the opposite end that was the form of a crystalline silver mirror like hammer!
This being was adorned with a crown that had the words <SACRALIZED EM> on it, grasping the massive hammer that was many times her size as it even seemed unnatural.

It caused the surrounding space to buzz as even though the cold seas were extremely stable with the space of this Grotto Sanctum being made extremely stable, it still crackled and buzzed as she swung this hammer effortlessly downwards- bringing with it terrifying swirls of Dimensional Essence!

The poor target of this strike was a badly malformed Abyssal Undead Anaconda who seemed to have already formed its Reality, its body covering nearly a fourth of the barren and cold landmass as much of its bones were currently broken or turned to dust.
BANG!

The hammer thundered on this Abyssal Undead Anaconda once more as its serpentine draconic head began to cave in, this Undead at the level of a LEGEND screaming out unfairness as it felt its very Dimensional Bloodline be oppressed by this young woman before it.
BANG!
As she swung the Mirror Hammer effortlessly with her gaze calm, the blue flames on the sockets of the Abyssal Undead Beast turned dim with unwillingness as its Origin broke apart!
'Why is a Dimensional Royalty like you here bullying little old me?
Ah!'

A melancholic thought passed through its mind as it was the last thing, the ravaging Mirror Essence that had permeated the surroundings sinking into and shattering its origin into countless Mirror Shards at this moment.
The Undead Reality of the Anaconda shattered and faded as the culprit to do all this- the Adjudicator Katelyn, floated across the cold waters calmly as the Mirror hammer faded away.

She came to float above the pulverized Abyssal Undead Beast as she patted its shattered skull, her expression showing complex emotions as she sighed and moved forward to the dome shaped golden barrier at the center of this landmass that swirled with a treasured light of destiny.

Her fair finger landed on this tough barrier for a few seconds as she felt its indestructible defense, but she uniquely didn't start infusing the barrier with essence or attack it as instead- an illusory authority of a black Halo flashed while she tapped onto the golden dome once!
BZZZT!

In the next instant, a unique scene manifested as a thin silver line appeared above the golden dome, this line showing a reflection of the dome barrier as it shockingly recreated the whole nearby area to be reflecting onto itself!

Katelyn's eyes flashed with a terrifying silver light as her hands reached into the crystalline silver mirror like reflection of the golden dome, her eyes lighting up as she pulled out a cluster of glimmering Grotto Nacres from it.
Nacres...that were clustered into the ecriture of <WELCOME> that when Katelyn saw, her gaze became even sharper.
CRACK!

The Mirror line she had drawn faded as the reflection of the golden dome faded- but the treasures within were already gone as a silver gateway appeared beside Katelyn where all the Grotto Nacres disappeared into!
It was a wondrous and unique power, and the existence to wield it was even more unique.

She gazed around the barren land around her thoughtfully as the words <WELCOME> flashed over her eyes that soon turned up to see the Chains of Reality leading to unknown areas forward, about to continue her ascension when all of a sudden...
"Oh?"

She couldn't help but speak out as she felt terrifying malice and Essence rising from behind her- from the Chain of Reality that should be leading all the way down to the first region of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum!
SHAA!
With valor and power, two terrifying auras rose up from the Chain of Reality as the oppressive might of two LEGENDS appeared.
They flashed with utter wildness and malice as at the very forefront, the figure of Xian could be seen as his whole surroundings were bathed by storms of Aether.
Beside him was a brown skinned young man with an air of poisonous allure, two sickles with a deathly green light buzzing in his hands as his eyes released a green hue!
"Haha!"
Xian let out a wild laugh as his gaze landed on Katelyn, the concentration of Aether around him getting even denser as he walked forward fearlessly.
"You haven't forgotten me yet, right?
I couldn't freely make moves back then with Brightborn there, but you...you're really a fruit that I truly cannot pass up."
BZZZT!

His words were powerful as 30 dazzling Ascendancy Halos erupted and were ready to merge into him, the other monstrous genius from the Olden Times beside him doing the same as he released a horrific verdant light when he spoke.
"You really weren't lying Xian!
Why don't I take first dibs with her?
I'm sure you can feel how dangerous this will be."

These two existences appeared here with their own aims, and they affirmed their target as well as the fact that their destinies told them it would be an extremely difficult task to achieve their goal!
"I might have had to run away with nothing if I came alone." Xian nodded his head as his Will tried to discern destiny and Karma.

He had lived in the Olden Era as he knew how important understanding destiny was, and he wouldn't normally take risks that showed the level of danger that he was feeling right now when facing this calm young woman before him.
"But if she was easy to take down, then she wouldn't be a Dimensional Royalty.
Let's not tarry too long...make your move, Dion!"
WAA!

His lips curved in a devilish smile as he spoke, his figure shooting to the left while Dion shot to the right, circling Adjudicator Katelyn from different directions as they prepared for a tough battle!

chapters.title: Chapter 1825
paragraphs: Two monstrous existences from the Olden Era circled a single young woman after just a few words, their goals diabolical as they planned to forcefully impose themselves on this existence to attain something special!

Even though their destinies told them what they wanted to do would be extremely dangerous, they still made a move as for others- attaining a Dimensional Physique was the difference between life and death.
There were too many Candidate Emperors that rose within an Era.
How could one become special among the masses? How could they distinguish themselves from geniuses who held Mythical Natural Born Physiques?
Throughout recorded history, those who had managed to pull power from one of the 9 Dimensions had managed to distinguish themselves as in the case of Xian and Dion, they had to do this!

Their solidified crowns shone with a menacing light as Reality Passages that neared 100 for each of them erupted above, their eyes showing terrifying gazes when they looked at the existence before them as whatever they had to do...they would make sure to not let her swim past their grasp.

They weren't normal Beginner LEGENDS as their defenses and Damage Values were already well over double the 5 Million Base, their foundation being too monstrous as they had been preparing since the Olden Era!
Yet even these beings with such power moved with seriousness against a single Ninth Firmament Dimensional Royalty.
Two beings looked at her from different directions, yet their gazes were exactly the same.
She hated that type of gaze.
It was a gaze that she had seen all the time while she was growing up- where her father was the only man around her who didn't look at her in such a way!
The LEGENDS of the Royal Humans that were supposed to look at her as a junior for them to protect looked at her this way.
The delegation of any beings from the Main Reality that passed through the Domains of the Royal Humans and saw her...looked at her in this manner!
A gaze...as if she was an object for them to possess.
As if she was something for them to use to get something...and the only reason they couldn't do it was because of the fear towards her father or her own power!
These types of gazes were also part of the reason she never went to the Main Reality even when a LEGEND exceeding the Alpha Strata had let his will to take her as a disciple be known.
"I really hate it."
BZZZT!
She uttered these words with coldness as many memories from the past were pulled up, her body blaring with astounding light as 30 bright Ascendancy Halos flashed and got ready to fuse with her!
Yet at this juncture...
SHAA!
A fourth aura with astounding uniqueness and authority appeared.

It wasn't coming from the Chain of Reality leading below- but from the Chain of Reality on the east of the floating landmass that should have been leading straight across to another floating landmass!

With buzzing authority and releasing a type of essence others couldn't ignore, the eyes of the two attackers and Kayelyn who were all about to fuse with their Halos turned their eyes to ass the outline of the new entrant.
Surrounded by a sandy golden light that caused the Chain of Reality to vibrate, the massive figure of a regal Dragon Phoenix with purple gold scales and three flaming tails appeared.

He held a vibrant crown with the words <VAS> shining resplendently, and the eyes of the three existences on this landmass constricted when they observed closely to see that a humanoid figure was situated grandly atop this regal Dragon Phoenix, using its rising glorious horns as a throne for himself as he was currently gazing at everything curiously, his eyes lighting up when he saw the visage of Katelyn!
In turn, Xian and Dion's gazes turned somber.
This was because they felt the vibrant waves of a LEGEND from this Dragon Phoenix as its aura was near theirs...and yet a being was sitting atop it as if it were a mere mount!
A being...still in the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy.
The Dragon Phoenix had a solidified crown and yet...this existence didn't show anything above his head as he had to have been masking his authority.

But his entrance here would make things complicated as their destinies showed that a battle with their target alone would already be dangerous enough- not to mention an unknown existence who had managed to subjugate a genius Dragon Phoenix!

Granted, Xian might actually be able to remember the figure of Noah had he bothered to look around the Purple Endeavor that brought them here, but he had paid little attention to anyone else apart from Katelyn as even he didn't recognize Noah's visage at this moment.
With the eyes of three beings on him, Noah rose from his makeshift throne on top of Andur as he eyed Xian and Dion coldly.
"Now, what would you two be doing surrounding Adjudicator Katelyn like this?"
HUUUM!
His words reverberated with authority as he didn't seem to put the visage of the two LEGENDS in his eyes.
He appeared like a hero in the last minute to save a damsel in distress as his eyes lit up with power...before they gradually dimmed in the next second as destiny told him something else!
'Hmm?'

His gaze turned from the powerful LEGENDS surrounding Katelyn as they locked onto her, actually seeing this being raising her brows towards him as she didn't at all seem like someone who was worried after being surrounded by powerful existences.
He could instead feel reigned coldness and anger from her as this existence turned her eyes from him and stared at those who chose to attack her, her fair hand raising up as she...snapped her finger.
And then everything went to hell.
Noah's will buzzed as the scene and situation became clear, sighing in his heart as he affirmed he would not be able to show off or save any damsel in distress today.
The being that two Olden LEGENDS had surrounded was not a meek girl they could terrorize or put under their Will.
She was a monstrous Dimensional Royalty that they had now angered, and her wrath would not be sated until her enemies were extinguished!
'Well, I could at least understand a semblance of her power then...'
Noah sat back on the vibrant head of the Dragon Phoenix as he saw the shocking scene unfolding before his eyes the moment that Katelyn snapped her fingers.
Her surroundings became hectic as multiple miniature silver doorways flashed into existence...from different parts of her own body.

Multiple miniature Mirror Gateways that seemed anchored to her very skin bloomed where in the next second...the terrifying auras of Mirror Beast LEGENDS enlarged and stepped out while roaring with wrath- sensing the anger of their Master!

chapters.title: Chapter 1826
paragraphs: How was the stage of Reality distinguished?
How could one grasp the level of power that could truly be reached at this level and it was comparable against Supreme geniuses who had yet to break into it?

Noah had already learned from Lavalliere that the Stage of Reality was treated as the Realm for one to truly establish their foundation, with one's Reality Passages and unique items like Grotto Nacres that could simultaneously cultivate all Aspects of Existence and expand one's Reality Passages playing a role to nourish one's body until...Empyral Bones, Musculature, and Organs began to form!
Constantly nourishing every part of your body until something as abstruse as <Empyral> was formed in your body parts.
On an Empyral Bone, Musculature, or Organ- one could brand abilities or concepts onto them and unleash reified abilities with a mere thought and no consequence of energy consumption!
Even Noah after breaking all of the Limits....had gained the qualifications to forge the <Mythical Paragon's Empyral Foundation>.
Nourishment.

This was the crucial thing as newly risen LEGENDS had to depend on the foundation they established in the Firmaments of Ascendancy to show off their power in the early stages of Reality, and beings who had lived for millions of years building their foundations before breaking through should theoretically be unstoppable in the Primogenial Strata of Reality when facing against their peers.

So what was occurring at this moment atop a certain barren landmass was all the more unfathomable as two Primogenial Strata from the Olden Times adopted stern expressions while fusing with their Ascendancy Halos- their eyes staring at an unbelievable scene of a single Ninth Firmament existence opening Dimensional Gateways from her very body as 6 overpowering auras of Primogenial Strata Mirror Beast LEGENDS thundered out!
OOOOOOH!

Their bellows caused space to squeeze and fracture as the surrounded domain flashed with a silvery light, the hands of Katelyn coming together in front of her bountiful chest at this moment as they seemingly compressed dense Mirror Essence before she pulled her hands apart and caused the expansion of a radiant Mirror Barrier.
BZZT!
A barrier that made it seem countless mirrors appeared and surrounded half of the landmass as the figures of Xian and Dion were contained within.
Locked in a Mirror Dimension Domain with 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS and a particularly angered Dimensional Royalty!

Noah gazed at this shocking scene while thinking of the Abilities of RUINATION, specifically about her upgrade that should be occurring soon as he couldn't wait to see what marvelous control of Mirror Essence she would have next...because the way that Katelyn was manipulating this Dimensional Essence was even far and above what Noah could do with Dream Essence.

The 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS called out seemed to constantly be shifting their forms, their eyes wrathful locked onto Xian and Dion as the forms these Olden Emperors took while they were fusing with their Halos...were also the forms these Mirror Beasts took on.

Xian had a glorious purple aurora of wings erupting from his back as he formed into an archaic titanic crocodile whose scales shone with a menacing purple crystalline luster, storms of Aether erupting around him as Dion transformed into a titanic verdant King Cobra who had venomous green black poison dripping from its enormous fangs!

They released wild power and valor as established LEGENDS would have a hard time fighting against them, and yet three Mirror Beast LEGENDS took on the form of the Aether Bourne Crocodile that Xian adorned while the other three transformed into the Venomous Devouring King Cobra form that Dion took...the most dreadful thing being the fact that the aura these Mirror Beasts released being no less than the enemies they reflected.
The eyes of Xian and Dion turned somber.
The dress on Katelyn shimmered with a silver light as she beckoned with her fingers, her expression being akin to a queen commanding her soldiers with regality as the 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS moved!
Their appearance prompted the question of the appearance of LEGENDS within this Grotto Sanctum.

Anything that had formed its Reality would be stopped from entering with the restrictions of the barrier of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, when even if someone was connected to another as they wanted to pull them in through the folds of space once they were in it...
The very spatial essence carrying these beings would be reflected and bounce off of the barrier of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

Yet Katelyn was able to call out LEGEND Tier existence as she had Gateways built into her own body, where she didn't pull upon their essence of connection with her to draw them into this special Domain, but she simply released these terrifying Mirror Beasts that were contained in a Dimensional Space in her own body!
It was a terrifying venture as the existences who had set their eyes on her found themselves in a difficult situation that was evolving in an unexplainable direction.

And even in this constantly changing situation, the eyes of Katelyn were languid as while her summoned Mirror Beast LEGENDS began pressing down on Xian and Dion, her visage flashed as her extremely beautiful face turned towards Noah.
Noah who was currently sitting above his Dragon Phoenix while watching everything occurring with great focus!
Katelyn's eyes flashed with a silver light while gazing at Noah as something maddening occurred in the next instant.
A flash of silver light bloomed as the sounds of Mirrors sliding could be heard, and a change occurred on the left horn of Andur where the ecstatic aura of none other than Katelyn appeared!
A Mirror Clone!

With glimmering might and an expression filled with ease as if it was nothing, a figure looking just like her from the distance landed on the purple gold scales of Andur as she turned to gaze at Noah- speaking with a pondering tone while gazing at him up and down.

"You hid yourself really well," Her voice was mesmerizing and powerful to hear as it carried a trace of regality when she spoke, her figure standing straight as she continued, "I don't think I can let you go freely again without getting a sufficient answer as to why you attached yourself to Sis Genevieve and came into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum."
