paragraphs: "I don't think I can let you go freely again without getting a sufficient answer as to why you attached yourself to Sis Genevieve and came into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum."

She was a Ninth Firmament existence who was currently facing two extremely powerful LEGENDS who were geniuses from the Olden Era, and yet she didn't even seem to be putting all that much focus into the battle as a Mirror Clone of hers appeared on the vibrant scales of Andur!
What power!
What might!

"Adjudicator Katelyn," Noah gave a light nod and spoke out without even turning to his left where the dazzling figure of Katelyn stood, continuing to watch the shocking scene of Mirror Beast LEGENDS and the other figure of Katelyn commanding them as he replied.
"I didn't know you were this powerful."
His words caused the languid eyes of this Dimensional Royalty to rise as she looked at this being closely once more.

She had grown curious of him not because he was someone Genevieve brought back and his behavior- but because she had sensed a thin trace of Mirror Essence on him when he first entered the Pure Blooded Domains!
Yet now...
"How is it that you are vibrantly playing with...Dream Essence? When I first saw Mirror Essence on you not too long ago?"
WAA!

"You've asked me many questions, which one should I answer first?" Noah's eyes blazed with a profound light as he looked away from the enticing battle and gazed up at the figure of Katelyn standing atop the horn opposite to him.

Dimensional Essence buzzed between these two beings as Noah was surrounded by surging sandy gold Dream Essence, while Katelyn had silver Mirror Essence buzzing around her as these two opposing forces clashed to release a terrific pressure!

The mixture of Dream and Mirror Essence caused a unique mixture to erupt as even the dark and deathly essence from the Niflheim Dimension that was influencing the surroundings ever so slowly was pushed away.

Like two ancient beasts merely measuring each other's auras, the surging sandy gold essence and silver essence coiled and buzzed against each other as even the surrounding space trembled at their sheer impact.
The grand figure of the Dragon Phoenix these two beings stood on was trembling slightly at this moment while using everything in its power to not show its emotions, but its thoughts were tumultuous.
'What the fuck?!'

Andur watched the battle blooming from afar and the perpetrator who had actually locked down two powerful LEGENDS having another one of her bodies land atop it, not expecting to come across another being that seemed as ridiculous if not more ridiculous than the Tyrannical Emperor he had just pledged Fealty to- and it was an existence that was somewhat renowned in name that he had heard of before!
He just didn't know...she would be this dreadful.
'Are we...in the same grouping of geniuses still?'
This newly turned Vassal began questioning everything he knew as two existences wielding heavy Dimensional Essence stood on top of its majestic draconic head.
BOOOM!
"XIAN! What the hell did you embroil me in?!"

In the battle from afar, the figures of the Aether Bourne Crocodile and the Venomous Devouring King Cobra were already battered and bleeding True Blood as three Mirror Beast LEGENDS reflecting their own forms besieged them on all sides- not even having the chance to display their power and authority they had forged for millions of years as they were getting thrashed as if they were novice LEGENDS.

They were truly powerful and had forged their Foundations to a great degree as just in the short period of time they had become LEGENDS, their True Reality Damage Values could already exceed 10 Million+.
Yet...
"Fuck!"

They cursed under their breaths as Domains of Aether and Poison erupted out, battling the summons of a ridiculous being who only watched everything from afar while clasping her hands behind her silver dress.
Another form of hers was even gazing towards a terrifying existence on top of a Dragon Phoenix as if the battle in the distance had nothing to do with her!
This was the power of a Dimensional Royalty.
This was a semblance of their might!
"Start with Genevieve."
She spoke lightly as her tone was neither commanding nor servile, as if she was talking to someone on the same level as her.
Noah smiled at her reply as he turned his eyes back to the unfolding battle while he spoke.
"She is not who everyone believes she is. She is a Disaster Remnant that the LEGENDS of the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines killed and kept the body of a long time ago."
WAA!
Noah spoke of grand secrets freely as Katelyn's eyes turned extremely sharp!
"What?"

Her words carried obvious disbelief as Genevieve was the daughter of the current Bloodline Master, and if she chose not to break through to the stage of a LEGEND in this Grotto Sanctum- she would more than likely take this seat while her Father ascended to become a LEGEND and take a new position in the Main Reality!

Noah's words sounded wild, but he didn't take any more time to explain as he put his hands beside his head and caused a surge of mana, wisps of essence flowing together and condensing into a crystalline ball of light that he threw towards Katelyn.
A ball of light that when crushed by the hands of another- pre-chosen scenes and memories would play out!

Katelyn's mesmerizing eyes were fearless as she grasped this ball of light and allowed the harmless essence to sink into her, the scenes of Will Bearers appearing and waging war against Genevieve while she transformed into a 'Sacred Beast' playing out, as well as the scenes of Beatrix speaking with Noah after he had gained control of her!
Silence descended in the surroundings as only the quaking might of the far away battle could be heard.
"OOOOH!"

The ferocious bellow of Xian could be heard as TABOO waves of authority congealed around storms of Aether, beginning to form an ability that was close to REIFIED as a massive demonic Crocodile surrounded by blooming Aether lotuses on its left and right nearly opened its eyes, it's jaws opening to release beams of terrific light as the three Mirror Beasts opposing Xian...replicated this same scene in a terrific manner as Noah clicked his tongue at this.

The Mirror Beasts under this ridiculous Dimensional Royalty alone seemed capable of matching against powerful Primogenial Strata LEGENDS, Noah wanting to get his hands on his own Dream and Nightmare LEGENDS for him to call out to- or simply finish forging multiple Infinite Dream Automatons!
As for the one in question who had called them out?
Her gaze was currently difficult as she sifted through the memories Noah provided her, her head shaking with a sigh soon after as she turned to gaze towards Noah again.
"Why didn't you move to stop her then? Why follow her into the Lands of Royal Humans and into this Grotto Sanctum?"
"Because..." Noah's eyes turned luminous as his body rose, his visage that of an untouchable emperor as he stared straight at this astounding being beside him and spoke out with utmost seriousness!

"My Destiny told me that an immeasurable fate was waiting for me if I take this path- filled with treasures, authority, and even..." His luminous eyes locked on to Katelyn's silvery glazed eyes as he continued.
"...dazzling new allies that will challenge me."
WAA!
The words of the Tyrannical Emperor were bold as he gazed straight at Katelyn when he said this!
"Be serious." Katelyn's brows merely rose towards Noah's words as she brushed them off with ease, her eyes becoming covered with a silver light as she gazed off into the distant battle thoughtfully.
"This will be problematic to handle. I couldn't discern anything from her as if a Disaster Remnant is moving around freely in here..."
She seemed to be reminiscing about all the past memories of the one she knew as Genevieve as she sighed, a smile appearing on Noah's face at this as his voice echoed out.
"How is it problematic? We simply need to wipe out all traces of her before she leaves this Grotto Sanctum!"

Noah's words were filled with tyranny as he spoke, these two terrifying existences with their own Mythical Natural Born Dimensional Physiques talking straightforwardly for the first time as the results of this meeting were unknown!

chapters.title: Chapter 1828
paragraphs: Atop a barren land mass floating in cold seas that should have been filled with death and solitude.

Two immensely powerful Olden Emperors were being thrashed like mere children, their grandeur and visage being torn down like it was nothing by 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS whose controller...was currently not even putting all her focus on them!

A Mirror Clone of hers was sitting beside the devilishly handsome Tyrannical Emperor as the two of them seemed like celestial existences gracing their presence to the masses- and they did so in a shocking fashion while standing on top of a Dragon Phoenix whose very scales burned with a tinge of golden purple hue.
One could see the two were distinguished even from afar as their bodies pulsed with vibrant Dimensional Essence.

Katelyn was surrounded by radiant silver Essence as her gaze seemed to pierce across the veils of space and see things others couldn't, thinking about Noah's words of simply 'wiping out all traces of Genevieve who was unveiled to be a Disaster Remnant!
For this, one must consider what a Disaster Remnant was- and why Will Bearers were a faction of Primordials who were especially born to hunt those like them.

Will Bearers were existences holding connections to the Ancient Bloodlines that had long since been evicted out of the Main Reality by Primordials, with their most destined beings who managed to survive in the lands of Primordials until now being cleansed over the years!

Primordial LEGENDS who were proficient in Destiny took reigns of Will Bearers that they then sent out towards any Disaster Remnants they found, and this was how the Emperor of the Golden Eye had sent the Trio of Will Bearers that opposed Noah and Genevieve...and were instead turned into Resplendent Treasure Caches.
There were many Will Bearers in this Grotto Sanctum too, but how many of them knew that a target of their hunt walked among them?
'Even I didn't know all these years...'

A sigh escaped Katelyn's red lips as she returned her attention to the being who had the same visage as her...a being that seemed to keep her attention as she was somehow able to talk to him freely without being put off as if it was geniuses of the Royal Humans or those from the Main Reality who were around her 'age group' - they would already be granting her gazes of envy and jealousy if they were women, or gazes of greed and lust if they were men!
She didn't ponder too much on this as while a bullying in the distance nearly reached its climax, she got back on track.
"The other question." Her exceedingly beautiful face shook as she got back on topic, looking Noah up and down as she spoke freely.

"You had a trace of Mirror Essence...and still do, yet you are overflowing with Dream Essence at this moment. You...did you attain a Dimensional Physique in the short period of time I first met you, or you could just hide it really well?"
Her question sought answers to many things as Noah couldn't help but raise his brows quizzically towards her.
"You...why are you so freely asking about the secrets of others as if it is nothing?"
Noah asked a very simple question that caused Katelyn to blink a few times, the silver light in her eyes fluctuating as she gradually seemed to realize something.

She had already affirmed this being didn't mean any harm to the Bloodline her father stemmed from and had now found out he was even tracking a Disaster Remnant that was aiming for her old Body in the Treasury of the Royal Humans, and like all other geniuses- he had his own secrets and means of power that he didn't have to share with others- and in fact, nobody would so freely share their secrets.

She had just freely asked this question to sate her curiosity as she had never even bothered to take the initiative to talk to other so called geniuses, where even an existence like Ezekiel whom her sister moved with that she knew carried a powerful veil over his being wasn't enough to make her bother!
So what made her so freely ask this Alexander King things as she even stood on top of a genius he had subjugated?
Katelyn was pondering this question without answering Noah as his magnetic voice brought her back to the present.
"How about this, I'll answer that question if you allow me to...take care of those two little things."

Noah's eyes were locked onto the visibly panicking Xian and Dion in their monstrous forms of Aether Bourne Crocodile and the Venomous Devouring King Cobra who were surrounded on all sides and were simply getting thrashed in a way that utterly destroyed any semblance of their authority!
Katelyn turned her eyes towards this area as she actually took Noah's words seriously, replying soon after.
"Just one."
WAA!

Just one! Katelyn had promised herself that she would seek the power and authority her family seemed to be rushing towards so much, so of course she wouldn't just let a chance to attain more authority from existences who tried to harm her go!
The sheer fact that she was okay giving one away was a testament to her curiosity as towards her reply, Noah's eyes released a terrific luster.

He had pondered and even affirmed with destiny whether he could just freely kill steal the enemies Katelyn was currently thrashing to obtain their Bloodlines and loot, and destiny showed him not so favorable fates in terms of his barely formed relationship with this terrifying Dimensional Royalty if he moved around in secret or merely said 'woops' after he did whatever he wanted!
The existence known as Katelyn...seemed to have a rather straightforward personality as Noah used her curiosity to simply say what he wanted to do.
And for the price of answering a question, he could loot an Olden existence!
HUUM!
His body buzzed with power as he rose up and stared at Xian with a devilish gaze.

To rouse more curiosity from the Dimensional Royalty beside him, his body distinctly flashed with the allure of 30 black Ascendancy Halos that fused with him, an aurora of wings erupting from his back as he adorned the True form of the Pure Arch-Royal Human!
His visage became even more devilishly handsome as tendrils of Runic golden flames surged around him, his one wing expanding behind him as his hair lengthened and adopted a golden luster.
In such a strengthened state, he didn't cast terrifyingly apocalyptic abilities or expose with power as he instead actually sat back down atop his Dragon Phoenix...and he merely began to speak!
p"Hey,"

At his mere word, Katelyn's eyes constricted with care as she felt a billowing Tyrannical will carried along with them- a will that utilized authority and Soundwave to establish itself as it was the utilization of Emperor's Haki.
The ability that would allow Noah to infuse deadly Dimensional Damage Values to his mere words and thoughts as attacks so long as he released them with his <Emperor's Haki>!

chapters.title: Chapter 1829
paragraphs: The utilization of Haki was extremely unique as those weaker than Noah who were oppressed by his will would automatically lose 50% of their battle power against him.
It had turned passive when the Tyrannical Emperor became TABOO as Noah could actively use it against his enemies, and the unique thing was how its resource cost varied depending on the target!
If it was a weak enemy that Noah's will could easily overcome, the resource cost was negligible and not even worth mentioning.

But if it was someone truly powerful that even his strong will and soul couldn't easily sway- the resource cost would be higher the longer he directed this ability against them as it could theoretically reach hundreds of thousands of Units of the Essence of Reality per microsecond!

The will for his Haki stemmed from the strength of his Primogenial Soul as its power was drawn from here too, so Noah found it unique to target those in the Primogenial Strata of Reality with his own Soul that had yet to fully establish itself in the realm of Reality as the moment he came out the victor...he reaffirmed his robust foundation.
"Hey,"
Carried by Haki, the word barreled out as under the authority of this True Form, Noah easily exceeded 10 Million True Dimensional Damage Values with this attack alone.

It came to thunder in Xian's mind as his gaze quickly changed, his head buzzing as his right eye seemingly felt a heavy pressure building up inside as this Aether Bourne Crocodile had its eye and socket explode in the next instant!

The battlefield instantly changed as Xian's battered body pulled back from the three Mirror Beast LEGENDS that actually didn't follow him- all of this being under the command of their Master who was currently watching everything with interest.
She hadn't gotten a chance to freely associate with a being holding a connection to a Dimension this closely before as even the methods of power of others were different.
She wanted to see.
She was curious!

But in the mind of the target that was Xian, his Olden Soul was shuddering as he gazed towards the source of the voice with immense shock and fear- this being already feeling his Aspects of Existence and Reality Passages beginning to dim as a pervasive Dimensional Essence ravaged throughout his body!
His eyes could see his destiny turning extremely dark.
"Wait..."
So he croaked out.
But the luminous eyes of the Tyrannical Emperor were coldly gazing downwards as he finished his words while casting Emperor's Haki three times!
"Die for me."
BZZZT!

A negligible 75,000 Units of the Essence of Reality surged out from him against this being known as Xian, three booming attacks that arrived the moment they were voiced out smashing onto the visage of an Olden Emperor on all sides as this being...

Saw his own destiny close before his very eyes as his crocodilian head burst open with the first word, his defenses already dimming down due to the effects of the Dream Essence as the other two words smashed into his Origin and Soul as they were also smashed to bits!
BOOM...SPLAT!

And the end result of it all was the enormous body of the Aether Bourne Crocodile expanding in multiple areas like a stuffed balloon as shimmering golden true blood splattered over the jagged mirror barriers!

An Emperor at the Realm of Reality who had forged his foundation for millions of years and prepared to springboard himself into Hegemony in the Kainos Era...died that simply as the masses wouldn't even be there to witness his death.

Andur's figure trembled at this scene as he wiped imaginary sweat from his draconic brows, thankful he had somewhat listened to his destiny and didn't actually die from someone merely speaking a few words!

Meanwhile, Katelyn's eyes squinted as she observed this scene closely, seeing the immense will carried by the attacks the being beside her had sent forth while he was still situated atop a Dragon Phoenix.
<Hey, die for me.>
4 words.
That was all it took to end such an existence as Katelyn saw the dense and vibrant Dimensional Damage Values that totaled over 40 Million from these 4 words put together.

Yet even though this scene was dreadful as it even caused the figure of Dion to gaze in a stupor as the 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS all surged towards this Devouring King Cobra that was already on its last legs.
Yet Katelyn herself only nodded with shining eyes as even after she saw this...she actually still didn't feel any ounce of fear or apprehension when gazing at this level of power!
"That much level of Dimensional Essence is impossible for any common Dimensional Physique."

She spoke about what interested her the most as even the deaths of two powerful Emperors weren't placed in her eyes, the poor Olden Emperors known as Xian and Dion not even getting a proper burial as the latter was ripped apart by 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS in the seconds that followed, the shimmering crown above Katelyn's head shining as more ecritures formed while above Noah...no fluctuations showed as he still hid his vibrant crown.

He didn't yet answer Katelyn's words as he watched vibrant prompts wash over his eyes, his Will also moving out to pull the glowing true blood of the ravaged Devouring King Cobra as Katelyn's Mirror Barrier began to fade while the 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS returned to her the Dimensional Gateways on her body!
[+25 Primogenial Blood Pearls have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+2,500 Physique Refining Pearls obtained.]
[+25 Liquified Soul Dews have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+25 Liquified Soul Seas have been obtained.]
[+25 Seeds of Reality have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+25 False Grotto Nacres have been obtained.]
[+100,000,000 Trillion Skill Points obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+10,000 Reality Resource Points obtained.]
<The effects of Absolute Looter are applied.>
<You have attained the TABOO Edicts of Aether's Embrace, Emperor of Fortitude, Ophidian Emperor....>
<The Olden Bloodline of the Aether Bourne Crocodile has been attained.>

His body in the Main Reality buzzed with power in its slumber as the crown above him shone, the ecritures <ETHEREAL DIMENSI EMPEROR> shining with glory as even though he had just slain an existence that held multiple ecritures on his crown, the authority he had obtained from Xian added just a little to his own!

Part of the reason why he had garnered as much authority as he had was due to the fact that this being granted him 13 new TABOO Nomological Edicts, the wondrous Physique Refining Pearls, Liquefied Soul Seas, and False Grotto Nacres only being a bow to top off this whole gift as Noah began perusing the memories of this being and understand more intricacies of the past.

As he did this, his clone of Alexander released his true form as he returned to utter calmness on top of the Dragon Phoenix genius that was visibly trembling at this moment, the visage of Katelyn looking towards him with sparkling eyes that held a trace of vibrant curiosity, a quizzical expression present on her face as she asked with some hesitation.
"Are you...also a Dimensional Champion?"

sentences.text: The utilization of Haki was extremely unique as those weaker than Noah who were oppressed by his will would automatically lose 50% of their battle power against him.
It had turned passive when the Tyrannical Emperor became TABOO as Noah could actively use it against his enemies, and the unique thing was how its resource cost varied depending on the target!
If it was a weak enemy that Noah's will could easily overcome, the resource cost was negligible and not even worth mentioning.

But if it was someone truly powerful that even his strong will and soul couldn't easily sway- the resource cost would be higher the longer he directed this ability against them as it could theoretically reach hundreds of thousands of Units of the Essence of Reality per microsecond!

The will for his Haki stemmed from the strength of his Primogenial Soul as its power was drawn from here too, so Noah found it unique to target those in the Primogenial Strata of Reality with his own Soul that had yet to fully establish itself in the realm of Reality as the moment he came out the victor...he reaffirmed his robust foundation.
"Hey,"
Carried by Haki, the word barreled out as under the authority of this True Form, Noah easily exceeded 10 Million True Dimensional Damage Values with this attack alone.

It came to thunder in Xian's mind as his gaze quickly changed, his head buzzing as his right eye seemingly felt a heavy pressure building up inside as this Aether Bourne Crocodile had its eye and socket explode in the next instant!

The battlefield instantly changed as Xian's battered body pulled back from the three Mirror Beast LEGENDS that actually didn't follow him- all of this being under the command of their Master who was currently watching everything with interest.
She hadn't gotten a chance to freely associate with a being holding a connection to a Dimension this closely before as even the methods of power of others were different.
She wanted to see.
She was curious!

But in the mind of the target that was Xian, his Olden Soul was shuddering as he gazed towards the source of the voice with immense shock and fear- this being already feeling his Aspects of Existence and Reality Passages beginning to dim as a pervasive Dimensional Essence ravaged throughout his body!
His eyes could see his destiny turning extremely dark.
"Wait..."
So he croaked out.
But the luminous eyes of the Tyrannical Emperor were coldly gazing downwards as he finished his words while casting Emperor's Haki three times!
"Die for me."
BZZZT!

A negligible 75,000 Units of the Essence of Reality surged out from him against this being known as Xian, three booming attacks that arrived the moment they were voiced out smashing onto the visage of an Olden Emperor on all sides as this being...

Saw his own destiny close before his very eyes as his crocodilian head burst open with the first word, his defenses already dimming down due to the effects of the Dream Essence as the other two words smashed into his Origin and Soul as they were also smashed to bits!
BOOM...SPLAT!

And the end result of it all was the enormous body of the Aether Bourne Crocodile expanding in multiple areas like a stuffed balloon as shimmering golden true blood splattered over the jagged mirror barriers!

An Emperor at the Realm of Reality who had forged his foundation for millions of years and prepared to springboard himself into Hegemony in the Kainos Era...died that simply as the masses wouldn't even be there to witness his death.

Andur's figure trembled at this scene as he wiped imaginary sweat from his draconic brows, thankful he had somewhat listened to his destiny and didn't actually die from someone merely speaking a few words!

Meanwhile, Katelyn's eyes squinted as she observed this scene closely, seeing the immense will carried by the attacks the being beside her had sent forth while he was still situated atop a Dragon Phoenix.
<Hey, die for me.>
4 words.
That was all it took to end such an existence as Katelyn saw the dense and vibrant Dimensional Damage Values that totaled over 40 Million from these 4 words put together.

Yet even though this scene was dreadful as it even caused the figure of Dion to gaze in a stupor as the 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS all surged towards this Devouring King Cobra that was already on its last legs.
Yet Katelyn herself only nodded with shining eyes as even after she saw this...she actually still didn't feel any ounce of fear or apprehension when gazing at this level of power!
"That much level of Dimensional Essence is impossible for any common Dimensional Physique."

She spoke about what interested her the most as even the deaths of two powerful Emperors weren't placed in her eyes, the poor Olden Emperors known as Xian and Dion not even getting a proper burial as the latter was ripped apart by 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS in the seconds that followed, the shimmering crown above Katelyn's head shining as more ecritures formed while above Noah...no fluctuations showed as he still hid his vibrant crown.

He didn't yet answer Katelyn's words as he watched vibrant prompts wash over his eyes, his Will also moving out to pull the glowing true blood of the ravaged Devouring King Cobra as Katelyn's Mirror Barrier began to fade while the 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS returned to her the Dimensional Gateways on her body!
